en_question: A company needs to partition the Amazon S3 storage that the company uses for a data lake. The partitioning will use a path of the S3 object keys in the following format: s3://bucket/prefix/year=2023/month=01/day=01. A data engineer must ensure that the AWS Glue Data Catalog synchronizes with the S3 storage when the company adds new partitions to the bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST latency?

A.text: Schedule an AWS Glue crawler to run every morning.

B.text: Manually run the AWS Glue CreatePartition API twice each day.

C.text: Use code that writes data to Amazon S3 to invoke the Boto3 AWS Glue create_partition API call.

D.text: Run the MSCK REPAIR TABLE command from the AWS Glue console.

zh_question: 一家公司需要對其用於資料湖的AmazonS3儲存空間進行分割。分割將使用以 下格式的S3物件鍵路徑：s3://bucket/prefix/year=2023/month=01/day=01。 資料工程師必須確保當公司在儲存桶中新增分割區時，AWSGlue資料目錄能與 S3儲存保持同步。 哪種解決方案能以最低的延遲滿足這些需求？

A.text: 排程讓AWSGlue爬蟲程式每天早上執行一次。

B.text: 每天手動執行兩次AWSGlueCreatePartitionAPI。

C.text: 使用將資料寫入AmazonS3的程式碼來呼叫Boto3AWSGluecreate_partitionAPI 呼叫。

D.text: 從AWSGlue控制台執行MSCKREPAIRTABLE指令。

en_question: A media company uses software as a service (SaaS) applications to gather data by using third-party tools. The company needs to store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company will use Amazon Redshift to perform analytics based on the data. Which AWS service or feature will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)

B.text: Amazon AppFlow

C.text: AWS Glue Data Catalog

D.text: Amazon Kinesis

zh_question: 一家媒體公司使用軟體即服務(SaaS)應用程式，並透過第三方工具收集資料。該 公司需要將資料儲存在AmazonS3儲存貯體中，並將使用AmazonRedshift根 據這些資料執行分析。 哪項AWS服務或功能能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: AmazonManagedStreamingforApacheKafka(AmazonMSK)

B.text: AmazonAppFlow

C.text: AWSGlueDataCatalog

D.text: AmazonKinesis

en_question: A data engineer is using Amazon Athena to analyze sales data that is in Amazon S3. The data engineer writes a query to retrieve sales amounts for 2023 for several products from a table named sales_data. However, the query does not return results for all of the products that are in the sales_data table. The data engineer needs to troubleshoot the query to resolve the issue. The data engineer's original query is as follows: SELECT product_name, sum(sales_amount) FROM sales_data - WHERE year = 2023 - GROUP BY product_name - How should the data engineer modify the Athena query to meet these requirements?

A.text: Replace sum(sales_amount) with count(*) for the aggregation.

B.text: Change WHERE year = 2023 to WHERE extract(year FROM sales_data) = 2023.

C.text: Add HAVING sum(sales_amount) > 0 after the GROUP BY clause.

D.text: Remove the GROUP BY clause.

zh_question: 一位資料工程師正在使用AmazonAthena分析位於AmazonS3中的銷售資料。 該資料工程師撰寫了一個查詢，旨在從名為sales_data的表中檢索幾種產品在 2023年的銷售金額。然而，該查詢並未傳回sales_data表中所有產品的結果。 該資料工程師需要除錯此查詢以解決問題。 資料工程師的原始查詢如下： SELECTproduct_name,sum(sales_amount) FROMsalesdata‑_ WHEREyear= 2023 ‑ GROUPBYproduct_name‑ 資料工程師應如何修改Athena查詢以符合這些需求？

A.text: 將聚合函數sum(sales_amount)替換為count(*)。

B.text: 將WHEREyear= 2023 改為WHEREextract(yearFROMsales_data)= 2023。

C.text: 在GROUPBY子句之後新增HAVINGsum(sales_amount)> 0 。

D.text: 移除GROUPBY子句。

en_question: A data engineer has a one-time task to read data from objects that are in Apache Parquet format in an Amazon S3 bucket. The data engineer needs to query only one column of the data. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Configure an AWS Lambda function to load data from the S3 bucket into a pandas dataframe. Write a SQL SELECT statement on the dataframe to query the required column.

B.text: Use S3 Select to write a SQL SELECT statement to retrieve the required column from the S3 objects.

C.text: Prepare an AWS Glue DataBrew project to consume the S3 objects and to query the required column.

D.text: Run an AWS Glue crawler on the S3 objects. Use a SQL SELECT statement in Amazon Athena to query the required column.

zh_question: 一位資料工程師有一項一次性任務，需從位於AmazonS3儲存桶中的 ApacheParquet格式物件讀取資料。該資料工程師只需查詢其中一欄資料。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 設定AWSLambda函式，將資料從S3儲存桶載入至pandas資料框。 在資料框上撰寫SQLSELECT陳述式以查詢所需的欄位。

B.text: 使用S3Select撰寫SQLSELECT陳述式，從S3物件中擷取所需的欄位。

C.text: 準備AWSGlueDataBrew專案以消費S3物件，並查詢所需的欄位。

D.text: 在S3物件上執行AWSGlue爬蟲。在AmazonAthena中使用SQLSELECT陳述式 來查詢所需的欄位。

en_question: A company uses Amazon Redshift for its data warehouse. The company must automate refresh schedules for Amazon Redshift materialized views. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST effort?

A.text: Use Apache Airflow to refresh the materialized views.

B.text: Use an AWS Lambda user-defined function (UDF) within Amazon Redshift to refresh the materialized views.

C.text: Use the query editor v2 in Amazon Redshift to refresh the materialized views.

D.text: Use an AWS Glue workflow to refresh the materialized views.

zh_question: 一家公司使用AmazonRedshift作為其資料倉儲。該公司必須自動化 AmazonRedshift實體化檢視表的重新整理排程。哪種解決方案能以最少的 工作量滿足此需求？

A.text: 使用ApacheAirflow重新整理實體化檢視表。

B.text: 在AmazonRedshift中使用AWSLambda使用者定義函數(UDF)來重新整理實體化 檢視表。

C.text: 使用AmazonRedshift中的查詢編輯器v2來重新整理實體化檢視表。

D.text: 使用AWSGlue工作流程來重新整理實體化檢視表。

en_question: A data engineer must orchestrate a data pipeline that consists of one AWS Lambda function and one AWS Glue job. The solution must integrate with AWS services. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST management overhead?

A.text: Use an AWS Step Functions workflow that includes a state machine. Configure the state machine to run the Lambda function and then the AWS Glue job.

B.text: Use an Apache Airflow workflow that is deployed on an Amazon EC2 instance. Define a directed acyclic graph (DAG) in which the first task is to call the Lambda function and the second task is to call the AWS Glue job.

C.text: Use an AWS Glue workflow to run the Lambda function and then the AWS Glue job.

D.text: Use an Apache Airflow workflow that is deployed on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). Define a directed acyclic graph (DAG) in which the first task is to call the Lambda function and the second task is to call the AWS Glue job.

zh_question: 資料工程師必須協調由一個AWSLambda函數和一個AWSGlue任務組成的 資料管線。該解決方案必須與AWS服務整合。 哪種解決方案能以最低的管理負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用包含狀態機的AWSStepFunctions工作流程。將狀態機設定為先執行Lambda 函式，然後執行AWSGlue任務。

B.text: 使用部署在亞馬遜彈性運算雲端（AmazonEC2）執行個體上的ApacheAirflow工作流程。定義一個 有向無環圖（DAG），其中第一個任務是呼叫Lambda函式，而 第二個任務是呼叫AWSGlue任務。

C.text: 使用AWSGlue工作流程來執行Lambda函數，然後執行AWSGlue任務。

D.text: 使用部署在亞馬遜彈性容器服務(AmazonEKS)上的ApacheAirflow工作流程。定義一個 有向無環圖(DAG)，其中第一個任務是呼叫Lambda函數，第二個任務是呼叫AWSGlue任務。

en_question: A company needs to set up a data catalog and metadata management for data sources that run in the AWS Cloud. The company will use the data catalog to maintain the metadata of all the objects that are in a set of data stores. The data stores include structured sources such as Amazon RDS and Amazon Redshift. The data stores also include semistructured sources such as JSON files and .xml files that are stored in Amazon S3. The company needs a solution that will update the data catalog on a regular basis. The solution also must detect changes to the source metadata. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Use Amazon Aurora as the data catalog. Create AWS Lambda functions that will connect to the data catalog. Configure the Lambda functions to gather the metadata information from multiple sources and to update the Aurora data catalog. Schedule the Lambda functions to run periodically.

B.text: Use the AWS Glue Data Catalog as the central metadata repository. Use AWS Glue crawlers to connect to multiple data stores and to update the Data Catalog with metadata changes. Schedule the crawlers to run periodically to update the metadata catalog.

C.text: Use Amazon DynamoDB as the data catalog. Create AWS Lambda functions that will connect to the data catalog. Configure the Lambda functions to gather the metadata information from multiple sources and to update the DynamoDB data catalog. Schedule the Lambda functions to run periodically.

D.text: Use the AWS Glue Data Catalog as the central metadata repository. Extract the schema for Amazon RDS and Amazon Redshift sources, and build the Data Catalog. Use AWS Glue crawlers for data that is in Amazon S3 to infer the schema and to automatically update the Data Catalog.

zh_question: 一家公司需要為在AWS雲端中運作的資料來源設定資料目錄與後設資料管理。該 公司將使用資料目錄來維護一組資料儲存區中所有物件的後設資料。這些資料儲存 區包含結構化來源，例如AmazonRDS和AmazonRedshift；也包含半結構化 來源，例如儲存在AmazonS3中的JSON檔案和.xml檔案。 公司需要一個能定期更新資料目錄的解決方案。該解決方案也必須偵測來源中 繼資料的變更。哪項解決方案能以最低的營運負擔符合這些需求？

A.text: 使用AmazonAurora作為資料目錄。建立將連線至資料目錄的AWSLambda函式。設 定這些Lambda函式以從 多個來源收集中繼資料資訊，並更新Aurora資料目錄。排程讓這些Lambda函式定期執行。

B.text: 使用AWSGlue資料目錄作為中央中繼資料儲存庫。使用AWSGlue爬取程式連線至多個 資料儲存區，並以中繼資料變更更新資料目錄。 排程讓爬取程式定期執行以更新中繼資料目錄。

C.text: 使用AmazonDynamoDB作為資料目錄。建立將連線至資料目錄的AWSLambda函式。 設定這些Lambda函式以從 多個來源收集元資料資訊並更新DynamoDB資料目錄。排程讓這些Lambda函式定期執行。

D.text: 使用AWSGlueDataCatalog作為中央元資料儲存庫。擷取AmazonRDS和 AmazonRedshift來源的結構描述，並建置資料目錄。針對位於AmazonS3中的資料，使用 AWSGlue爬蟲程式來推斷結構描述並自動更新資料目錄。

en_question: A company stores data from an application in an Amazon DynamoDB table that operates in provisioned capacity mode. The workloads of the application have predictable throughput load on a regular schedule. Every Monday, there is an immediate increase in activity early in the morning. The application has very low usage during weekends. The company must ensure that the application performs consistently during peak usage times. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST cost-effective way?

A.text: Increase the provisioned capacity to the maximum capacity that is currently present during peak load times.

B.text: Divide the table into two tables. Provision each table with half of the provisioned capacity of the original table. Spread queries evenly across both tables.

C.text: Use AWS Application Auto Scaling to schedule higher provisioned capacity for peak usage times. Schedule lower capacity during off-peak times.

D.text: Change the capacity mode from provisioned to on-demand. Configure the table to scale up and scale down based on the load on the table.

zh_question: 一家公司將應用程式的資料儲存在以預置容量模式運作的Amazon DynamoDB資料表中。該應用程式的工作負載具有可預測的定期吞吐量負載。 每逢週一清晨，活動量會立即增加；而週末期間的使用量則非常低。 該公司必須確保應用程式在尖峰使用時段能維持一致的效能。 哪項解決方案能以最符合成本效益的方式滿足這些需求？

A.text: 將預置容量增加至目前尖峰負載時段所出現的最大容量。 尖峰負載時段。

B.text: 將資料表分割為兩個資料表。為每個資料表配置原資料表預置容量的一半。將查詢均勻分 散至這兩個資料表。

C.text: 使用AWSApplicationAutoScaling排程在尖峰使用時段提高預置容量，並在離峰時段 排程較低的容量。

D.text: 將容量模式從預置改為隨需。設定資料表依據其負載自動擴展與縮減。

en_question: A company is planning to migrate on-premises Apache Hadoop clusters to Amazon EMR. The company also needs to migrate a data catalog into a persistent storage solution. The company currently stores the data catalog in an on-premises Apache Hive metastore on the Hadoop clusters. The company requires a serverless solution to migrate the data catalog. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

A.text: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate the Hive metastore into Amazon S3. Configure AWS Glue Data Catalog to scan Amazon S3 to produce the data catalog.

B.text: Configure a Hive metastore in Amazon EMR. Migrate the existing on-premises Hive metastore into Amazon EMR. Use AWS Glue Data Catalog to store the company's data catalog as an external data catalog.

C.text: Configure an external Hive metastore in Amazon EMR. Migrate the existing on-premises Hive metastore into Amazon EMR. Use Amazon Aurora MySQL to store the company's data catalog.

D.text: Configure a new Hive metastore in Amazon EMR. Migrate the existing on-premises Hive metastore into Amazon EMR. Use the new metastore as the company's data catalog.

zh_question: 一家公司正計劃將本地的ApacheHadoop叢集遷移至AmazonEMR。該 公司還需要將資料目錄遷移至持久化儲存解決方案。 該公司目前將資料目錄儲存在Hadoop叢集上的本地ApacheHive中繼儲存庫 中。該公司需要一種無伺服器解決方案來遷移資料目錄。 哪種解決方案能以最具成本效益的方式滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用AWSDatabaseMigrationService(AWSDMS)將Hive中繼儲存庫遷移至 AmazonS3。設定AWSGlueDataCatalog以掃描AmazonS3來產生資料目錄。

B.text: 在AmazonEMR中設定Hive中繼資料庫。將現有的內部部署Hive中繼資料庫遷移至 AmazonEMR。使用AWSGlueDataCatalog將公司的資料目錄儲存為外部資料目錄。

C.text: 在AmazonEMR中設定外部Hive中繼資料庫。將現有的內部部署Hive中繼資料庫遷移 至AmazonEMR。使用AmazonAuroraMySQL儲存公司的資料目錄。

D.text: 在AmazonEMR中設定新的Hive中繼資料庫。將現有的內部部署Hive中繼資料庫 遷移至AmazonEMR。使用新的中繼資料庫作為公司的資料目錄。

en_question: A company uses an Amazon Redshift provisioned cluster as its database. The Redshift cluster has five reserved ra3.4xlarge nodes and uses key distribution. A data engineer notices that one of the nodes frequently has a CPU load over 90%. SQL Queries that run on the node are queued. The other four nodes usually have a CPU load under 15% during daily operations. The data engineer wants to maintain the current number of compute nodes. The data engineer also wants to balance the load more evenly across all five compute nodes. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Change the sort key to be the data column that is most often used in a WHERE clause of the SQL SELECT statement.

B.text: Change the distribution key to the table column that has the largest dimension.

C.text: Upgrade the reserved node from ra3.4xlarge to ra3.16xlarge.

D.text: Change the primary key to be the data column that is most often used in a WHERE clause of the SQL SELECT statement.

zh_question: 某公司使用AmazonRedshift預置叢集作為其資料庫。該紅移叢集擁有五個保 留的ra3.4xlarge節點，並採用金鑰分發策略。 一位資料工程師發現其中一個節點的CPU負載經常超過90%。在該節點上執 行的查詢會被排入佇列。在日常運作期間，其他四個節點的CPU負載通常低於 15%。 這位資料工程師希望維持目前的運算節點數量。該 資料工程師也希望能在所有五個節點之間更均勻地平衡負載。 計算節點。 哪種解決方案能滿足這些需求？

A.text: 將排序鍵改為SQLSELECT陳述式之WHERE子句中最常使用的資料欄位。

B.text: 將分散式鍵改為具有最大維度的表格欄位。

C.text: 將保留節點從ra3.4xlarge升級為ra3.16xlarge。

D.text: 將主鍵變更為在SQLSELECT陳述式的WHERE子句中最常使用的資料欄位。

en_question: A security company stores IoT data that is in JSON format in an Amazon S3 bucket. The data structure can change when the company upgrades the IoT devices. The company wants to create a data catalog that includes the IoT data. The company's analytics department will use the data catalog to index the data. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

A.text: Create an AWS Glue Data Catalog. Configure an AWS Glue Schema Registry. Create a new AWS Glue workload to orchestrate the ingestion of the data that the analytics department will use into Amazon Redshift Serverless.

B.text: Create an Amazon Redshift provisioned cluster. Create an Amazon Redshift Spectrum database for the analytics department to explore the data that is in Amazon S3. Create Redshift stored procedures to load the data into Amazon Redshift.

C.text: Create an Amazon Athena workgroup. Explore the data that is in Amazon S3 by using Apache Spark through Athena. Provide the Athena workgroup schema and tables to the analytics department.

D.text: Create an AWS Glue Data Catalog. Configure an AWS Glue Schema Registry. Create AWS Lambda user defined functions (UDFs) by using the Amazon Redshift Data API. Create an AWS Step Functions job to orchestrate the ingestion of the data that the analytics department will use into Amazon Redshift Serverless.

zh_question: 一家安全公司將以JSON格式儲存的物聯網(IoT)資料存放於AmazonS3儲存貯 體中。當該公司升級物聯網裝置時，資料結構可能會發生變更。該公司希望建立一 個包含物聯網資料的資料目錄，其分析部門將使用此資料目錄來編制資料索引。哪 種解決方案能以最具成本效益的方式滿足這些需求？

A.text: 建立AWSGlue資料目錄。設定AWSGlue結構描述登錄檔。建立新的AWSGlue工作流 程，以協調將分析部門所需之資料匯入AmazonRedshiftServerless。

B.text: 建立一個AmazonRedshift預置叢集。為分析部門建立一個AmazonRedshiftS pectrum資料庫，以便探索位於AmazonS3中的資料。建立Redshift預存程序，將資料載入 至AmazonRedshift。

C.text: 建立一個AmazonAthena工作群組。透過Athena使用ApacheSpark探索位於 AmazonS3中的資料。向分析部門提供Athena工作群組的綱要與資料表。

D.text: 建立一個AWSGlue資料目錄。設定一個AWSGlue結構描述登錄檔。使用Amazon RedshiftDataAPI建立AWSLambda使用者定義函數(UDF)。建立一個AWSStep Functions作業，以協調將分析部門所需資料匯入至AmazonRedshiftServerless的流程。

en_question: A company stores details about transactions in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company wants to log all writes to the S3 bucket into another S3 bucket that is in the same AWS Region. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational effort?

A.text: Configure an S3 Event Notifications rule for all activities on the transactions S3 bucket to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to write the event to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Configure Kinesis Data Firehose to write the event to the logs S3 bucket.

B.text: Create a trail of management events in AWS CloudTraiL. Configure the trail to receive data from the transactions S3 bucket. Specify an empty prefix and write-only events. Specify the logs S3 bucket as the destination bucket.

C.text: Configure an S3 Event Notifications rule for all activities on the transactions S3 bucket to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to write the events to the logs S3 bucket.

D.text: Create a trail of data events in AWS CloudTraiL. Configure the trail to receive data from the transactions S3 bucket. Specify an empty prefix and write-only events. Specify the logs S3 bucket as the destination bucket.

zh_question: 一家公司將交易詳細資訊儲存在AmazonS3儲存貯體中。該公司希望將所有對 該S3儲存貯體的寫入操作記錄到同一個AWS區域中的另一個S3儲存貯體。 哪種解決方案能以最小的營運工作量滿足此需求？

A.text: 為交易儲存貯體上的所有活動設定S3事件通知規則，以呼叫AWSLambda函式。撰寫該 Lambda函式以將事件寫入至AmazonKinesisDataFirehose。設定KinesisData Firehose將事件寫入至日誌儲存貯體。

B.text: 在AWSCloudTrail中建立管理事件追蹤。設定該追蹤以接收來自交易儲存貯體的資料。指 定空前綴和僅寫入事件。將日誌儲存貯體指定為目標儲存貯體。

C.text: 為交易儲存貯體上的所有活動設定S3事件通知規則，以呼叫AWSLambda函式。撰寫該 Lambda函式以將事件寫入至日誌儲存貯體。

D.text: 在AWSCloudTrail中建立資料事件追蹤。設定該追蹤以接收來自transactionsS3儲存 桶的資料。指定空前綴與僅寫入事件。指定日誌S3 儲存桶作為目標儲存桶。

en_question: A data engineer needs to maintain a central metadata repository that users access through Amazon EMR and Amazon Athena queries. The repository needs to provide the schema and properties of many tables. Some of the metadata is stored in Apache Hive. The data engineer needs to import the metadata from Hive into the central metadata repository. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

A.text: Use Amazon EMR and Apache Ranger.

B.text: Use a Hive metastore on an EMR cluster.

C.text: Use the AWS Glue Data Catalog.

D.text: Use a metastore on an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance.

zh_question: 資料工程師需要維護一個中央中繼資料儲存庫，供使用者透過AmazonEMR和 AmazonAthena查詢進行存取。該儲存庫需提供許多表的結構描述與屬性。部 分中繼資料儲存於ApacheHive中。資料工程師需要將中繼資料從Hive匯入至 中央中繼資料儲存庫。 哪種解決方案能以最小的開發工作量滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用AmazonEMR和ApacheRanger。

B.text: 在EMR叢集上使用Hive中繼儲存區。

C.text: 使用AWSGlue資料目錄。

D.text: 在AmazonRDSforMySQL資料庫執行個體上使用中繼儲存區。

en_question: A company needs to build a data lake in AWS. The company must provide row- level data access and column-level data access to specific teams. The teams will access the data by using Amazon Athena, Amazon Redshift Spectrum, and Apache Hive from Amazon EMR. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Use Amazon S3 for data lake storage. Use S3 access policies to restrict data access by rows and columns. Provide data access through Amazon S3.

B.text: Use Amazon S3 for data lake storage. Use Apache Ranger through Amazon EMR to restrict data access by rows and columns. Provide data access by using Apache Pig.

C.text: Use Amazon Redshift for data lake storage. Use Redshift security policies to restrict data access by rows and columns. Provide data access by using Apache Spark and Amazon Athena federated queries.

D.text: Use Amazon S3 for data lake storage. Use AWS Lake Formation to restrict data access by rows and columns. Provide data access through AWS Lake Formation.

zh_question: 一家公司需要在AWS中建置資料湖。該公司必須向特定團隊提供列層級與欄層級 的資料存取權限。這些團隊將透過AmazonAthena、AmazonRedshift Spectrum以及來自AmazonEMR的ApacheHive來存取資料。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用AmazonS3作為資料湖儲存。利用S3存取原則，依列限制資料存取 和欄。透過AmazonS3提供資料存取。

B.text: 使用AmazonS3作為資料湖儲存。透過AmazonEMR使用ApacheRanger，依列和 欄限制資料存取。使用ApachePig提供資料存取。

C.text: 使用AmazonRedshift作為資料湖儲存。利用Redshift安全性原則，依列和欄限制資料 存取。使用ApacheSpark和AmazonAthena聯邦查詢提供資料存取。

D.text: 使用AmazonS3作為資料湖儲存。使用AWSLakeFormation依列和欄限制資料存取。 透過AWSLakeFormation提供資料存取。

en_question: An airline company is collecting metrics about flight activities for analytics. The company is conducting a proof of concept (POC) test to show how analytics can provide insights that the company can use to increase on-time departures. The POC test uses objects in Amazon S3 that contain the metrics in .csv format. The POC test uses Amazon Athena to query the data. The data is partitioned in the S3 bucket by date. As the amount of data increases, the company wants to optimize the storage solution to improve query performance. Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

A.text: Add a randomized string to the beginning of the keys in Amazon S3 to get more throughput across partitions.

B.text: Use an S3 bucket that is in the same account that uses Athena to query the data.

C.text: Use an S3 bucket that is in the same AWS Region where the company runs Athena queries.

D.text: Preprocess the .csv data to JSON format by fetching only the document keys that the query requires.

E.text: Preprocess the .csv data to Apache Parquet format by fetching only the data blocks that are needed for predicates.

zh_question: 一家航空公司正在蒐集航班活動指標以進行分析。該公司正進行概念驗證（ POC）測試，以展示分析如何提供見解，協助公司提升準時起飛率。 POC測試使用位於AmazonS3中的物件，這些物件包含.csv格式的指標。該 測試利用AmazonAthena來查詢資料，且資料在S3儲存桶中已依日期進行分 割。 隨著資料量增加，公司希望最佳化儲存解決方案以提升查詢效能。 哪種解決方案組合能符合這些需求？（請選擇兩項。）

A.text: 在AmazonS3的鍵值開頭加入隨機字串，以提高跨分割區的吞吐量 跨分割區。

B.text: 使用與執行Athena查詢之帳戶相同的S3儲存貯桶。

C.text: 使用與公司執行Athena查詢所在相同AWS區域的S3儲存貯桶。

D.text: 僅擷取查詢所需的文件鍵，將.csv資料預處理為JSON格式。

E.text: 僅擷取謂詞所需的資料區塊，將.csv資料預處理為ApacheParquet格式。

en_question: A company uses Amazon RDS for MySQL as the database for a critical application. The database workload is mostly writes, with a small number of reads. A data engineer notices that the CPU utilization of the DB instance is very high. The high CPU utilization is slowing down the application. The data engineer must reduce the CPU utilization of the DB Instance. Which actions should the data engineer take to meet this requirement? (Choose two.)

A.text: Use the Performance Insights feature of Amazon RDS to identify queries that have high CPU utilization. Optimize the problematic queries.

B.text: Modify the database schema to include additional tables and indexes.

C.text: Reboot the RDS DB instance once each week.

D.text: Upgrade to a larger instance size.

E.text: Implement caching to reduce the database query load.

zh_question: 一家公司使用AmazonRDSforMySQL作為關鍵應用程式的資料庫。該資料 庫的工作負載主要為寫入操作，讀取操作較少。 資料工程師注意到資料庫執行個體的CPU使用率非常高。高CPU使用率導致應 用程式變慢。資料工程師必須降低資料庫執行個體的CPU使用率。 資料工程師應採取哪些行動來符合此需求？（請選擇兩項。）

A.text: 使用AmazonRDS的PerformanceInsights功能，識別具有高CPU使用率的查詢。最 佳化這些有問題的查詢。

B.text: 修改資料庫結構描述，加入額外的資料表和索引。

C.text: 每週重新啟動一次RDS資料庫執行個體。

D.text: 升級至較大型的執行個體大小。

E.text: 實作快取機制以減少資料庫查詢負載。

en_question: A company has used an Amazon Redshift table that is named Orders for 6 months. The company performs weekly updates and deletes on the table. The table has an interleaved sort key on a column that contains AWS Regions. The company wants to reclaim disk space so that the company will not run out of storage space. The company also wants to analyze the sort key column. Which Amazon Redshift command will meet these requirements?

A.text: VACUUM FULL Orders

B.text: VACUUM DELETE ONLY Orders

C.text: VACUUM REINDEX Orders

D.text: VACUUM SORT ONLY Orders

zh_question: 一家公司已使用名為Orders的AmazonRedshift表格達6 個月。該公司每週對該表格執行更新和刪除作業。該表格在包含AWS區域 的欄位上具有交錯排序鍵。 該公司希望回收磁碟空間，以免儲存空間耗盡。該公司也希望分析排序鍵欄位。 哪一個AmazonRedshift指令能符合這些需求？

A.text: VACUUMFULLOrders

B.text: 僅對訂單執行VACUUMDELETE

C.text: 對訂單執行VACUUMREINDEX

D.text: 僅對訂單執行VACUUMSORT

en_question: A manufacturing company wants to collect data from sensors. A data engineer needs to implement a solution that ingests sensor data in near real time. The solution must store the data to a persistent data store. The solution must store the data in nested JSON format. The company must have the ability to query from the data store with a latency of less than 10 milliseconds. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Use a self-hosted Apache Kafka cluster to capture the sensor data. Store the data in Amazon S3 for querying.

B.text: Use AWS Lambda to process the sensor data. Store the data in Amazon S3 for querying.

C.text: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to capture the sensor data. Store the data in Amazon DynamoDB for querying.

D.text: Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to buffer incoming sensor data. Use AWS Glue to store the data in Amazon RDS for querying.

zh_question: 一家製造公司希望收集感測器資料。資料工程師需要實作一種解決方案，以近乎 即時的方式匯入感測器資料。該解決方案必須將資料儲存至持久性資料儲存區， 且必須以巢狀JSON格式儲存資料。該公司必須能夠從資料儲存區進行查詢，延 遲低於10毫秒。哪種解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用自行託管的ApacheKafka叢集來擷取感測器資料。將資料儲存於Amazon S3以供查詢。

B.text: 使用AWSLambda處理感測器資料。將資料儲存於AmazonS3以供查詢。

C.text: 使用AmazonKinesisDataStreams來擷取感測器資料。將資料儲存於Amazon DynamoDB以供查詢。

D.text: 使用AmazonSimpleQueueService（AmazonSQS）緩衝傳入的感測器資料。使用 AWSGlue將資料儲存於AmazonRDS以供查詢。

en_question: A company stores data in a data lake that is in Amazon S3. Some data that the company stores in the data lake contains personally identifiable information (PII). Multiple user groups need to access the raw data. The company must ensure that user groups can access only the PII that they require. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST effort?

A.text: Use Amazon Athena to query the data. Set up AWS Lake Formation and create data filters to establish levels of access for the company's IAM roles. Assign each user to the IAM role that matches the user's PII access requirements.

B.text: Use Amazon QuickSight to access the data. Use column-level security features in QuickSight to limit the PII that users can retrieve from Amazon S3 by using Amazon Athena. Define QuickSight access levels based on the PII access requirements of the users.

C.text: Build a custom query builder UI that will run Athena queries in the background to access the data. Create user groups in Amazon Cognito. Assign access levels to the user groups based on the PII access requirements of the users.

D.text: Create IAM roles that have different levels of granular access. Assign the IAM roles to IAM user groups. Use an identity-based policy to assign access levels to user groups at the column level.

zh_question: 一家公司將資料儲存在位於AmazonS3的資料湖中。该公司儲存在資料湖中的 部分資料包含個人識別資訊(PII)。多個使用者群組需要存取原始資料。該公司 必須確保使用者群組僅能存取其所需的PII。哪種解決方案能以最少的工作量符 合這些需求？

A.text: 使用AmazonAthena查詢資料。設定AWSLakeFormation並建立資料篩選器，為公司 的IAM角色設定存取層級。將每位使用者指派至符合其PII存取需求的IAM角色。

B.text: 使用AmazonQuickSight存取資料。利用QuickSight中的欄位層級安全功能 透過AmazonAthena限制使用者可從AmazonS3擷取的PII。根據使用者的PII存 取需求定義QuickSight存取層級。

C.text: 建置自訂查詢建構器介面，於背景執行Athena查詢以存取資料。在AmazonCognito中建 立使用者群組。根據使用者的PII存取需求，為使用者群組指派存取層級。

D.text: 建立具有不同細粒度存取層級的IAM角色。將這些IAM角色指派給IAM 使用者群組。使用基於身分的原則，為使用者群組指派欄位層級的存取層級。 等級。

en_question: A data engineer must build an extract, transform, and load (ETL) pipeline to process and load data from 10 source systems into 10 tables that are in an Amazon Redshift database. All the source systems generate .csv, JSON, or Apache Parquet files every 15 minutes. The source systems all deliver files into one Amazon S3 bucket. The file sizes range from 10 MB to 20 GB. The ETL pipeline must function correctly despite changes to the data schema. Which data pipeline solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

A.text: Use an Amazon EventBridge rule to run an AWS Glue job every 15 minutes. Configure the AWS Glue job to process and load the data into the Amazon Redshift tables.

B.text: Use an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke an AWS Glue workflow job every 15 minutes. Configure the AWS Glue workflow to have an on-demand trigger that runs an AWS Glue crawler and then runs an AWS Glue job when the crawler finishes running successfully. Configure the AWS Glue job to process and load the data into the Amazon Redshift tables.

C.text: Configure an AWS Lambda function to invoke an AWS Glue crawler when a file is loaded into the S3 bucket. Configure an AWS Glue job to process and load the data into the Amazon Redshift tables. Create a second Lambda function to run the AWS Glue job. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke the second Lambda function when the AWS Glue crawler finishes running successfully.

D.text: Configure an AWS Lambda function to invoke an AWS Glue workflow when a file is loaded into the S3 bucket. Configure the AWS Glue workflow to have an on-demand trigger that runs an AWS Glue crawler and then runs an AWS Glue job when the crawler finishes running successfully. Configure the AWS Glue job to process and load the data into the Amazon Redshift tables.

E.text: Configure an AWS Lambda function to invoke an AWS Glue job when a file is loaded into the S3 bucket. Configure the AWS Glue job to read the files from the S3 bucket into an Apache Spark DataFrame. Configure the AWS Glue job to also put smaller partitions of the DataFrame into an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream. Configure the delivery stream to load data into the Amazon Redshift tables.

zh_question: 資料工程師必須建置一個提取、轉換和載入(ETL)管線，以處理並將來自10個 來源系統的資料載入到位於AmazonRedshift資料庫中的10個資料表。所有 來源系統每15分鐘產生.csv、JSON或ApacheParquet檔案。這些來源系統 皆將檔案遞送至同一個AmazonS3儲存貯桶。檔案大小介於10MB至20GB 之間。即使資料綱目發生變更，此ETL管線也必須正常運作。哪些資料管線解 決方案符合這些需求？（請選擇兩項。）

A.text: 使用AmazonEventBridge規則每15分鐘執行一次AWSGlue工作。設定該AWSGlue工 作以處理資料並將其載入AmazonRedshift資料表中。

B.text: 使用AmazonEventBridge規則每15分鐘叫用一次AWSGlue工作流程工作。設定 該AWSGlue工作流程，使其具備隨需觸發程式，該觸發程式會先執行AWSGlue爬取程 式，待爬取程式成功執行完畢後，再執行AWSGlue工作。 設定該AWSGlue工作以處理資料並將其載入AmazonRedshift資料表中。

C.text: 設定AWSLambda函式，以便在檔案載入至S3儲存貯桶時觸發AWSGlue爬取器。設定 AWSGlue任務以處理並將資料載入AmazonRedshift資料表中。建立第二個Lambda函式 來執行AWSGlue任務。建立AmazonEventBridge規則，以便在AWSGlue爬取器成功執 行完畢時觸發第二個Lambda函式。

D.text: 設定AWSLambda函式，以便在檔案載入至S3儲存貯桶時觸發AWSGlue工作流程。設 定該AWSGlue工作流程具備隨需觸發器，使其先執行AWSGlue爬取器，並於爬取器成功 執行完畢後接著執行AWSGlue任務。設定此AWSGlue任務以處理並將資料載入 AmazonRedshift資料表中。

E.text: 設定AWSLambda函式，以便在檔案載入至S3儲存貯桶時觸發AWSGlue任務。設定 該AWSGlue任務將檔案從S3儲存貯桶讀取至ApacheSparkDataFrame。同時設定此 AWSGlue任務，將DataFrame中較小的分割區放入AmazonKinesisDataFirehose遞送串 流。設定該遞送串流以將資料載入AmazonRedshift資料表中。

en_question: A financial company wants to use Amazon Athena to run on-demand SQL queries on a petabyte-scale dataset to support a business intelligence (BI) application. An AWS Glue job that runs during non-business hours updates the dataset once every day. The BI application has a standard data refresh frequency of 1 hour to comply with company policies. A data engineer wants to cost optimize the company's use of Amazon Athena without adding any additional infrastructure costs. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Configure an Amazon S3 Lifecycle policy to move data to the S3 Glacier Deep Archive storage class after 1 day.

B.text: Use the query result reuse feature of Amazon Athena for the SQL queries.

C.text: Add an Amazon ElastiCache cluster between the BI application and Athena.

D.text: Change the format of the files that are in the dataset to Apache Parquet.

zh_question: 一家金融公司希望使用AmazonAthena對PB級資料集執行隨需SQL查 詢，以支援商業智慧（BI） 應用程式。一項在非營業時間執行的AWSGlue工作每天更新一次資料集。該 BI應用程式依據公司政策，標準資料重新整理頻率為每小時一次。 一位資料工程師希望在不增加任何額外基礎設施成本的情況下，最佳化公司使 用AmazonAthena的成本。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運 開銷？

A.text: 設定AmazonS3生命週期原則，將資料移至S3GlacierDeepArchive儲存層級 1天後的類別。

B.text: 對SQL查詢使用AmazonAthena的查詢結果重複使用功能。

C.text: 在BI應用 程式與Athena之間新增AmazonElastiCache叢集。

D.text: 將資料集中的檔案格式改為ApacheParquet。

en_question: A company's data engineer needs to optimize the performance of table SQL queries. The company stores data in an Amazon Redshift cluster. The data engineer cannot increase the size of the cluster because of budget constraints. The company stores the data in multiple tables and loads the data by using the EVEN distribution style. Some tables are hundreds of gigabytes in size. Other tables are less than 10 MB in size. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Keep using the EVEN distribution style for all tables. Specify primary and foreign keys for all tables.

B.text: Use the ALL distribution style for large tables. Specify primary and foreign keys for all tables.

C.text: Use the ALL distribution style for rarely updated small tables. Specify primary and foreign keys for all tables.

D.text: Specify a combination of distribution, sort, and partition keys for all tables.

zh_question: 某公司的資料工程師需要最佳化SQL查詢的表格效能。該公司將資料儲存在 AmazonRedshift叢集中。由於預算限制，資料工程師無法擴大叢集規模。该公 司將資料儲存在多個表格中，並使用EVEN分佈樣式來載入資料。部分表格的大 小達數百GB，而其他表格則小於10MB。 哪種解決方案能符合這些需求？

A.text: 對所有表格繼續使用EVEN分佈樣式。為所有 表格。

B.text: 對大型表格使用ALL分佈樣式。為所有表格指定主鍵和外鍵。

C.text: 對極少更新的小型資料表使用ALL分散式樣式。為所有資料表指定主鍵與外鍵。

D.text: 為所有資料表指定分散、排序與分割鍵的組合。

en_question: A company receives .csv files that contain physical address data. The data is in columns that have the following names: Door_No, Street_Name, City, and Zip_Code. The company wants to create a single column to store these values in the following format: Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST coding effort?

A.text: Use AWS Glue DataBrew to read the files. Use the NEST_TO_ARRAY transformation to create the new column.

B.text: Use AWS Glue DataBrew to read the files. Use the NEST_TO_MAP transformation to create the new column.

C.text: Use AWS Glue DataBrew to read the files. Use the PIVOT transformation to create the new column.

D.text: Write a Lambda function in Python to read the files. Use the Python data dictionary type to create the new column.

zh_question: 一家公司收到包含實體地址資料的.csv檔案。資料位於以下名稱的欄位中： Door_No、Street_Name、City和Zip_Code。該公司希望建立單一欄位，以以 下格式儲存這些值： 哪種解決方案能以最少的程式碼工作量滿足此需求？

A.text: 使用AWSGlueDataBrew讀取檔案。使用NEST_TO_ARRAY轉換來建立新欄位。

B.text: 使用AWSGlueDataBrew讀取檔案。使用NEST_TO_MAP轉換來建立新欄位。

C.text: 使用AWSGlueDataBrew讀取檔案。使用PIVOT轉換來建立新的 欄位。

D.text: 編寫一個PythonLambda函數來讀取檔案。使用Python資料字典類型來建立新的欄位。

en_question: A company receives call logs as Amazon S3 objects that contain sensitive customer information. The company must protect the S3 objects by using encryption. The company must also use encryption keys that only specific employees can access. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST effort?

A.text: Use an AWS CloudHSM cluster to store the encryption keys. Configure the process that writes to Amazon S3 to make calls to CloudHSM to encrypt and decrypt the objects. Deploy an IAM policy that restricts access to the CloudHSM cluster.

B.text: Use server-side encryption with customer-provided keys (SSE-

C.text: to encrypt the objects that contain customer information. Restrict access to the keys that encrypt the objects. C) Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) to encrypt the objects that contain customer information. Configure an IAM policy that restricts access to the KMS keys that encrypt the objects.

D.text: Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3) to encrypt the objects that contain customer information. Configure an IAM policy that restricts access to the Amazon S3 managed keys that encrypt the objects.

zh_question: 一家公司收到包含敏感客戶資訊的呼叫記錄，這些記錄以AmazonS3物件 的形式儲存。該公司必須使用加密來保護這些S3物件，並且必須使用僅特 定員工才能存取的加密金鑰。 哪種解決方案能以最小的努力滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用AWSCloudHSM叢集來儲存加密金鑰。設定寫入至AmazonS3的流程，使其呼叫 CloudHSM以對物件進行加密和解密。部署一個限制存取該雲硬體安全模組（CloudHSM）叢 集的IAM政策。

B.text: 使用帶有客戶提供金鑰的伺服器端加密(SSE‑

C.text: 來加密物件， 包含客戶資訊。限制對加密物件之金鑰的存取。 C)使用帶有AWSKMS金鑰的伺服器端加密(SSE‑KMS)來加密包含客戶資訊的物件。設定 一個IAM政策，限制對加密物件之KMS金鑰的存取。

D.text: 使用帶有AmazonS3託管金鑰的伺服器端加密(SSE‑S3)來加密包含客戶資訊的物件。 設定一個IAM政策，限制對加密物件之AmazonS3託管金鑰的存取。

en_question: A company stores petabytes of data in thousands of Amazon S3 buckets in the S3 Standard storage class. The data supports analytics workloads that have unpredictable and variable data access patterns. The company does not access some data for months. However, the company must be able to retrieve all data within milliseconds. The company needs to optimize S3 storage costs. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Use S3 Storage Lens standard metrics to determine when to move objects to more cost- optimized storage classes. Create S3 Lifecycle policies for the S3 buckets to move objects to cost-optimized storage classes. Continue to refine the S3 Lifecycle policies in the future to optimize storage costs.

B.text: Use S3 Storage Lens activity metrics to identify S3 buckets that the company accesses infrequently. Configure S3 Lifecycle rules to move objects from S3 Standard to the S3 Standard- Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) and S3 Glacier storage classes based on the age of the data.

C.text: Use S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Activate the Deep Archive Access tier.

D.text: Use S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Use the default access tier.

zh_question: 一家公司在數千個採用S3Standard儲存類別的AmazonS3儲存桶中儲存了 PB級的資料。這些資料支援具有不可預測且多變資料存取模式的分析工作負載。 該公司數個月不會存取部分資料，但必須能夠在毫秒內擷取所有資料。該公司 需要最佳化S3儲存成本。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用S3StorageLens標準指標來判斷何時應將物件移至更具成本效益的儲存類別。為 S3儲存桶建立S3生命週期原則，以將物件移至具成本效益的儲存類別。未來持續優化這些 S3生命週期原則，以進一步降低儲存成本。

B.text: 使用S3StorageLens活動指標來識別公司所存取的S3儲存桶 不頻繁地。設定S3生命週期規則，將物件從S3Standard移至S3Standard‑ 根據資料的存儲時間，使用不常存取（S3Standard‑IA）和S3Glacier存儲類別。

C.text: 使用S3Intelligent‑Tiering。啟用深層歸檔存取層級。

D.text: 使用S3Intelligent‑Tiering。使用預設存取層級。

en_question: During a security review, a company identified a vulnerability in an AWS Glue job. The company discovered that credentials to access an Amazon Redshift cluster were hard coded in the job script. A data engineer must remediate the security vulnerability in the AWS Glue job. The solution must securely store the credentials. Which combination of steps should the data engineer take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

A.text: Store the credentials in the AWS Glue job parameters.

B.text: Store the credentials in a configuration file that is in an Amazon S3 bucket.

C.text: Access the credentials from a configuration file that is in an Amazon S3 bucket by using the AWS Glue job.

D.text: Store the credentials in AWS Secrets Manager.

E.text: Grant the AWS Glue job IAM role access to the stored credentials.

zh_question: 在安全審查期間，公司發現AWSGlue腳本中存在一項弱點。公司發現存 取AmazonRedshift叢集的憑證被硬編碼在該腳本中。 資料工程師必須修補此AWSGlue腳本中的安全弱點。 解決方案必須安全地儲存憑證。 資料工程師應採取哪兩種步驟組合以符合這些需求？（請選擇兩項。）

A.text: 將憑證儲存在AWSGlue腳本參數中。

B.text: 將憑證儲存在位於AmazonS3儲存桶中的設定檔中。

C.text: 使用AWSGlue工作從位於AmazonS3儲存桶中的設定檔存取憑證。

D.text: 將憑證儲存在AWSSecretsManager中。

E.text: 授予AWSGlue工作IAM角色存取所儲存憑證的權限。

en_question: A data engineer uses Amazon Redshift to run resource-intensive analytics processes once every month. Every month, the data engineer creates a new Redshift provisioned cluster. The data engineer deletes the Redshift provisioned cluster after the analytics processes are complete every month. Before the data engineer deletes the cluster each month, the data engineer unloads backup data from the cluster to an Amazon S3 bucket. The data engineer needs a solution to run the monthly analytics processes that does not require the data engineer to manage the infrastructure manually. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Use Amazon Step Functions to pause the Redshift cluster when the analytics processes are complete and to resume the cluster to run new processes every month.

B.text: Use Amazon Redshift Serverless to automatically process the analytics workload.

C.text: Use the AWS CLI to automatically process the analytics workload.

D.text: Use AWS CloudFormation templates to automatically process the analytics workload.

zh_question: 資料工程師使用AmazonRedshift每月執行一次資源密集的分析流程。每個 月，資料工程師都會建立一個新的Redshift預置叢集。在每月的分析流程完 成後，資料工程師會刪除該Redshift預置叢集。在每月刪除叢集之前，資料 工程師會將備份資料從叢集卸載至AmazonS3儲存桶。 資料工程師需要一種解決方案來執行每月的分析流程，且無需手動管理基礎設施。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用AmazonStepFunctions在分析流程完成時暫停Redshift叢集，並於每月恢復叢集 以執行新流程。

B.text: 使用AmazonRedshiftServerless自動處理分析工作負載。

C.text: 使用AWSCLI自動處理分析工作負載。

D.text: 使用AWSCloudFormation範本自動處理分析工作負載。

en_question: A company receives a daily file that contains customer data in .xls format. The company stores the file in Amazon S3. The daily file is approximately 2 GB in size. A data engineer concatenates the column in the file that contains customer first names and the column that contains customer last names. The data engineer needs to determine the number of distinct customers in the file. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational effort?

A.text: Create and run an Apache Spark job in an AWS Glue notebook. Configure the job to read the S3 file and calculate the number of distinct customers.

B.text: Create an AWS Glue crawler to create an AWS Glue Data Catalog of the S3 file. Run SQL queries from Amazon Athena to calculate the number of distinct customers.

C.text: Create and run an Apache Spark job in Amazon EMR Serverless to calculate the number of distinct customers.

D.text: Use AWS Glue DataBrew to create a recipe that uses the COUNT_DISTINCT aggregate function to calculate the number of distinct customers.

zh_question: 一家公司每天收到一個包含客戶資料的.xls格式檔案。該公司將此檔案儲存於 AmazonS3中。每日檔案的大小約為2GB。 一位資料工程師將檔案中包含客戶名字的欄位與包含客戶姓氏的欄位進行串接。 該資料工程師需要確定檔案中不同客戶的數量。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運工作量滿足此需求？

A.text: 在AWSGlue筆記本中建立並執行ApacheSpark工作。設定該工作以讀取 S3檔案並計算不同客戶的數量。

B.text: 建立AWSGlue爬蟲程式，為S3檔案建立AWSGlue資料目錄。從Amazon Athena執行SQL查詢以計算不同客戶的數量。

C.text: 在AmazonEMRServerless中建立並執行ApacheSpark工作，以計算不同客戶的數量。

D.text: 使用AWSGlueDataBrew建立食譜，利用COUNT_DISTINCT聚合函數來計算 不同客戶的數量。

en_question: A healthcare company uses Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to stream real-time health data from wearable devices, hospital equipment, and patient records. A data engineer needs to find a solution to process the streaming data. The data engineer needs to store the data in an Amazon Redshift Serverless warehouse. The solution must support near real-time analytics of the streaming data and the previous day's data. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Load data into Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Load the data into Amazon Redshift.

B.text: Use the streaming ingestion feature of Amazon Redshift.

C.text: Load the data into Amazon S3. Use the COPY command to load the data into Amazon Redshift.

D.text: Use the Amazon Aurora zero-ETL integration with Amazon Redshift.

zh_question: 一家醫療保健公司使用AmazonKinesisDataStreams來串流來自可穿戴裝置、 醫院設備和病患記錄的即時健康資料。資料工程師需要尋找一種解決方案來處理這 些串流資料。該工程師需要將資料儲存至AmazonRedshiftServerless資料倉 儲中。此解決方案必須支援對串流資料及前一天資料進行近即時分析。 哪項解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 將資料載入至AmazonKinesisDataFirehose，再將資料載入至AmazonRedshift。

B.text: 使用AmazonRedshift的串流擷取功能。

C.text: 將資料載入至AmazonS3。使用COPY指令將資料載入至Amazon Redshift。

D.text: 使用AmazonAurora與AmazonRedshift之間的零ETL整合。

en_question: A data engineer needs to use an Amazon QuickSight dashboard that is based on Amazon Athena queries on data that is stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. When the data engineer connects to the QuickSight dashboard, the data engineer receives an error message that indicates insufficient permissions. Which factors could cause to the permissions-related errors? (Choose two.)

A.text: There is no connection between QuickSight and Athena.

B.text: The Athena tables are not cataloged.

C.text: QuickSight does not have access to the S3 bucket.

D.text: QuickSight does not have access to decrypt S3 data.

E.text: There is no IAM role assigned to QuickSight.

zh_question: 一名資料工程師需要使用基於AmazonAthena查詢的AmazonQuickSight儀 表板，該查詢針對儲存在AmazonS3儲存桶中的資料。當資料工程師連線至 QuickSight儀表板時，收到指出權限不足的錯誤訊息。哪些因素可能導致與權限 相關的錯誤？（請選擇兩項。）

A.text: QuickSight與Athena之間沒有連線。

B.text: Athena表格未編入目錄。

C.text: QuickSight無法存取S3儲存桶。

D.text: QuickSight無法解密S3資料。

E.text: 未指派任何IAM角色給QuickSight。

en_question: A company stores datasets in JSON format and .csv format in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company has Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server databases, Amazon DynamoDB tables that are in provisioned capacity mode, and an Amazon Redshift cluster. A data engineering team must develop a solution that will give data scientists the ability to query all data sources by using syntax similar to SQL. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Use AWS Glue to crawl the data sources. Store metadata in the AWS Glue Data Catalog. Use Amazon Athena to query the data. Use SQL for structured data sources. Use PartiQL for data that is stored in JSON format.

B.text: Use AWS Glue to crawl the data sources. Store metadata in the AWS Glue Data Catalog. Use Redshift Spectrum to query the data. Use SQL for structured data sources. Use PartiQL for data that is stored in JSON format.

C.text: Use AWS Glue to crawl the data sources. Store metadata in the AWS Glue Data Catalog. Use AWS Glue jobs to transform data that is in JSON format to Apache Parquet or .csv format. Store the transformed data in an S3 bucket. Use Amazon Athena to query the original and transformed data from the S3 bucket.

D.text: Use AWS Lake Formation to create a data lake. Use Lake Formation jobs to transform the data from all data sources to Apache Parquet format. Store the transformed data in an S3 bucket. Use Amazon Athena or Redshift Spectrum to query the data.

zh_question: 一家公司在AmazonS3儲存桶中以JSON格式和.csv格式儲存資料集。該公司 擁有用於MicrosoftSQLServer資料庫的AmazonRDS、處於預置容量模式的 AmazonDynamoDB資料表，以及一個AmazonRedshift叢集。資料工程團 隊必須開發一種解決方案，讓資料科學家能夠使用類似SQL的語法查詢所有資料 來源。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用AWSGlue爬取資料來源。將中繼資料儲存在AWSGlueDataCatalog中。使用 AmazonAthena查詢資料。對結構化資料來源使用SQL；對以JSON格式儲存的資料使用 PartiQL。

B.text: 使用AWSGlue爬取資料來源。將中繼資料儲存在AWSGlueDataCatalog中。使用 RedshiftSpectrum來查詢資料。對結構化資料來源使用SQL。對以JSON格式儲存的資 料使用PartiQL。

C.text: 使用AWSGlue爬取資料來源。將中繼資料儲存在AWSGlueDataCatalog中。使用 AWSGlue任務將JSON格式的資料轉換為ApacheParquet或.csv格式。將轉換後的資料儲 存在S3儲存桶中。使用AmazonAthena從S3儲存桶查詢原始和轉換後的資料。

D.text: 使用AWSLakeFormation建立資料湖。利用LakeFormation任務將所有資料來源的資料 轉換為ApacheParquet格式，並將轉換後的資料儲存於S3儲存桶中。 使用AmazonAthena或RedshiftSpectrum來查詢資料。

en_question: A data engineer is configuring Amazon SageMaker Studio to use AWS Glue interactive sessions to prepare data for machine learning (ML) models. The data engineer receives an access denied error when the data engineer tries to prepare the data by using SageMaker Studio. Which change should the engineer make to gain access to SageMaker Studio?

A.text: Add the AWSGlueServiceRole managed policy to the data engineer's IAM user.

B.text: Add a policy to the data engineer's IAM user that includes the sts:AssumeRole action for the AWS Glue and SageMaker service principals in the trust policy.

C.text: Add the AmazonSageMakerFullAccess managed policy to the data engineer's IAM user.

D.text: Add a policy to the data engineer's IAM user that allows the sts:AddAssociation action for the AWS Glue and SageMaker service principals in the trust policy.

zh_question: 資料工程師正在設定AmazonSageMakerStudio以使用AWSGlue 互動式工作階段來為機器學習(ML)模型準備資料。 當資料工程師嘗試使用SageMakerStudio準備資料時，收到存取拒絕錯誤。 工程師應進行哪項變更才能取得SageMakerStudio的存取權限？

A.text: 將AWSGlueServiceRole受管原則新增至資料工程師的IAM使用者。

B.text: 在資料工程師的IAM使用者新增一項政策，該政策於信任政策中包含針對AWSGlue和 SageMaker服務主體的sts:AssumeRole動作。

C.text: 將AmazonSageMakerFullAccess受管政策新增至資料工程師的IAM使用者。

D.text: 在資料工程師的IAM使用者新增一項政策，允許針對信任政策中AWSGlue和 SageMaker服務主體執行sts:AddAssociation動作。

en_question: A company extracts approximately 1 TB of data every day from data sources such as SAP HANA, Microsoft SQL Server, MongoDB, Apache Kafka, and Amazon DynamoDB. Some of the data sources have undefined data schemas or data schemas that change. A data engineer must implement a solution that can detect the schema for these data sources. The solution must extract, transform, and load the data to an Amazon S3 bucket. The company has a service level agreement (SLA) to load the data into the S3 bucket within 15 minutes of data creation. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Use Amazon EMR to detect the schema and to extract, transform, and load the data into the S3 bucket. Create a pipeline in Apache Spark.

B.text: Use AWS Glue to detect the schema and to extract, transform, and load the data into the S3 bucket. Create a pipeline in Apache Spark.

C.text: Create a PySpark program in AWS Lambda to extract, transform, and load the data into the S3 bucket.

D.text: Create a stored procedure in Amazon Redshift to detect the schema and to extract, transform, and load the data into a Redshift Spectrum table. Access the table from Amazon S3.

zh_question: 一家公司每天從SAPHANA、MicrosoftSQLServer、MongoDB、Apache Kafka和AmazonDynamoDB等資料來源提取約1TB的資料。部分資料來源 具有未定義的資料綱要，或其資料綱要會發生變動。 資料工程師必須實作一種解決方案，以偵測這些資料來源的綱要。該解決方案必 須將資料提取、轉換並載入至AmazonS3儲存貯體。該公司簽有服務層級協議 （SLA），規定必須在資料建立後15分鐘內將資料載入至S3儲存貯體。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用AmazonEMR來偵測綱要，並將資料提取、轉換並載入至S3儲存貯體。在Apache Spark中建立管道。

B.text: 使用AWSGlue偵測結構描述，並將資料提取、轉換及載入至S3儲存貯桶。在Apache Spark中建立管線。

C.text: 在AWSLambda中建立PySpark程式，以將資料提取、轉換及載入至S3 儲存桶。

D.text: 在AmazonRedshift中建立預存程序以偵測結構描述，並將資料擷取、轉換及載入至 RedshiftSpectrum資料表。從AmazonS3存取該資料表。

en_question: A company has multiple applications that use datasets that are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company has an ecommerce application that generates a dataset that contains personally identifiable information (PII). The company has an internal analytics application that does not require access to the PII. To comply with regulations, the company must not share PII unnecessarily. A data engineer needs to implement a solution that with redact PII dynamically, based on the needs of each application that accesses the dataset. Which solution will meet the requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Create an S3 bucket policy to limit the access each application has. Create multiple copies of the dataset. Give each dataset copy the appropriate level of redaction for the needs of the application that accesses the copy.

B.text: Create an S3 Object Lambda endpoint. Use the S3 Object Lambda endpoint to read data from the S3 bucket. Implement redaction logic within an S3 Object Lambda function to dynamically redact PII based on the needs of each application that accesses the data.

C.text: Use AWS Glue to transform the data for each application. Create multiple copies of the dataset. Give each dataset copy the appropriate level of redaction for the needs of the application that accesses the copy.

D.text: Create an API Gateway endpoint that has custom authorizers. Use the API Gateway endpoint to read data from the S3 bucket. Initiate a REST API call to dynamically redact PII based on the needs of each application that accesses the data.

zh_question: 一家公司擁有多個應用程式，這些應用程式使用儲存在AmazonS3儲存貯桶中 的資料集。該公司有一個電子商務應用程式，會產生包含個人識別資訊(PII)的 資料集。該公司還有一個內部分析應用程式，不需要存取PII。為了符合法規要 求，該公司不得非必要地共用PII。一名資料工程師需要實作一種解決方案，能 夠根據存取資料集的每個應用程式的需求，動態遮蔽PII。哪種解決方案能以最 低的營運開銷滿足這些需求？

A.text: 建立S3儲存貯存桶原則，以限制每個應用程式的存取權限。建立資料集的多個複本，並針對 存取該複本的應用程式需求，為每個資料集複本提供適當層級的去識別化處理。

B.text: 建立S3ObjectLambda端點。使用S3ObjectLambda端點從S3儲存貯桶讀取資料。 在S3ObjectLambda函數中實作遮蔽邏輯，以 根據存取資料的每個應用程式需求，動態遮蔽個人識別資訊（PII）。

C.text: 使用AWSGlue為每個應用程式轉換資料。建立多個資料集副本。針對存取該副本的 應用程式需求，為每個資料集副本提供適當層級的遮蔽。

D.text: 建立具有自訂授權器的APIGateway端點。使用該APIGateway端點從S3儲存桶讀 取資料。發起RESTAPI呼叫，以根據存取資料的每個應用程式需求，動態遮蔽個人識別資訊 （PII）。

en_question: A data engineer needs to build an extract, transform, and load (ETL) job. The ETL job will process daily incoming .csv files that users upload to an Amazon S3 bucket. The size of each S3 object is less than 100 MB. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

A.text: Write a custom Python application. Host the application on an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster.

B.text: Write a PySpark ETL script. Host the script on an Amazon EMR cluster.

C.text: Write an AWS Glue PySpark job. Use Apache Spark to transform the data.

D.text: Write an AWS Glue Python shell job. Use pandas to transform the data.

zh_question: 資料工程師需要建置一個提取、轉換和載入(ETL)工作。該ETL工作將處理使用 者上傳至AmazonS3儲存貯桶的每日傳入.csv檔案。每個S3物件的大小均小於 100MB。 哪種解決方案能以最具成本效益的方式滿足這些需求？

A.text: 撰寫自訂的Python應用程式。將該應用程式託管在AmazonElasticKubernetes Service(AmazonEKS)叢集上。

B.text: 撰寫PySparkETL腳本。將該腳本託管在AmazonEMR叢集上。

C.text: 建立AWSGluePySpark工作。使用ApacheSpark轉換資料。

D.text: 建立AWSGluePythonShell工作。使用pandas轉換資料。

en_question: A data engineer creates an AWS Glue Data Catalog table by using an AWS Glue crawler that is named Orders. The data engineer wants to add the following new partitions: s3://transactions/orders/order_date=2023-01-01 s3://transactions/orders/order_date=2023-01-02 The data engineer must edit the metadata to include the new partitions in the table without scanning all the folders and files in the location of the table. Which data definition language (DDL) statement should the data engineer use in Amazon Athena?

A.text: ALTER TABLE Orders ADD PARTITION(order_date=’2023-01-01’) LOCATION ‘s3://transactions/ orders/order_date=2023-01-01’; ALTER TABLE Orders ADD PARTITION(order_date=’2023-01-02’) LOCATION ‘s3://transactions/ orders/order_date=2023-01-02’;

B.text: MSCK REPAIR TABLE Orders;

C.text: REPAIR TABLE Orders;

D.text: ALTER TABLE Orders MODIFY PARTITION(order_date=’2023-01-01’) LOCATION ‘s3://transactions/ orders/2023-01-01’; ALTER TABLE Orders MODIFY PARTITION(order_date=’2023-01-02’) LOCATION ‘s3://transactions/ orders/2023-01-02’;

zh_question: 一名資料工程師使用名為Orders的AWSGlue爬蟲程式建立了AWSGlue資料 目錄表。該資料工程師想要新增以下新分割區： s3://transactions/orders/order_date=2023‑01‑01 s3://transactions/orders/order_date=2023‑01‑02 該資料工程師必須編輯中繼資料，將新分割區納入表中，而無需掃描該表位置中 的所有資料夾和檔案。 該資料工程師應在AmazonAthena中使用哪一個資料定義語言(DDL)陳述式？

A.text: ALTERTABLEOrdersADDPARTITION(order_date='2023‑01‑01')LOCATION 's3://transactions/orders/order_date=2023‑01‑01'; ALTERTABLEOrdersADDPARTITION(order_date='2023‑01‑02')LOCATION 's3://transactions/orders/order_date=2023‑01‑02'；

B.text: MSCK REPAIR TABLE Orders;

C.text: REPAIR TABLE Orders;

D.text: ALTERTABLEOrdersMODIFYPARTITION(order_date='2023‑01‑01')LOCATION 's3://transactions/orders/2023‑01‑01'； ALTERTABLEOrdersMODIFYPARTITION(order_date='2023‑01‑02')LOCATION 's3://transactions/orders/2023‑01‑02';

en_question: A company stores 10 to 15 TB of uncompressed .csv files in Amazon S3. The company is evaluating Amazon Athena as a one-time query engine. The company wants to transform the data to optimize query runtime and storage costs. Which file format and compression solution will meet these requirements for Athena queries?

A.text: .csv format compressed with zip

B.text: JSON format compressed with bzip2

C.text: Apache Parquet format compressed with Snappy

D.text: Apache Avro format compressed with LZO

zh_question: 一家公司在AmazonS3中儲存了10到15TB的未壓縮.csv檔案。該公司 正在評估將AmazonAthena作為一次性查詢引擎。 該公司希望轉換資料格式，以最佳化查詢執行時間和儲存成本。 哪種檔案格式和壓縮解決方案能滿足這些針對Athena查詢的需求？

A.text: 使用zip壓縮的.csv格式

B.text: 使用bzip2壓縮的JSON格式

C.text: 使用Snappy壓縮的ApacheParquet格式

D.text: 使用LZO壓縮的ApacheAvro格式

en_question: A company uses Apache Airflow to orchestrate the company's current on- premises data pipelines. The company runs SQL data quality check tasks as part of the pipelines. The company wants to migrate the pipelines to AWS and to use AWS managed services. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of refactoring?

A.text: Setup AWS Outposts in the AWS Region that is nearest to the location where the company uses Airflow. Migrate the servers into Outposts hosted Amazon EC2 instances. Update the pipelines to interact with the Outposts hosted EC2 instances instead of the on-premises pipelines.

B.text: Create a custom Amazon Machine Image (AMI) that contains the Airflow application and the code that the company needs to migrate. Use the custom AMI to deploy Amazon EC2 instances. Update the network connections to interact with the newly deployed EC2 instances.

C.text: Migrate the existing Airflow orchestration configuration into Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA). Create the data quality checks during the ingestion to validate the data quality by using SQL tasks in Airflow.

D.text: Convert the pipelines to AWS Step Functions workflows. Recreate the data quality checks in SQL as Python based AWS Lambda functions.

zh_question: 一家公司使用ApacheAirflow來協調該公司目前的內部部署資料管線。該公司將 SQL資料品質檢查任務作為管線的一部分執行。該公司希望將管線遷移至AWS， 並使用AWS託管服務。 哪項解決方案能以最少量的重構滿足這些需求？

A.text: 在公司使用Airflow的地點最近的AWS區域中設定AWSOutposts。將伺服器遷移至託 管於Outposts的AmazonEC2執行個體。更新管線以與託管於Outposts的EC2執行個體 互動，而非本地的管線。

B.text: 建立包含Airflow應用程式及公司需要遷移之程式碼的自訂Amazon機器映像(AMI)。使 用此自訂AMI部署AmazonEC2執行個體。更新網路連線以與新部署的EC2執行個體互動。

C.text: 將現有的Airflow編排設定遷移至AmazonManagedWorkflowsforApache Airflow(AmazonMWAA)。在資料匯入期間建立資料品質檢查，透過在Airflow中使用 SQL任務來驗證資料品質。

D.text: 將管線轉換為AWSStepFunctions工作流程。將以SQL撰寫的資料品質檢查重新建立為 基於Python的AWSLambda函式。

en_question: A company uses Amazon EMR as an extract, transform, and load (ETL) pipeline to transform data that comes from multiple sources. A data engineer must orchestrate the pipeline to maximize performance. Which AWS service will meet this requirement MOST cost effectively?

A.text: Amazon EventBridge

B.text: Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA)

C.text: AWS Step Functions

D.text: AWS Glue Workflows

zh_question: 一家公司使用AmazonEMR作為提取、轉換和載入(ETL)管線，以轉換來自 多個來源的資料。資料工程師必須協調該管線以最大化效能。 哪項AWS服務能以最具成本效益的方式滿足此需求？

A.text: AmazonEventBridge

B.text: AmazonManagedWorkflowsforApacheAirflow（AmazonMWAA）

C.text: AWSStepFunctions

D.text: AWSGlueWorkflows

en_question: An online retail company stores Application Load Balancer (ALB) access logs in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company wants to use Amazon Athena to query the logs to analyze traffic patterns. A data engineer creates an unpartitioned table in Athena. As the amount of the data gradually increases, the response time for queries also increases. The data engineer wants to improve the query performance in Athena. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

A.text: Create an AWS Glue job that determines the schema of all ALB access logs and writes the partition metadata to AWS Glue Data Catalog.

B.text: Create an AWS Glue crawler that includes a classifier that determines the schema of all ALB access logs and writes the partition metadata to AWS Glue Data Catalog.

C.text: Create an AWS Lambda function to transform all ALB access logs. Save the results to Amazon S3 in Apache Parquet format. Partition the metadata. Use Athena to query the transformed data.

D.text: Use Apache Hive to create bucketed tables. Use an AWS Lambda function to transform all ALB access logs.

zh_question: 一家線上零售公司將應用程式負載平衡器(ALB)存取記錄儲存在AmazonS3儲 存貯體中。該公司希望使用AmazonAthena來查詢這些記錄，以分析流量模式。 一名資料工程師在Athena中建立了一個未分割的表格。隨著資料量逐漸增加， 查詢的回應時間也隨之變長。該資料工程師希望提升Athena中的查詢效能。 哪項解決方案能以最小的營運工作量滿足這些需求？

A.text: 建立一個AWSGlue工作，用以判斷所有ALB存取日誌的結構描述，並將 分割區元資料寫入至AWSGlueDataCatalog。

B.text: 建立一個包含分類器的AWSGlue爬取程式，用以判斷所有ALB存取日誌的結構描述，並 將分割區元資料寫入至AWSGlueDataCatalog。

C.text: 建立AWSLambda函式以轉換所有ALB存取日誌。將結果以ApacheParquet格式儲存 至AmazonS3。對中繼資料進行分割。使用Athena查詢轉換後的資料。

D.text: 使用ApacheHive建立桶狀表格。使用AWSLambda函式轉換所有ALB存取日誌。

en_question: A company has a business intelligence platform on AWS. The company uses an AWS Storage Gateway Amazon S3 File Gateway to transfer files from the company's on-premises environment to an Amazon S3 bucket. A data engineer needs to setup a process that will automatically launch an AWS Glue workflow to run a series of AWS Glue jobs when each file transfer finishes successfully. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Determine when the file transfers usually finish based on previous successful file transfers. Set up an Amazon EventBridge scheduled event to initiate the AWS Glue jobs at that time of day.

B.text: Set up an Amazon EventBridge event that initiates the AWS Glue workflow after every successful S3 File Gateway file transfer event.

C.text: Set up an on-demand AWS Glue workflow so that the data engineer can start the AWS Glue workflow when each file transfer is complete.

D.text: Set up an AWS Lambda function that will invoke the AWS Glue Workflow. Set up an event for the creation of an S3 object as a trigger for the Lambda function.

zh_question: 一家公司在AWS上擁有商業智慧平台。該公司使用AWSStorageGateway的 AmazonS3FileGateway，將檔案從公司的內部部署環境傳輸至AmazonS3 儲存桶。 資料工程師需要設定一個流程，以便在每次檔案傳輸成功完成時，自動啟動 AWSGlue工作流程來執行一連串的AWSGlue任務。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 根據先前成功的檔案傳輸，判斷檔案傳輸通常完成的時間。 設定AmazonEventBridge排程事件，於該時段啟動AWSGlue任務。

B.text: 設定AmazonEventBridge事件，在每次S3FileGateway檔案傳輸事件成功後啟 動AWSGlue工作流程。

C.text: 設定一個隨需的AWSGlue工作流程，以便資料工程師在每個檔案傳輸完成時啟動該工作 流程。

D.text: 設定一個會叫用AWSGlue工作流程的AWSLambda函式。將S3物件的建立設定為 觸發該Lambda函式的事件。

en_question: A retail company uses Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL to process and store live transactional data. The company uses an Amazon Redshift cluster for a data warehouse. An extract, transform, and load (ETL) job runs every morning to update the Redshift cluster with new data from the PostgreSQL database. The company has grown rapidly and needs to cost optimize the Redshift cluster. A data engineer needs to create a solution to archive historical data. The data engineer must be able to run analytics queries that effectively combine data from live transactional data in PostgreSQL, current data in Redshift, and archived historical data. The solution must keep only the most recent 15 months of data in Amazon Redshift to reduce costs. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

A.text: Configure the Amazon Redshift Federated Query feature to query live transactional data that is in the PostgreSQL database.

B.text: Configure Amazon Redshift Spectrum to query live transactional data that is in the PostgreSQL database.

C.text: Schedule a monthly job to copy data that is older than 15 months to Amazon S3 by using the UNLOAD command. Delete the old data from the Redshift cluster. Configure Amazon Redshift Spectrum to access historical data in Amazon S3.

D.text: Schedule a monthly job to copy data that is older than 15 months to Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval by using the UNLOAD command. Delete the old data from the Redshift cluster. Configure Redshift Spectrum to access historical data from S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.

E.text: Create a materialized view in Amazon Redshift that combines live, current, and historical data from different sources.

zh_question: 一家零售公司使用AmazonAuroraPostgreSQL來處理和儲存即時交易資料。 該公司使用AmazonRedshift叢集作為資料倉儲。 每天早上會執行提取、轉換和載入(ETL)作業，將來自PostgreSQL資料庫的新 資料更新到Redshift叢集。該公司成長迅速，需要對Redshift叢集進行成本優 化。 資料工程師需要建立一個解決方案來歸檔歷史資料。該資料工程師必須能夠執行分 析查詢，有效結合來自PostgreSQL中的即時交易資料、Redshift中的目前資料 以及歸檔的歷史資料。該解決方案必須僅在AmazonRedshift中保留最近15個 月的資料，以降低成本。 哪兩個步驟的組合符合這些需求？（選擇兩項。）

A.text: 設定AmazonRedshift聯邦查詢功能，以查詢位於PostgreSQL資料庫中的即時交易資 料。

B.text: 設定AmazonRedshiftSpectrum以查詢位於 PostgreSQL資料庫。

C.text: 排程每月工作，使用UNLOAD指令將超過15個月的資料複製到AmazonS3。從 Redshift叢集中刪除舊資料。設定AmazonRedshiftSpectrum以存取位於AmazonS3的歷 史資料。

D.text: 排程每月工作，使用UNLOAD指令將超過15個月的資料複製到AmazonS3Glacier FlexibleRetrieval。從Redshift叢集中刪除舊資料。設定RedshiftSpectrum以存取來自 S3GlacierFlexibleRetrieval的歷史資料。

E.text: 在AmazonRedshift中建立實體化檢視表，整合來自不同來源的即時、目前與歷史資料。

en_question: A manufacturing company has many IoT devices in facilities around the world. The company uses Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to collect data from the devices. The data includes device ID, capture date, measurement type, measurement value, and facility ID. The company uses facility ID as the partition key. The company's operations team recently observed many WriteThroughputExceeded exceptions. The operations team found that some shards were heavily used but other shards were generally idle. How should the company resolve the issues that the operations team observed?

A.text: Change the partition key from facility ID to a randomly generated key.

B.text: Increase the number of shards.

C.text: Archive the data on the producer's side.

D.text: Change the partition key from facility ID to capture date.

zh_question: 一家製造公司在全球各地的設施中擁有許多物聯網裝置。該公司使用Amazon KinesisDataStreams從這些裝置收集資料。資料包含裝置ID、擷取日期、測量 類型、測量值和設施ID。該公司使用設施ID作為分割鍵。 該公司的營運團隊最近觀察到許多 WriteThroughputExceeded例外。營運團隊發現某些分片使用率極高，但 其他分片大致處於閒置狀態。 該公司應如何解決營運團隊所觀察到的問題？

A.text: 將分割鍵從設施ID改為隨機產生的金鑰。

B.text: 增加分片數量。

C.text: 在生產者端歸檔資料。

D.text: 將分割鍵從設施ID改為擷取日期。

en_question: A data engineer wants to improve the performance of SQL queries in Amazon Athena that run against a sales data table. The data engineer wants to understand the execution plan of a specific SQL statement. The data engineer also wants to see the computational cost of each operation in a SQL query. Which statement does the data engineer need to run to meet these requirements?

A.text: EXPLAIN SELECT * FROM sales;

B.text: EXPLAIN ANALYZE FROM sales;

C.text: EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM sales;

D.text: EXPLAIN FROM sales;

zh_question: 一位資料工程師希望提升在AmazonAthena中針對銷售資料表執行的SQL 查詢效能。 資料工程師想要了解特定SQL陳述式的執行計畫。該資料工程師也希望查看 SQL查詢中每個運算的計算成本。 資料工程師需要執行哪一個陳述式以符合這些需求？

A.text: EXPLAINSELECT*FROMsales;

B.text: EXPLAINANALYZEFROMsales;

C.text: EXPLAINANALYZESELECT*FROMsales;

D.text: EXPLAINFROMsales;

en_question: A company plans to provision a log delivery stream within a VPC. The company configured the VPC flow logs to publish to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. The company needs to send the flow logs to Splunk in near real time for further analysis. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Configure an Amazon Kinesis Data Streams data stream to use Splunk as the destination. Create a CloudWatch Logs subscription filter to send log events to the data stream.

B.text: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to use Splunk as the destination. Create a CloudWatch Logs subscription filter to send log events to the delivery stream.

C.text: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to use Splunk as the destination. Create an AWS Lambda function to send the flow logs from CloudWatch Logs to the delivery stream.

D.text: Configure an Amazon Kinesis Data Streams data stream to use Splunk as the destination. Create an AWS Lambda function to send the flow logs from CloudWatch Logs to the data stream.

zh_question: 一家公司計劃在VPC內設定日誌交付串流。該公司 已設定VPC流量記錄以發布至AmazonCloudWatchLogs。 該公司需要將流量記錄近乎即時地傳送至Splunk，以便進行進一步分析。 哪項解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 設定AmazonKinesisDataStreams資料串流，使用Splunk作為目的地。 建立CloudWatchLogs訂閱篩選器，將記錄事件傳送至該資料串流。

B.text: 建立AmazonKinesisDataFirehose遞送串流，將Splunk設為目的地。建立 CloudWatchLogs訂閱篩選器，將日誌事件傳送至該遞送串流。

C.text: 建立AmazonKinesisDataFirehose遞送串流，將Splunk設為目的地。建立AWS Lambda函數，將來自CloudWatchLogs的流量日誌傳送至該遞送串流。

D.text: 設定AmazonKinesisDataStreams資料串流，將Splunk設為目的地。建立AWS Lambda函數，將來自CloudWatchLogs的流量日誌傳送至該資料串流。

en_question: A company has a data lake on AWS. The data lake ingests sources of data from business units. The company uses Amazon Athena for queries. The storage layer is Amazon S3 with an AWS Glue Data Catalog as a metadata repository. The company wants to make the data available to data scientists and business analysts. However, the company first needs to manage fine-grained, column- level data access for Athena based on the user roles and responsibilities. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Set up AWS Lake Formation. Define security policy-based rules for the users and applications by IAM role in Lake Formation.

B.text: Define an IAM resource-based policy for AWS Glue tables. Attach the same policy to IAM user groups.

C.text: Define an IAM identity-based policy for AWS Glue tables. Attach the same policy to IAM roles. Associate the IAM roles with IAM groups that contain the users.

D.text: Create a resource share in AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) to grant access to IAM users.

zh_question: 一家公司在AWS上擁有資料湖。該資料湖匯入來自各業務單位的資料來源。该公 司使用AmazonAthena進行查詢。儲存層為AmazonS3，並使用AWSGlue DataCatalog作為程式碼儲存庫。 該公司希望讓資料科學家和業務分析師能夠使用這些資料。然而，公司首先需要 根據使用者的角色與職責，管理針對Athena的細粒度欄位層級資料存取權限。 哪項解決方案能符合這些需求？

A.text: 設定AWSLakeFormation。在LakeFormation中，透過IAM角色為使用 者和應用程式定義基於安全政策的規則。

B.text: 為AWSGlue資料表定義IAM資源型政策。將相同政策附加至IAM使用者群組。

C.text: 為AWSGlue資料表定義IAM身分型政策。將相同政策附加至IAM角色。將這些IAM角 色與包含使用者的IAM群組進行關聯。

D.text: 在AWSResourceAccessManager(AWSRAM)中建立資源共用，以授予IAM使用者 存取權限。

en_question: A company has developed several AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) jobs to validate and transform data from Amazon S3. The ETL jobs load the data into Amazon RDS for MySQL in batches once every day. The ETL jobs use a DynamicFrame to read the S3 data. The ETL jobs currently process all the data that is in the S3 bucket. However, the company wants the jobs to process only the daily incremental data. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST coding effort?

A.text: Create an ETL job that reads the S3 file status and logs the status in Amazon DynamoDB.

B.text: Enable job bookmarks for the ETL jobs to update the state after a run to keep track of previously processed data.

C.text: Enable job metrics for the ETL jobs to help keep track of processed objects in Amazon CloudWatch.

D.text: Configure the ETL jobs to delete processed objects from Amazon S3 after each run.

zh_question: 一家公司開發了數個AWSGlue提取、轉換和載入(ETL)作業，用以驗證並轉換 來自AmazonS3的資料。這些ETL作業每天批次將資料載入至AmazonRDS forMySQL一次。這些ETL作業使用DynamicFrame來讀取S3資料。 目前的ETL工作會處理S3儲存桶中的所有資料。然而，公司希望這些工作僅處 理每日的增量資料。 哪種解決方案能以最小的程式撰寫工作量滿足此需求？

A.text: 建立一個ETL工作，讀取S3檔案狀態並將狀態記錄在AmazonDynamoDB中。

B.text: 為ETL工作啟用工作書籤，以便在執行後更新狀態，以追蹤先前已處理的資料。

C.text: 為ETL工作啟用工作指標，以協助在AmazonCloudWatch中追蹤已處理的物件。

D.text: 設定ETL工作，在每次執行後從AmazonS3刪除已處理的物件。

en_question: An online retail company has an application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances that are in a VPC. The company wants to collect flow logs for the VPC and analyze network traffic. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

A.text: Publish flow logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use Amazon Athena for analytics.

B.text: Publish flow logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use an Amazon OpenSearch Service cluster for analytics.

C.text: Publish flow logs to Amazon S3 in text format. Use Amazon Athena for analytics.

D.text: Publish flow logs to Amazon S3 in Apache Parquet format. Use Amazon Athena for analytics.

zh_question: 一家線上零售公司擁有一個應用程式，該程式執行於位於VPC中的Amazon EC2執行個體上。该公司希望收集該VPC的流量日誌並分析網路流量。 哪項解決方案能以最具成本效益的方式滿足這些需求？

A.text: 將流量日誌發布至AmazonCloudWatchLogs。使用AmazonAthena進行分析。

B.text: 將流量日誌發布至AmazonCloudWatchLogs。使用AmazonOpenSearchService叢集 進行分析。

C.text: 將流量日誌以文字格式發布至AmazonS3。使用AmazonAthena進行分析。

D.text: 將流量日誌以ApacheParquet格式發布至AmazonS3。使用AmazonAthena進行分析。

en_question: A retail company stores transactions, store locations, and customer information tables in four reserved ra3.4xlarge Amazon Redshift cluster nodes. All three tables use even table distribution. The company updates the store location table only once or twice every few years. A data engineer notices that Redshift queues are slowing down because the whole store location table is constantly being broadcast to all four compute nodes for most queries. The data engineer wants to speed up the query performance by minimizing the broadcasting of the store location table. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST cost-effective way?

A.text: Change the distribution style of the store location table from EVEN distribution to ALL distribution.

B.text: Change the distribution style of the store location table to KEY distribution based on the column that has the highest dimension.

C.text: Add a join column named store_id into the sort key for all the tables.

D.text: Upgrade the Redshift reserved node to a larger instance size in the same instance family.

zh_question: 一家零售公司將交易、門市地點和客戶資訊表儲存在四個保留的ra3.4xlarge AmazonRedshift叢集節點中。所有三個表均使用均勻表分佈。 該公司每隔幾年僅更新一次或兩次門市位置資料表。 一位資料工程師注意到，由於大多數查詢都會將整個門市位置資料表廣播至所 有四個運算節點，導致Redshift佇列變慢。該資料工程師希望透過最小化門 市位置資料表的廣播來提升查詢效能。 哪種解決方案能以最具成本效益的方式滿足這些需求？

A.text: 將門市位置資料表的分佈樣式從均勻分佈（EVENdistribution）改為全部分佈（ ALLdistribution）。

B.text: 將門市位置資料表的分佈樣式改為基於具有最高維度之欄位的鍵值分佈（KEY distribution）。

C.text: 在所有資料表的排序鍵中，新增一個名為store_id的連接欄位。

D.text: 將Redshift保留節點升級為同一實例系列中較大的實例大小。

en_question: A company has a data warehouse that contains a table that is named Sales. The company stores the table in Amazon Redshift. The table includes a column that is named city_name. The company wants to query the table to find all rows that have a city_name that starts with "San" or "El". Which SQL query will meet this requirement?

A.text: Select * from Sales where city_name ~ ‘$(San|El)*’;

B.text: Select * from Sales where city_name ~ ‘^(San|El)*’;

C.text: Select * from Sales where city_name ~’$(San&El)*’;

D.text: Select * from Sales where city_name ~ ‘^(San&El)*’;

zh_question: 一家公司擁有一個資料倉儲，其中包含一個名為Sales的表格。該公司將此表格 儲存於AmazonRedshift中。該表格包含一個名為city_name的欄位。該公司 想要查詢此表格，以找出所有city_name以「San」或「El」開頭的列。 哪一個SQL查詢能符合此需求？

A.text: 從銷售資料表中選取所有欄位，其中城市_名稱~ '$(San|El)*'；

B.text: Select*fromSaleswherecity_name~ '^(San|El)*';

C.text: 從銷售資料表中選取所有欄位，其中城市_名稱~'$(San&El)*'；

D.text: 從銷售資料表中選擇所有欄位，其中城市_名稱~ '^(San&El)*'；

en_question: A company needs to send customer call data from its on-premises PostgreSQL database to AWS to generate near real-time insights. The solution must capture and load updates from operational data stores that run in the PostgreSQL database. The data changes continuously. A data engineer configures an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) ongoing replication task. The task reads changes in near real time from the PostgreSQL source database transaction logs for each table. The task then sends the data to an Amazon Redshift cluster for processing. The data engineer discovers latency issues during the change data capture (CDC) of the task. The data engineer thinks that the PostgreSQL source database is causing the high latency. Which solution will confirm that the PostgreSQL database is the source of the high latency?

A.text: Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor the DMS task. Examine the CDCIncomingChanges metric to identify delays in the CDC from the source database.

B.text: Verify that logical replication of the source database is configured in the postgresql.conf configuration file.

C.text: Enable Amazon CloudWatch Logs for the DMS endpoint of the source database. Check for error messages.

D.text: Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor the DMS task. Examine the CDCLatencySource metric to identify delays in the CDC from the source database.

zh_question: 一家公司需要將其內部部署的PostgreSQL資料庫中的客戶來電資料傳送至 AWS，以產生近乎即時的洞察。該解決方案必須捕捉並載入運作於 PostgreSQL資料庫中之營運資料儲存的更新。資料持續變動。 資料工程師設定了一項AWSDatabaseMigrationService(AWSDMS)持 續複製任務。該任務會從每個表格的PostgreSQL來源資料庫交易記錄中， 以近乎即時的方式讀取變更，隨後將資料傳送至AmazonRedshift叢集進 行處理。 資料工程師在任務的變更資料擷取(CDC)過程中發現延遲問題。該工程師認為 PostgreSQL來源資料庫是造成高延遲的原因。 哪種解決方案能確認PostgreSQL資料庫是高延遲的來源？

A.text: 使用AmazonCloudWatch監控DMS任務。檢查CDCIncomingChanges指標 以識別來自來源資料庫的CDC延遲。

B.text: 驗證來源資料庫的邏輯複製是否已在postgresql.conf設定檔案中設定。

C.text: 為來源資料庫的DMS端點啟用AmazonCloudWatchLogs。檢查錯誤訊息。
