B.text: 建立AWSDatabaseMigrationService(AWSDMS)完整載入工作。將Amazon Redshift設定為目標。設定工作以使用變更資料擷取(CD

C.text: 功能。 C)使用pg_dump公用程式產生PostgreSQL資料庫的備份。將備份上傳至Amazon S3儲存貯體。使用COPY指令將資料匯入至AmazonRedshift。

D.text: 建立AWSDatabaseMigrationService(AWSDMS)全量載入任務。將Amazon Redshift設定為目標。設定該任務每晚執行一次資料庫至AmazonRedshift的全量載入。

en_question: A company has several new datasets in CSV and JSON formats. A data engineer needs to make the data available to a team of data analysts who will analyze the data by using SQL queries. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST cost-effective way?

A.text: Create an Amazon RDS MySQL cluster. Use AWS Glue to transform and load the CSV and JSON files into database tables. Provide the data analysts access to the MySQL cluster.

B.text: Create an AWS Glue DataBrew project that contains the new data. Make the DataBrew project available to the data analysts.

C.text: Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use an AWS Glue crawler to catalog the S3 bucket as tables. Create an Amazon Athena workgroup that has a data usage threshold. Grant the data analysts access to the Athena workgroup.

D.text: Load the data into Super-fast, Parallel, In-memory Calculation Engine (SPIC

E.text: in Amazon QuickSight. Allow the data analysts to create analyses and dashboards in QuickSight.

zh_question: 某公司擁有數個以CSV和JSON格式儲存的新資料集。一名資料工程師需要讓 這些資料可供一組資料分析師使用，以便他們透過SQL查詢進行分析。 哪種解決方案能以最具成本效益的方式滿足這些需求？

A.text: 建立一個AmazonRDSMySQL叢集。使用AWSGlue將CSV和JSON檔案轉換並載入至 資料庫表中。提供資料分析師存取該MySQL叢集的權限。

B.text: 建立一個包含新資料的AWSGlueDataBrew專案。讓資料分析師可以使用該DataBrew專 案。

C.text: 將資料儲存於AmazonS3儲存貯體中。使用AWSGlue爬取程式將該S3儲存貯體編目為表。 建立一個具有資料使用量閾值的AmazonAthena工作群組。授予資料分析師存取該Athena工 作群組的權限。

D.text: 將資料載入至AmazonQuickSight中的超快速平行記憶體內計算引擎（SPICE）。允 許資料分析師在QuickSight中建立分析與儀表板。

en_question: A retail company stores order information in an Amazon Aurora table named Orders. The company needs to create operational reports from the Orders table with minimal latency. The Orders table contains billions of rows, and over 100,000 transactions can occur each second. A marketing team needs to join the Orders data with an Amazon Redshift table named Campaigns in the marketing team's data warehouse. The operational Aurora database must not be affected. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

A.text: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) Serverless to replicate the Orders table to Amazon Redshift. Create a materialized view in Amazon Redshift to join with the Campaigns table.

B.text: Use the Aurora zero-ETL integration with Amazon Redshift to replicate the Orders table. Create a materialized view in Amazon Redshift to join with the Campaigns table.

C.text: Use AWS Glue to replicate the Orders table to Amazon Redshift. Create a materialized view in Amazon Redshift to join with the Campaigns table.

D.text: Use federated queries to query the Orders table directly from Aurora. Create a materialized view in Amazon Redshift to join with the Campaigns table.

zh_question: 一家零售公司將訂單資訊儲存在名為Orders的AmazonAurora資料表中。該 公司需要從Orders資料表建立營運報表，並要求延遲時間最低。Orders資料表 包含數十億列資料，且每秒可發生超過100,000筆交易。 行銷團隊需要將訂單資料與行銷團隊資料倉儲中名為「Campaigns」的 AmazonRedshift資料表進行聯結。不得影響營運用的Aurora資料庫。 哪項解決方案能以最低的營運工作量滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用AWSDatabaseMigrationService(AWSDMS)Serverless將訂單資料表複製到 AmazonRedshift。在AmazonRedshift中建立實體化檢視以與「Campaigns」資料表進 行聯結。

B.text: 使用Aurorazero‑ETL整合功能與AmazonRedshift來複製訂單資料表。在 AmazonRedshift中建立實體化檢視以與「Campaigns」資料表進行聯結。

C.text: 使用AWSGlue將訂單資料表複製到AmazonRedshift。在AmazonRedshift中建立實體 化檢視以與「Campaigns」資料表進行聯結。

D.text: 使用聯合查詢直接從Aurora查詢Orders資料表。在AmazonRedshift中建立實體 化檢視以與Campaigns資料表進行聯結。

en_question: A company is building a new application that ingests CSV files into Amazon Redshift. The company has developed the frontend for the application. The files are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. Files are no larger than 5 MB. A data engineer is developing the extract, transform, and load (ETL) pipeline for the CSV files. The data engineer configured a Redshift cluster and an AWS Lambda function that copies the data out of the files into the Redshift cluster. Which additional steps should the data engineer perform to meet these requirements?

A.text: Configure the bucket to send S3 event notifications to Amazon EventBridge. Configure an EventBridge rule that matches S3 new object created events. Set the Lambda function as the target.

B.text: Configure the $3 bucket to send S3 event notifications to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure the Lambda function to process the queue.

C.text: Configure AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to stream new S3 objects to a data stream in Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Set the Lambda function as the target of the data stream.

D.text: Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule that matches S3 new object created events. Set an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as the target of the rule. Configure the Lambda function to process the queue.

zh_question: 一家公司正在建置一個新應用程式，該應用程式會將CSV檔案匯入 AmazonRedshift。該公司已開發出此應用程式的前端。 檔案儲存在AmazonS3儲存貯體中。每個檔案大小不超過5MB。 一名資料工程師正在開發用於處理CSV檔案的擷取、轉換與載入(ETL)管線。該 工程師已設定一個Redshift叢集，以及一個將檔案中的資料複製到Redshift叢 集的AWSLambda函式。 資料工程師應執行哪些額外步驟以符合這些需求？

A.text: 設定儲存貯體，使其將S3事件通知傳送至AmazonEventBridge。設定一個比對「新物 件建立」S3事件的EventBridge規則，並將Lambda函式設為目標。

B.text: 設定$3儲存貯體，使其將S3事件通知傳送至AmazonSimpleQueueService (AmazonSQS)佇列。設定Lambda函式以處理該佇列。

C.text: 設定AWSDatabaseMigrationService(AWSDMS)將新的S3物件串流至A mazonKinesisDataStreams中的資料串流。將Lambda函式設定為該資料串流的目標。

D.text: 設定AmazonEventBridge規則，以比對S3新物件建立事件。將Amazon SimpleQueueService(AmazonSQS)佇列設定為該規則的目標。設定Lambda函式以處 理該佇列。

en_question: A company stores sensitive data in an Amazon Redshift table. The company needs to give specific users the ability to access the sensitive data. The company must not create duplication in the data. Customer support users must be able to see the last four characters of the sensitive data. Audit users must be able to see the full value of the sensitive data. No other users can have the ability to access the sensitive information. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Create a dynamic data masking policy to allow access based on each user role. Create IAM roles that have specific access permissions. Attach the masking policy to the column that contains sensitive data.

B.text: Enable metadata security on the Redshift cluster. Create IAM users and IAM roles for the customer support users and the audit users. Grant the IAM users and IAM roles permissions to view the metadata in the Redshift cluster.

C.text: Create a row-level security policy to allow access based on each user role. Create IAM roles that have specific access permissions. Attach the security policy to the table.

D.text: Create an AWS Glue job to redact the sensitive data and to load the data into a new Redshift table.

zh_question: 一家公司將敏感資料儲存在AmazonRedshift資料表中。該公司需要讓特定 使用者能夠存取這些敏感資料，且不得產生資料重複。 客戶支援使用者必須能夠查看敏感資料的最後四個字元。稽核使用者必須能夠 查看敏感資料的完整值。其他任何使用者均不得具備存取敏感資訊的權限。 哪項解決方案符合這些需求？

A.text: 建立動態資料遮罩原則，以根據每個使用者角色允許存取。建立具有特定存取權限的IA M角色。將遮罩原則附加至包含敏感資料的欄位。

B.text: 在Redshift叢集上啟用中繼資料安全性。為客戶支援使用者和稽核使用者建立IAM使 用者和IAM角色。授予這些IAM使用者和IAM角色檢視Redshift叢集中繼資料的權限。

C.text: 建立列層級安全性原則，以根據每個使用者角色允許存取。建立具有特定存取權限的IA M角色。將安全性原則附加至資料表。

D.text: 建立一個AWSGlue工作，以修飾敏感資料並將資料載入新的Redshift資料表中。

en_question: A data engineer uses AWS Lake Formation to manage access to data that is stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. The data engineer configures an AWS Glue crawler to discover data at a specific file location in the bucket, s3:// examplepath. The crawler execution fails with the following error: “The S3 location: s3://examplepath is not registered.” The data engineer needs to resolve the error. Which solution will meet this requirement?

A.text: Attach an appropriate IAM policy to the IAM role of the AWS Glue crawler to grant the crawler permission to read the S3 location.

B.text: Register the S3 location in Lake Formation to allow the crawler to access the data.

C.text: Create a new AWS Glue database. Assign the correct permissions to the database for the crawler.

D.text: Configure the S3 bucket policy to allow cross-account access.

zh_question: 一名資料工程師使用AWSLakeFormation來管理儲存於AmazonS3儲 存貯桶中的資料存取權限。該資料工程師設定了一個AWSGlue爬取程式， 以發現在儲存貯桶中特定檔案位置（s3://examplepath）的資料。爬取程式 執行失敗，並出現以下錯誤：「S3位置：s3://examplepath尚未註冊。」 資料工程師需要解決此錯誤。 哪項解決方案能符合此需求？

A.text: 將適當的IAM政策附加至AWSGlue爬取程式的IAM角色，以授予爬取程式讀取S3位置 的權限。

B.text: 在LakeFormation中註冊S3位置，以允許爬取程式存取資料。

C.text: 建立新的AWSGlue資料庫。為爬取程式指派正確的資料庫權限。

D.text: 設定S3儲存貯桶原則以允許跨帳戶存取。

en_question: A company built a data lake and a data warehouse on AWS. The company wants to implement a data catalog to enhance the current data storage solutions. The company wants to have the capability to add business metadata and glossary information to the data catalog for every asset. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Use AWS Glue Catalog. Create a user table for the business glossary. Use the AWS Glue API to change table properties to add business metadata. Create a web application to access the metadata.

B.text: Use an Apache Hive metastore. Create a user table for the business glossary. Use the ALTER TABLE command to change table properties to add business metadata. Create a web application to access the metadata.

C.text: Use Amazon DataZone. Create the business glossaries. Create metadata forms. Use the Amazon DataZone data portal to access the metadata.

D.text: Use Amazon OpenSearch Service. Create an index for the business glossary. Create a second index for the business metadata. Use the OpenSearch Service dashboard to access the metadata.

zh_question: 一家公司在AWS上建立了資料湖和資料倉儲。該公司希望實作資料目錄，以強 化現有的資料儲存解決方案。該公司希望能為資料目錄中的每項資產新增業務中 繼資料和詞彙資訊。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用AWSGlueCatalog。建立業務詞彙的使用者表格。使用AWSGlueAPI變更表格屬性 以新增業務中繼資料。建立Web應用程式以存取中繼資料。

B.text: 使用ApacheHive中繼儲存庫。建立業務詞彙的使用者表格。使用ALTERTABLE指令 變更表格屬性以新增業務中繼資料。建立Web應用程式以存取中繼資料。

C.text: 使用AmazonDataZone。建立業務詞彙。建立中繼資料表單。使用Amazon DataZone資料入口網站存取中繼資料。

D.text: 使用AmazonOpenSearchService。為業務詞彙建立索引。為業務中繼資料建立第二個索 引。使用OpenSearchService儀表板存取中繼資料。

en_question: A data engineer is using an AWS Glue ETL job to remove outdated customer records from a table that contains customer account information. The data engineer is using the following SQL command to remove customers that exist in a table named monthly_accounts_update table from the customer accounts table: MERGE INTO accounts t USING monthly_accounts_update s ON t.customer = s.customer - WHEN MATCHED - THEN DELETE - What will happen when the data engineer runs the SQL command?

A.text: All customer records that exist in both the customer accounts table and the monthly_accounts_update table will be deleted from the accounts table.

B.text: Only customer records that are present in both tables will be retained in the customer accounts table.

C.text: The monthly_accounts_update table will be deleted.

D.text: No records will be deleted because the command syntax is not valid in AWS Glue.

zh_question: 一名資料工程師正在使用AWSGlueETL工作，從包含客戶帳戶資訊的表中移除 過時的客戶記錄。該資料工程師使用以下SQL指令，從客戶帳戶表中移除存在於 名為monthly_accounts_update的表中的客戶： MERGEINTOaccountstUSINGmonthly_accounts_updates ONt.customer= s.customer‑ WHENMATCHED‑ THENDELETE‑ 當資料工程師執行此SQL指令時，會發生什麼情況？

A.text: 所有同時存在於客戶帳戶表與 每月_帳戶_更新表中的客戶記錄，將從帳戶表中刪除。

B.text: 僅保留同時存在於兩張表中的客戶記錄於客戶 帳戶表中。

C.text: 每月_帳戶_更新表將被刪除。

D.text: 不會刪除任何記錄，因為該命令語法在AWSGlue中無效。

en_question: A company receives marketing campaign data from a vendor. The company ingests the data into an Amazon S3 bucket every 40 to 60 minutes. The data is in CSV format. File sizes are between 100 KB and 300 KB. A data engineer needs to set-up an extract, transform, and load (ETL) pipeline to upload the content of each file to Amazon Redshift. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Create an AWS Lambda function that connects to Amazon Redshift and runs a COPY command. Use Amazon EventBridge to invoke the Lambda function based on an Amazon S3 upload trigger.

B.text: Create an Amazon Data Firehose stream. Configure the stream to use an AWS Lambda function as a source to pull data from the S3 bucket. Set Amazon Redshift as the destination.

C.text: Use Amazon Redshift Spectrum to query the S3 bucket. Configure an AWS Glue Crawler for the S3 bucket to update metadata in an AWS Glue Data Catalog.

D.text: Creates an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) task. Specify an appropriate data schema to migrate. Specify the appropriate type of migration to use.

zh_question: 一家公司從供應商處接收行銷活動資料。該公司每40至60分鐘將資料匯入一 次AmazonS3儲存桶。資料為CSV格式，檔案大小介於100KB至300KB之 間。 資料工程師需要設定提取、轉換和載入(ETL)管線，將每個檔案的內容上傳至 AmazonRedshift。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運開銷滿足這些需求？

A.text: 建立一個AWSLambda函式以連線至AmazonRedshift並執行COPY 指令。使用AmazonEventBridge根據AmazonS3觸發Lambda函式。 上傳觸發程序。

B.text: 建立一個AmazonDataFirehose串流。設定該串流使用AWSLambda 函式作為來源，從S3儲存桶提取資料。將目標設定為AmazonRedshift。

C.text: 使用AmazonRedshiftSpectrum查詢S3儲存桶。設定一個針對該儲存桶的AWSGlue Crawler，以更新AWSGlueDataCatalog中的中繼資料。

D.text: 建立一個資料庫遷移服務(AWSDMS)任務。指定適當的資料結構描述以進行遷移。指 定要使用的遷移類型。

en_question: A company wants to build a dimension table in an Amazon S3 bucket. The bucket contains historical data that includes 10 million records. The historical data is 1 TB in size. A data engineer needs a solution to update changes for up to 10,000 records in the base table every day. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LOWEST runtime?

A.text: Develop an Apache Spark job in Amazon EMR to read the historical data and the new changes into two Spark DataFrames. Use the Spark update method to update the base table.

B.text: Develop an AWS Glue Python job to read the historical data and new changes into two Pandas DataFrames. Use the Pandas update method to update the base table.

C.text: Develop an AWS Glue Apache Spark job to read the historical data and new changes into two Spark DataFrames. Use the Spark update method to update the base table.

D.text: Develop an Amazon EMR job to read new changes into Apache Spark DataFrames. Use the Apache Hudi framework to create the base table in Amazon S3. Use the Spark update method to update the base table.

zh_question: 一家公司想要在AmazonS3儲存桶中建置維度表。該儲存桶包含歷史資料，其 中有1,000萬筆記錄，總大小為1TB。 資料工程師需要一種解決方案，每天更新基本表中最多10,000筆記錄的變更。 哪種解決方案能以最低的執行時間滿足此需求？

A.text: 在AmazonEMR中開發ApacheSpark工作，將歷史資料與新的 變更讀取至兩個SparkDataFrame中。使用Spark的update方法來更新基本表。

B.text: 開發AWSGluePython工作，將歷史資料與新的變更讀取至兩個 PandasDataFrames。使用Pandasupdate方法來更新基礎表。

C.text: 開發一個AWSGlueApacheSpark作業，將歷史資料和新變更讀取到兩個Spark DataFrames中。使用Sparkupdate方法來更新基礎表。

D.text: 開發一個AmazonEMR作業，將新變更讀取到ApacheSparkDataFrames中。使用 ApacheHudi框架在AmazonS3中建立基礎表。使用Sparkupdate方法 來更新基礎表。

en_question: A data engineer develops an AWS Glue Apache Spark ETL job to perform transformations on a dataset. When the data engineer runs the job, the job returns an error that reads, “No space left on device.” The data engineer needs to identify the source of the error and provide a solution. Which combinations of steps will meet this requirement MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two.)

A.text: Scale out the workers vertically to address data skewness.

B.text: Use the Spark UI and AWS Glue metrics to monitor data skew in the Spark executors.

C.text: Scale out the number of workers horizontally to address data skewness.

D.text: Enable the --write-shuffie-files-to-s3 job parameter. Use the salting technique.

E.text: Use error logs in Amazon CloudWatch to monitor data skew.

zh_question: 一名資料工程師開發了一個AWSGlueApacheSparkETL作業，以對資料 集執行轉換。當該工程師執行此作業時，作業回傳錯誤訊息：「裝置上沒有 剩餘空間。」 資料工程師需要識別錯誤來源並提供解決方案。 哪些步驟組合能以最具成本效益的方式滿足此需求？（請選擇兩項。）

A.text: 垂直擴展工作節點以解決資料傾斜問題。

B.text: 使用SparkUI和AWSGlue指標來監控Spark執行器中的資料傾斜情況。

C.text: 水平擴展工作節點數量以解決資料傾斜問題。

D.text: 啟用‑‑write‑shuffie‑files‑to‑s3工作參數。使用加鹽技術。

E.text: 使用AmazonCloudWatch中的錯誤日誌來監控資料傾斜。

en_question: A company has a data pipeline that uses an Amazon RDS instance, AWS Glue jobs, and an Amazon S3 bucket. The RDS instance and AWS Glue jobs run in a private subnet of a VPC and in the same security group. A user made a change to the security group that prevents the AWS Glue jobs from connecting to the RDS instance. After the change, the security group contains a single rule that allows inbound SSH traffic from a specific IP address. The company must resolve the connectivity issue. Which solution will meet this requirement?

A.text: Add an inbound rule that allows all TCP traffic on all TCP ports. Set the security group as the source.

B.text: Add an inbound rule that allows all TCP traffic on all UDP ports. Set the private IP address of the RDS instance as the source.

C.text: Add an inbound rule that allows all TCP traffic on all TCP ports. Set the DNS name of the RDS instance as the source.

D.text: Replace the source of the existing SSH rule with the private IP address of the RDS instance. Create an outbound rule with the same source, destination, and protocol as the inbound SSH rule.

zh_question: 某公司擁有一個資料管線，該管線使用AmazonRDS執行個體、AWSGlue 工作以及AmazonS3儲存貯桶。RDS執行個體與AWSGlue工作運行於 VPC的私人子網中，且位於同一個安全群組內。 使用者對安全群組進行了變更，導致AWSGlue工作無法連線至RDS執行個體。 變更後，該安全群組僅包含一條規則，允許來自特定IP位址的入站SSH流量。 公司必須解決此連線問題。 哪項解決方案能符合此需求？

A.text: 新增一條入站規則，允許所有TCP連接埠上的所有TCP流量。將安全群組設定為來源。

B.text: 新增一條入站規則，允許所有UDP連接埠上的所有TCP流量。將RDS執行個體的私有 IP位址設定為來源。

C.text: 新增一條入站規則，允許所有TCP連接埠上的所有TCP流量。將RDS執行個體的DNS名 稱設定為來源。

D.text: 將現有SSH規則的來源替換為RDS執行個體的私人IP位址。 建立一條出站規則，其來源、目的地和通訊協定與入站SSH規則相同。

en_question: A company builds a new data pipeline to process data for business intelligence reports. Users have noticed that data is missing from the reports. A data engineer needs to add a data quality check for columns that contain null values and for referential integrity at a stage before the data is added to storage. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Use Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler to create a Data Quality and Insights report.

B.text: Use AWS Glue ETL jobs to perform a data quality evaluation transform on the data. Use an IsComplete rule on the requested columns. Use a ReferentialItegrity rule for each join.

C.text: Use AWS Glue ETL jobs to perform a SQL transform on the data to determine whether requested column contain null values. Use a second SQL transform to check referential integrity.

D.text: Use Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler and a custom Python transform to create custom rules to check for null values and referential integrity.

zh_question: 一家公司建置了一条新的資料管線，用於處理商業智慧報告的資料。使用者發現 報告中缺少了部分資料。 資料工程師需要在資料存入儲存區之前的階段，針對包含空值的欄位以及參考完 整性新增資料品質檢查。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用AmazonSageMakerDataWrangler建立資料品質與洞察報告。

B.text: 使用AWSGlueETL工作對資料執行資料品質評估轉換。對要求的欄位使用I sComplete規則。對每個聯結使用ReferentialIntegrity規則。

C.text: 使用AWSGlueETL工作對資料執行SQL轉換，以判斷 所需的欄位是否包含空值。使用第二個SQL轉換來檢查參考完整性。

D.text: 使用AmazonSageMakerDataWrangler和自訂的Python轉換來建立自訂規則，以 檢查空值和參考完整性。

en_question: A company is setting up a data pipeline in AWS. The pipeline extracts client data from Amazon S3 buckets, performs quality checks, and transforms the data. The pipeline stores the processed data in a relational database. The company will use the processed data for future queries. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

A.text: Use AWS Glue ETL to extract the data from the S3 buckets and perform the transformations. Use AWS Glue Data Quality to enforce suggested quality rules. Load the data and the quality check results into an Amazon RDS for MySQL instance.

B.text: Use AWS Glue Studio to extract the data from the S3 buckets. Use AWS Glue DataBrew to perform the transformations and quality checks. Load the processed data into an Amazon RDS for MySQL instance. Load the quality check results into a new S3 bucket.

C.text: Use AWS Glue ETL to extract the data from the S3 buckets and perform the transformations. Use AWS Glue DataBrew to perform quality checks. Load the processed data and the quality check results into a new S3 bucket.

D.text: Use AWS Glue Studio to extract the data from the S3 buckets. Use AWS Glue DataBrew to perform the transformations and quality checks. Load the processed data and quality check results into an Amazon RDS for MySQL instance.

zh_question: 一家公司正在AWS中設定資料管線。該管線從AmazonS3儲存桶擷取客戶資料、 執行品質檢查，並轉換資料。管線將處理後的資料儲存至關聯式資料庫。该公司將 使用處理後的資料進行未來查詢。 哪項解決方案能以最具成本效益的方式滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用AWSGlueETL從S3儲存桶提取資料並執行轉換。使用AWSGlueDataQuality強 制執行建議的品質規則。將資料和品質檢查結果載入至AmazonRDSforMySQL執行個體。

B.text: 使用AWSGlueStudio從S3儲存桶提取資料。使用AWSGlueDataBrew執行轉換和品 質檢查。將處理後的資料載入至AmazonRDSforMySQL執行個體。將品質檢查結果載入至 新的S3儲存桶。

C.text: 使用AWSGlueETL從S3儲存桶提取資料並執行轉換。使用AWSGlueDataBrew執行 品質檢查。將處理後的資料和品質檢查結果載入至新的S3儲存桶。

D.text: 使用AWSGlueStudio從S3儲存桶提取資料。使用AWSGlueDataBrew執行轉換和 品質檢查。將處理後的資料和品質檢查結果載入至AmazonRDSforMySQL執行個體。

en_question: A company uses Amazon Redshift as a data warehouse solution. One of the datasets that the company stores in Amazon Redshift contains data for a vendor. Recently, the vendor asked the company to transfer the vendor’s data into the vendor’s Amazon S3 bucket once each week. Which solution will meet this requirement?

A.text: Create an AWS Lambda function to connect to the Redshift data warehouse. Configure the Lambda function to use the Redshift COPY command to copy the required data to the vendor’s S3 bucket on a schedule.

B.text: Create an AWS Glue job to connect to the Redshift data warehouse. Configure the AWS Glue job to use the Redshift UNLOAD command to load the required data to the vendor’s S3 bucket on a schedule.

C.text: Use the Amazon Redshift data sharing feature. Set the vendor’s S3 bucket as the destination. Configure the source to be as a custom SQL query that selects the required data.

D.text: Configure Amazon Redshift Spectrum to use the vendor’s S3 bucket a destination, Enable data querying in both directions.

zh_question: 一家公司使用AmazonRedshift作為資料倉儲解決方案。該公司在 AmazonRedshift中儲存的一個資料集包含某供應商的資料。 最近，供應商要求公司每週將供應商的資料傳輸一次至供應商的A mazonS3儲存貯桶。 哪項解決方案能符合此需求？

A.text: 建立一個AWSLambda函數以連線至Redshift資料倉儲。設定該Lambda函數，使其排 程使用RedshiftCOPY指令將所需資料複製到供應商的S3儲存貯桶。

B.text: 建立一個AWSGlue工作以連線至Redshift資料倉儲。設定該AWSGlue工作，使其 排程使用RedshiftUNLOAD指令將所需資料載入到供應商的S3儲存貯桶。

C.text: 使用AmazonRedshift資料共用功能。將供應商的S3儲存貯桶設定為目的地。 將來源設定為自訂的SQL查詢，以選取所需的資料。

D.text: 設定Amazon使用供應商的S3儲存貯桶作為目的地，並啟用雙向資料查詢功能。

en_question: A company uses an Amazon Redshift cluster as a data warehouse that is shared across two departments. To comply with a security policy, each department must have unique access permissions. Department A must have access to tables and views for Department A. Department B must have access to tables and views for Department B. The company often runs SQL queries that use objects from both departments in one query. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Group tables and views for each department into dedicated schemas. Manage permissions at the schema level.

B.text: Group tables and views for each department into dedicated databases. Manage permissions at the database level.

C.text: Update the names of the tables and views to follow a naming convention that contains the department names. Manage permissions based on the new naming convention.

D.text: Create an IAM user group for each department. Use identity-based IAM policies to grant table and view permissions based on the IAM user group.

zh_question: 一家公司使用AmazonRedshift叢集作為資料倉儲，由兩個部門共用。為符合 安全政策，每個部門必須擁有獨立的存取權限。 A部門必須能夠存取該部門的資料表和檢視表。B部門必須能夠存取該 部門的資料表和檢視表。 该公司經常執行SQL查詢，這些查詢會在單一查詢中使用來自兩個部門的物件。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 將每個部門的資料表和檢視表歸組到專用的結構描述中。在結構描述層級管理權限。

B.text: 將每個部門的資料表和檢視表歸組到專用的資料庫中。在資料庫層級管理權限。

C.text: 更新資料表和檢視表的名稱，以遵循包含部門名稱的命名慣例。根據新的命名慣例管理權限。

D.text: 為每個部門建立一個IAM使用者群組。使用基於身分的IAM政策，根據IAM使用者群組授 予資料表和檢視表的權限。

en_question: A company wants to ingest streaming data into an Amazon Redshift data warehouse from an Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK) cluster. A data engineer needs to develop a solution that provides low data access time and that optimizes storage costs. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Create an external schema that maps to the MSK cluster. Create a materialized view that references the external schema to consume the streaming data from the MSK topic.

B.text: Develop an AWS Glue streaming extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to process the incoming data from Amazon MSK. Load the data into Amazon S3. Use Amazon Redshift Spectrum to read the data from Amazon S3.

C.text: Create an external schema that maps to the streaming data source. Create a new Amazon Redshift table that references the external schema.

D.text: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Ingest the data from Amazon MSK. Create an event-driven AWS Lambda function to load the data from the S3 bucket to a new Amazon Redshift table.

zh_question: 一家公司希望將串流資料從AmazonManagedStreamingforApacheKafka (AmazonMSK)叢集匯入至AmazonRedshift資料倉儲。資料工程師需要開發 一項解決方案，以提供低延遲的資料存取時間，並最佳化儲存成本。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 建立對應至MSK叢集的外部結構描述。建立參考該外部結構描述的實體化檢視，以使用來 自MSK主題的串流資料。

B.text: 開發AWSGlue串流提取、轉換與載入(ETL)工作來處理 來自AmazonMSK的傳入資料。將資料載入至AmazonS3。使用AmazonRedshift Spectrum從AmazonS3讀取資料。

C.text: 建立對應至串流資料來源的外部結構描述。建立參考該外部結構描述的新Amazon Redshift資料表。

D.text: 建立一個AmazonS3儲存貯桶。從AmazonMSK匯入資料。建立一個事件驅動的A WSLambda函數，將資料從S3儲存貯桶載入至新的AmazonRedshift資料表。

en_question: A sales company uses AWS Glue ETL to collect, process, and ingest data into an Amazon S3 bucket. The AWS Glue pipeline creates a new file in the S3 bucket every hour. File sizes vary from 200 KB to 300 KB. The company wants to build a sales prediction model by using data from the previous 5 years. The historic data includes 44,000 files. The company builds a second AWS Glue ETL pipeline by using the smallest worker type. The second pipeline retrieves the historic files from the S3 bucket and processes the files for downstream analysis. The company notices significant performance issues with the second ETL pipeline. The company needs to improve the performance of the second pipeline. Which solution will meet this requirement MOST cost-effectively?

A.text: Use a larger worker type.

B.text: Increase the number of workers in the AWS Glue ETL jobs.

C.text: Use the AWS Glue DynamicFrame grouping option.

D.text: Enable AWS Glue auto scaling.

zh_question: 一家銷售公司使用AWSGlueETL來收集、處理並將資料匯入AmazonS3儲存 桶。該AWSGlue管線每小時會在S3儲存桶中建立一個新檔案，檔案大小介於 200KB至300KB之間。该公司希望利用過去5年的資料建置銷售預測模型，歷 史資料共包含44,000個檔案。 該公司使用最小的worker類型建置了第二個AWSGlueETL管線。第二個管 線從S3儲存桶擷取歷史檔案，並處理這些檔案以供下游分析。該公司發現第二 個ETL管線存在嚴重的效能問題。 該公司需要改善第二個管線的效能。 哪項解決方案能以最具成本效益的方式滿足此需求？

A.text: 使用較大的worker類型。

B.text: 增加AWSGlueETL作業中的worker數量。

C.text: 使用AWSGlueDynamicFrame分組選項。

D.text: 啟用AWSGlue自動擴展。

en_question: A company wants to combine data from multiple software as a service (SaaS) applications for analysis. A data engineering team needs to use Amazon QuickSight to perform the analysis and build dashboards. A data engineer needs to extract the data from the SaaS applications and make the data available for QuickSight queries. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

A.text: Create AWS Lambda functions that call the required APIs to extract the data from the applications. Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use AWS Glue to catalog the data in the S3 bucket. Create a data source and a dataset in QuickSight.

B.text: Use AWS Lambda functions as Amazon Athena data source connectors to run federated queries against the SaaS applications. Create an Athena data source and a dataset in QuickSight.

C.text: Use Amazon AppFlow to create a flow for each SaaS application. Set an Amazon S3 bucket as the destination. Schedule the flows to extract the data to the bucket. Use AWS Glue to catalog the data in the S3 bucket. Create a data source and a dataset in QuickSight.

D.text: Export data the from the SaaS applications as Microsoft Excel files. Create a data source and a dataset in QuickSight by uploading the Excel files.

zh_question: 一家公司希望整合來自多個軟體即服務(SaaS)應用程式的數據以進行分析。 資料工程團隊需要使用AmazonQuickSight進行分析並建置儀表板。資料工程 師需要從SaaS應用程式中提取資料，並讓這些資料可供QuickSight查詢。 哪種解決方案能以最符合營運效率的方式滿足這些需求？

A.text: 建立AWSLambda函式來呼叫所需的API，以從 應用程式中提取資料。將資料儲存在AmazonS3儲存貯體中。使用AWSGlue將S3 儲存貯體中的資料編目。在QuickSight中建立資料來源和資料集。

B.text: 使用AWSLambda函數作為AmazonAthena資料來源連接器，以執行聯邦式 查詢，針對SaaS應用程式進行。在QuickSight中建立Athena資料來源和資料集。

C.text: 使用AmazonAppFlow為每個SaaS應用程式建立流程。將AmazonS3儲存桶設定為 目的地。排程這些流程以將資料擷取至該儲存桶。使用AWSGlue將S3儲存桶中的資料編目。 在QuickSight中建立資料來源和資料集。

D.text: 從SaaS應用程式匯出資料為MicrosoftExcel檔案。透過上傳Excel檔案，在 QuickSight中建立資料來源和資料集。

en_question: A company runs multiple applications on AWS. The company configured each application to output logs. The company wants to query and visualize the application logs in near real time. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Configure the applications to output logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs log groups. Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Create an AWS Lambda function that runs on a schedule to export the required log groups to the S3 bucket. Use Amazon Athena to query the log data in the S3 bucket.

B.text: Create an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain. Configure the applications to output logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs log groups. Create an OpenSearch Service subscription filter for each log group to stream the data to OpenSearch. Create the required queries and dashboards in OpenSearch Service to analyze and visualize the data.

C.text: Configure the applications to output logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs log groups. Use CloudWatch log anomaly detection to query and visualize the log data.

D.text: Update the application code to send the log data to Amazon QuickSight by using Super-fast, Parallel, In-memory Calculation Engine (SPIC

E.text: . Create the required analyses and dashboards in QuickSight.

zh_question: 一家公司在AWS上運行多個應用程式。該公司已設定每個應用程式輸出日誌。 该公司希望以近乎即時的方式查詢並視覺化這些應用程式日誌。 哪項解決方案能符合這些需求？

A.text: 設定應用程式將日誌輸出至AmazonCloudWatchLogs日誌群組。建立一個Amazon S3儲存貯桶。建立一個依排程執行的AWSLambda函式，將所需的日誌群組匯出至該S3儲 存貯桶。使用AmazonAthena查詢S3儲存貯桶中的日誌資料。

B.text: 建立一個AmazonOpenSearchService網域。設定應用程式將日誌輸出至Amazon CloudWatchLogs日誌群組。為 每個日誌群組建立OpenSearchService訂閱篩選器，以將資料串流至OpenSearch。在 OpenSearchService中建立所需的查詢與儀表板，以分析並視覺化資料。

C.text: 設定應用程式將日誌輸出至AmazonCloudWatchLogs日誌群組。使用 CloudWatch日誌異常偵測功能來查詢並視覺化日誌資料。

D.text: 更新應用程式程式碼，使用超快速、平行、記憶體內計算引擎(SPIC

E.text: 將日誌資料傳送至 AmazonQuickSight。在QuickSight中建立所需的分析與儀表板。

en_question: An ecommerce company processes millions of orders each day. The company uses AWS Glue ETL to collect data from multiple sources, clean the data, and store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket in CSV format by using the S3 Standard storage class. The company uses the stored data to conduct daily analysis. The company wants to optimize costs for data storage and retrieval. Which solution will meet this requirement?

A.text: Transition the data to Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.

B.text: Transition the data from Amazon S3 to an Amazon Aurora cluster.

C.text: Configure AWS Glue ETL to transform the incoming data to Apache Parquet format.

D.text: Configure AWS Glue ETL to use Amazon EMR to process incoming data in parallel.

zh_question: 一家電子商務公司每天處理數百萬筆訂單。該公司使用AWSGlueETL從多個 來源收集資料、清理資料，並透過S3標準儲存類別將資料以CSV格式儲存在 AmazonS3儲存貯體中。該公司利用所儲存的資料進行每日分析。 該公司希望最佳化資料儲存與檢索的成本。 哪項解決方案能符合此需求？

A.text: 將資料轉移至AmazonS3GlacierFlexibleRetrieval。

B.text: 將資料從AmazonS3轉移至AmazonAurora叢集。

C.text: 設定AWSGlueETL以將傳入的資料轉換為ApacheParquet格式。

D.text: 設定AWSGlueETL以使用AmazonEMR平行處理傳入的資料。

en_question: A data engineer is optimizing query performance in Amazon Athena notebooks that use Apache Spark to analyze large datasets that are stored in Amazon S3. The data is partitioned. An AWS Glue crawler updates the partitions. The data engineer wants to minimize the amount of data that is scanned to improve efficiency of Athena queries. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Apply partition filters in the queries.

B.text: Increase the frequency of AWS Glue crawler invocations to update the data catalog more often.

C.text: Organize the data that is in Amazon S3 by using a nested directory structure.

D.text: Configure Spark to use in-memory caching for frequently accessed data.

zh_question: 一位資料工程師正在最佳化使用ApacheSpark分析儲存於AmazonS3之大型 資料集的AmazonAthena筆記本中的查詢效能。該資料已進行分割。 AWSGluecrawler會更新分割區。 資料工程師希望最小化掃描的資料量，以提升Athena查詢的效率。 哪種解決方案能符合這些需求？

A.text: 在查詢中套用分割區篩選條件。

B.text: 增加AWSGluecrawler的呼叫頻率，以更頻繁地更新資料目錄。

C.text: 使用巢狀目錄結構來組織AmazonS3中的資料。

D.text: 設定Spark對經常存取的資料使用記憶體快取。

en_question: A company manages an Amazon Redshift data warehouse. The data warehouse is in a public subnet inside a custom VPC. A security group allows only traffic from within itself. An ACL is open to all traffic. The company wants to generate several visualizations in Amazon QuickSight for an upcoming sales event. The company will run QuickSight Enterprise edition in a second AWS account inside a public subnet within a second custom VPC. The new public subnet has a security group that allows outbound traffic to the existing Redshift cluster. A data engineer needs to establish connections between Amazon Redshift and QuickSight. QuickSight must refresh dashboards by querying the Redshift cluster. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Configure the Redshift security group to allow inbound traffic on the Redshift port from the QuickSight security group.

B.text: Assign Elastic IP addresses to the QuickSight visualizations. Configure the QuickSight security group to allow inbound traffic on the Redshift port from the Elastic IP addresses.

C.text: Confirm that the CIDR ranges of the Redshift VPC and the QuickSight VPC are the same. If CIDR ranges are different, reconfigure one CIDR range to match the other. Establish network peering between the VPCs.

D.text: Create a QuickSight gateway endpoint in the Redshift VPC. Attach an endpoint policy to the gateway endpoint to ensure only specific QuickSight accounts can use the endpoint.

zh_question: 一家公司管理著一個AmazonRedshift資料倉儲。該資料倉儲位於自訂VPC內 的公用子網中。安全群組僅允許來自其內部的流量，而存取控制清單(ACL)則對 所有流量開放。 該公司希望為即將到來的銷售活動在AmazonQuickSight中產生多個視覺化圖 表。该公司將在第二個AWS帳戶中的自訂VPC內公用子網執行QuickSight Enterprise版本。新的公用子網具備一個安全群組，允許出站流量連接到現有的 Redshift叢集。 資料工程師需要建立AmazonRedshift與QuickSight之間的連線。 QuickSight必須透過查詢Redshift叢集來更新儀表板。 哪項解決方案符合這些需求？

A.text: 設定Redshift安全性群組，以允許來自QuickSight安全性群組的入站流量進入 Redshift連接埠。

B.text: 將彈性IP位址指派給QuickSight視覺化項目。設定QuickSight安全群組，以允許來自這 些彈性IP位址、針對Redshift連接埠的入站流量。

C.text: 確認RedshiftVPC與QuickSightVPC的CIDR範圍相同。若CIDR範圍不同，請重新 設定其中一個以與另一個相符。在兩個VPC之間建立網路對等互連。

D.text: 在RedshiftVPC中建立QuickSight閘道端點。將端點原則附加至該閘道端點，以確保僅 特定的QuickSight帳戶可使用此端點。

en_question: A data engineer is building a data pipeline. A large data file is uploaded to an Amazon S3 bucket once each day at unpredictable times. An AWS Glue workflow uses hundreds of workers to process the file and load the data into Amazon Redshift. The company wants to process the file as quickly as possible. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Create an on-demand AWS Glue trigger to start the workflow. Create an AWS Lambda function that runs every 15 minutes to check the S3 bucket for the daily file. Configure the function to start the AWS Glue workflow if the file is present.

B.text: Create an event-based AWS Glue trigger to start the workflow. Configure Amazon S3 to log events to AWS CloudTrail. Create a rule in Amazon EventBridge to forward PutObject events to the AWS Glue trigger.

C.text: Create a scheduled AWS Glue trigger to start the workflow. Create a cron job that runs the AWS Glue job every 15 minutes. Set up the AWS Glue job to check the S3 bucket for the daily file. Configure the job to stop if the file is not present.

D.text: Create an on-demand AWS Glue trigger to start the workflow. Create an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) migration task. Set the DMS source as the S3 bucket. Set the target endpoint as the AWS Glue workflow.

zh_question: 資料工程師正在建置資料管線。一個大型資料檔案每天會在不可預測的時間上傳 至AmazonS3儲存貯體一次。AWSGlue工作流程使用數百個工作節點來處理 該檔案，並將資料載入AmazonRedshift。该公司希望盡快處理該檔案。 哪種解決方案能符合這些需求？

A.text: 建立一個隨需的AWSGlue觸發程序以啟動工作流程。建立一個每15分鐘執行一次的A WSLambda函數，用於檢查S3儲存桶中是否存在每日檔案。設定該函數在檔案存在時啟動 AWSGlue工作流程。

B.text: 建立一個基於事件的AWSGlue觸發程序以啟動工作流程。設定AmazonS3將事件記錄至 AWSCloudTrail。在AmazonEventBridge中建立規則，將PutObject事件轉送至A WSGlue觸發程序。

C.text: 建立一個排程式的AWSGlue觸發程序以啟動工作流程。建立一個每15分鐘執行一次A WSGlue工作的cron工作。設定該AWSGlue工作檢查S3儲存桶中是否存在每日檔案，並設 定若檔案不存在則停止該工作。

D.text: 建立一個隨需的AWSGlue觸發程序以啟動工作流程。建立一個AWSDatabase MigrationService(AWSDMS)遷移任務。將DMS來源設定為S3儲存桶，並將目標端點設定 為AWSGlue工作流程。

en_question: A data engineer needs to run a data transformation job whenever a user adds a file to an Amazon S3 bucket. The job will run for less than 1 minute. The job must send the output through an email message to the data engineer. The data engineer expects users to add one file every hour of the day. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

A.text: Create a small Amazon EC2 instance that polls the S3 bucket for new files. Run transformation code on a schedule to generate the output. Use operating system commands to send email messages.

B.text: Run an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) task to poll the S3 bucket for new files. Run transformation code on a schedule to generate the output. Use operating system commands to send email messages.

C.text: Create an AWS Lambda function to transform the data. Use Amazon S3 Event Notifications to invoke the Lambda function when a new object is created. Publish the output to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe the data engineer’s email account to the topic.

D.text: Deploy an Amazon EMR cluster. Use EMR File System (EMRFS) to access the files in the S3 bucket. Run transformation code on a schedule to generate the output to a second S3 bucket. Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Configure Amazon S3 Event Notifications to notify the topic when a new object is created.

zh_question: 資料工程師需要在使用者將檔案新增至AmazonS3儲存貯桶時，執行資料轉換 工作。該工作執行時間少於1分鐘，且必須透過電子郵件將輸出結果傳送給資料 工程師。資料工程師預期使用者每小時會新增一個檔案。 哪種解決方案能以最具作業效率的方式符合這些需求？

A.text: 建立一個小型AmazonEC2執行個體來輪詢S3儲存貯桶以尋找新檔案。排程執行轉換程式 碼以產生輸出。使用作業系統指令傳送電子郵件訊息。

B.text: 執行AmazonElasticContainerService(AmazonECS)工作，以輪詢S3儲存桶中的新 檔案。依排程執行轉換程式碼以產生輸出。使用作業系統指令傳送電子郵件訊息。

C.text: 建立AWSLambda函數以轉換資料。當建立新物件時，使用AmazonS3事件通知來叫用 Lambda函數。將輸出發布至Amazon SimpleNotificationService(AmazonSNS)主題。將資料工程師的電子郵件帳戶訂閱至該 主題。

D.text: 部署AmazonEMR叢集。使用EMRFileSystem(EMRFS)存取S3 儲存桶中的檔案。依排程執行轉換程式碼以產生輸出至第二個S3儲存桶。建立Amazon SimpleNotificationService(AmazonSNS)主題。設定AmazonS3事件通知，以便在建立 新物件時通知該主題。

en_question: A company uses Amazon S3 and AWS Glue Data Catalog to manage a data lake that contains contact information for customers. The company uses PySpark and AWS Glue jobs with a DynamicFrame to run a workflow that processes data within the data lake. A data engineer notices that the workflow is generating errors as a result of how customer postal codes are stored in the data lake. Some postal codes include unnecessary numbers or invalid characters. The data engineer needs a solution to address the errors and correct the postal codes in the data lake.

A.text: Create a schema definition for PySpark that matches the format the processing workflow requires for postal codes. Pass the schema to the DynamicFrame during processing.

B.text: Use AWS Glue workflow properties to allow job state sharing. Configure the AWS Glue jobs to read values from the postal code column by using the properties from a previously successful run of the jobs.

C.text: Configure the column.push_down_predicate setting and the catalogPartitionPredicate settings for the postal code column in the DynamicFrame.

D.text: Set the DynamicFrame additional_options parameter ‘useS3ListImplementation’ to True.

zh_question: 一家公司使用AmazonS3和AWSGlue資料目錄來管理包含客戶聯絡資訊的資 料湖。該公司使用PySpark和帶有動態框架（DynamicFrame）的AWS Glue任務，執行處理資料湖內資料的工作流程。 一位資料工程師發現，由於客戶郵遞區號在資料湖中的儲存方式，工作流程產生了 錯誤。部分郵遞區號包含不必要的數字或無效字元。 這位資料工程師需要一個解決方案來修正這些錯誤，並更正資料湖中的郵遞區號。

A.text: 建立一個符合處理工作流程對郵遞區號格式要求的PySpark結構定義。在處理期間將此結 構傳遞給動態框架。

B.text: 使用AWSGlue工作流程屬性以允許任務狀態共享。設定AWSGlue任務，利用先前成功執 行任務的屬性來讀取郵遞區號欄位的值。

C.text: 設定column.push_down_predicate設定與catalogPartitionPredicate DynamicFrame中郵遞區號欄位的設定。

D.text: 將DynamicFrameadditional_options參數'useS3ListImplementation'設為True。

en_question: A data engineer is troubleshooting an AWS Glue workflow that occasionally fails. The engineer determines that the failures are a result of data quality issues. A business reporting team needs to receive an email notification any time the workflow fails in the future. Which solution will meet this requirement?

A.text: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) FIFO topic. Subscribe the team’s email account to the SNS topic. Create an AWS Lambda function that initiates when the AWS Glue job state changes to FAILED. Set the SNS topic as the target.

B.text: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) standard topic. Subscribe the team’s email account to the SNS topic. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that triggers when the AWS Glue job state changes to FAILED. Set the SNS topic as the target.

C.text: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Subscribe the team’s email account to the SQS queue. Create an AWS Config rule that triggers when the AWS Glue job state changes to FAILED. Set the SQS queue as the target.

D.text: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue. Subscribe the team’s email account to the SQS queue. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that triggers when the AWS Glue job state changes to FAILESet the SQS queue as the target.

zh_question: 一位資料工程師正在排查一個偶爾失敗的AWSGlue工作流程。該工程師判定失 敗是由資料品質問題所導致。業務報告團隊需要在工作流程未來任何一次失敗時收 到電子郵件通知。 哪項解決方案能符合此需求？

A.text: 建立一個AmazonSimpleNotificationService(AmazonSNS)FIFO主題。將團隊的電子 郵件帳戶訂閱至該SNS主題。建立一個AWSLambda函數，當AWSGlue工作狀態變更為 FAILED時觸發。將該SNS主題設定為目標。

B.text: 建立一個AmazonSimpleNotificationService(AmazonSNS)標準主題。將團隊的電 子郵件帳戶訂閱至該SNS主題。建立一個AmazonEventBridge規則，當AWSGlue工作 狀態變更為FAILED時觸發。將該SNS主題設定為目標。

C.text: 建立一個AmazonSimpleQueueService(AmazonSQS)FIFO佇列。將團隊的電子郵件 帳戶訂閱至該SQS佇列。建立一個AWSConfig規則，當AWSGlue工作狀態變更為 FAILED時觸發。將該SQS佇列設定為目標。

D.text: 建立一個AmazonSimpleQueueService(AmazonSQS)標準佇列。將團隊的電子郵件帳 戶訂閱至該SQS佇列。建立一個AmazonEventBridge規則，當AWSGlue工作狀態變更為 FAILED時觸發。將該SQS佇列設定為目標。

en_question: A company uses AWS Glue jobs to implement several data pipelines. The pipelines are critical to the company. The company needs to implement a monitoring mechanism that will alert stakeholders if the pipelines fail. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to match AWS Glue job failure events. Configure the rule to target an AWS Lambda function to process events. Configure the function to send notifications to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.

B.text: Configure an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group for the AWS Glue jobs. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to match new log creation events in the log group. Configure the rule to target an AWS Lambda function that reads the logs and sends notifications to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic if AWS Glue job failure logs are present.

C.text: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to match AWS Glue job failure events. Define an Amazon CloudWatch metric based on the EventBridge rule. Set up a CloudWatch alarm based on the metric to send notifications to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.

D.text: Configure an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group for the AWS Glue jobs. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to match new log creation events in the log group. Configure the rule to send notifications to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.

zh_question: 一家公司使用AWSGlue任務來實作多個資料管線。這些管線對該公司至 關重要。 公司需要實作一種監控機制，以便在管線失敗時通知利害關係人。 哪項解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 建立AmazonEventBridge規則以比對AWSGlue工作失敗事件。將該規則設定為目標指 向AWSLambda函數以處理事件。設定該函數將通知傳送至AmazonSimpleNotification Service(AmazonSNS)主題。

B.text: 為AWSGlue工作設定AmazonCloudWatchLogs日誌群組。建立Amazon EventBridge規則以比對該日誌群組中的新日誌建立事件。將該規則設定為目標指向 一個AWSLambda函數，該函數會讀取日誌，並在發現AWSGlue工作失敗日誌時，將 通知傳送至AmazonSimpleNotificationService(AmazonSNS)主題。

C.text: 建立AmazonEventBridge規則以比對AWSGlue工作失敗事件。根據該EventBridge 規則定義AmazonCloudWatch指標。設定基於該 指標的CloudWatch警報，以便將通知傳送至AmazonSimpleNotificationService(AmazonSNS)主題。

D.text: 為AWSGlue工作設定AmazonCloudWatchLogs日誌群組。建立Amazon EventBridge規則，以比對該日誌群組中的新日誌建立事件。設定此規則將通知傳送至 AmazonSimpleNotificationService(AmazonSNS)主題。

en_question: A company uses AWS Glue Apache Spark jobs to handle extract, transform, and load (ETL) workloads. The company has enabled logging and monitoring for all AWS Glue jobs. One of the AWS Glue jobs begins to fail. A data engineer investigates the error and wants to examine metrics for all individual stages within the job. How can the data engineer access the stage metrics?

A.text: Examine the AWS Glue job and stage details in the Spark UI.

B.text: Examine the AWS Glue job and stage metrics in Amazon CloudWatch.

C.text: Examine the AWS Glue job and stage logs in AWS CloudTrail logs.

D.text: Examine the AWS Glue job and stage details by using the run insights feature on the job.

zh_question: 一家公司使用AWSGlueApacheSpark作業來處理提取、轉換和載入(ETL) 工作負載。該公司已為所有AWSGlue作業啟用了日誌記錄和監控。 其中一個AWSGlue作業開始失敗。資料工程師調查該錯誤，並希望檢查該作 業內所有個別階段的指標。 資料工程師該如何存取階段指標？

A.text: 在SparkUI中檢查AWSGlue作業與階段的詳細資訊。

B.text: 在AmazonCloudWatch中檢查AWSGlue作業與階段的指標。

C.text: 在AWSCloudTrail日誌中檢查AWSGlue作業與階段的日誌。

D.text: 使用該作業的執行洞察功能來檢查AWSGlue作業與階段的詳細資訊。

en_question: A data engineer notices slow query performance on a highly partitioned table that is in Amazon Athena. The table contains daily data for the previous 5 years, partitioned by date. The data engineer wants to improve query performance and to automate partition management. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Use an AWS Lambda function that runs daily. Configure the function to manually create new partitions in AWS Glue for each day’s data.

B.text: Use partition projection in Athena. Configure the table properties by using a date range from 5 years ago to the present.

C.text: Reduce the number of partitions by changing the partitioning schema from daily to monthly granularity.

D.text: Increase the processing capacity of Athena queries by allocating more compute resources.

zh_question: 一名資料工程師注意到，在AmazonAthena中一個高度分區的表格上，查詢效 能緩慢。該表格包含過去5年的每日資料，並依日期進行分區。 資料工程師希望提升查詢效能並自動化分割區管理。 哪項解決方案能符合這些需求？

A.text: 使用每天執行的AWSLambda函式。設定該函式以手動在AWSGlue中為每天的資料建立 新的分割區。

B.text: 在Athena中使用分割區投影。透過設定從5年前至今的日期範圍來設定表格屬性。

C.text: 將分割區架構從每日粒度變更為每月粒度，以減少分割區數量。

D.text: 透過配置更多運算資源，提升Athena查詢的處理容量。

en_question: A data engineer is using an Apache Iceberg framework to build a data lake that contains 100 ТВ of data. The data engineer wants to run AWS Glue Apache Spark jobs that use the Iceberg framework. What combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

A.text: Create a key named --conf for an AWS Glue job. Set Iceberg as a value for the --datalake- formats job parameter.

B.text: Specify the path to a specific version of Iceberg by using the -extra-jars job parameter. Set Iceberg as a value for the datalake-formats job parameter.

C.text: Set Iceberg as a value for the --datalake-formats job parameter.

D.text: Set the --enable-auto-scaling parameter to true.

E.text: Add the --job-bookmark-option: job-bookmark-enable parameter to an AWS Glue job.

zh_question: 一名資料工程師正在使用ApacheIceberg框架建置一個包含100TB資料的資料 湖。該資料工程師希望執行使用Iceberg框架的AWSGlueApacheSpark作業。 哪兩個步驟的組合可滿足這些需求？（請選擇兩項。）

A.text: 為AWSGlue工作建立名為‑‑conf的金鑰。將‑‑datalake‑formats工作參數的值設為 Iceberg。

B.text: 使用‑extra‑jars工作參數指定特定版本的Iceberg路徑。將datalake‑formats工作參數 的值設為Iceberg。

C.text: 將‑‑datalake‑formats工作參數的值設為Iceberg。

D.text: 將‑‑enable‑auto‑scaling參數設為true。

E.text: 將‑‑job‑bookmark‑option:job‑bookmark‑enable參數新增至AWSGlue工作。

en_question: A data engineer is configuring an AWS Glue Apache Spark extract, transform, and load (ETL) job. The job contains a sort-merge join of two large and equally sized DataFrames. The job is failing with the following error: No space left on device. Which solution will resolve the error?

A.text: Use the AWS Glue Spark shuffle manager.

B.text: Deploy are Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume for the job to use.

C.text: Convert the sort-merge join in the job to be a broadcast join.

D.text: Convert the DataFrames to DynamicFrames, and perform a DynamicFrame join in the job.

zh_question: 一名資料工程師正在設定一個包含兩個大型且大小相等之資料框（DataFra me）排序合併聯結的AWSGlueApacheSpark提取、轉換與載入(ETL)工作。 工作失敗，出現以下錯誤：裝置空間不足。 哪種解決方案可以解決此錯誤？

A.text: 使用AWSGlueSpark洗牌管理員。

B.text: 部署一個AmazonElasticBlockStore(AmazonEBS)磁碟區供工作使用。

C.text: 將工作中的排序合併聯結轉換為廣播聯結。

D.text: 將DataFrame轉換為DynamicFrame，並在工作中執行DynamicFrame聯結。

en_question: A company needs to implement a workflow to process transactions. Each transaction goes through multiple levels of validation. Each validation level depends on the preceding validation level. The workflow must either process or reject each transaction within 24-hours. The workflow must run for less than 24 hours total. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational cost?

A.text: Create a standard workflow in AWS Step Functions. Implement a Wait for Callback pattern to wait for the validation steps to finish.

B.text: Create an express workflow in AWS Step Functions. Implement a Wait for Callback pattern to wait for the validation steps to finish.

C.text: Use AWS Lambda functions to implement the workflow. Use Amazon EventBridge to invoke the validation steps.

D.text: Use Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA) to implement the workflow.

zh_question: 一家公司需要實作一個工作流程來處理交易。每筆交易需經過多層驗證，且每 個驗證層級皆依賴前一個驗證層級。 該工作流程必須在24小時內完成每筆交易的處理或拒絕，且整體執行時間須 少於24小時。 哪項解決方案能以最低的營運成本滿足這些需求？

A.text: 在AWSStepFunctions中建立標準工作流程。實作「等待回呼」模式，以等候驗證步驟 完成。

B.text: 在AWSStepFunctions中建立Express工作流程。實作「等待回呼」模式，以等候驗證 步驟完成。

C.text: 使用AWSLambda函數實作工作流程。使用AmazonEventBridge叫用驗證步驟。

D.text: 使用AmazonManagedWorkflowsforApacheAirflow(AmazonMWAA)實作工 作流程。

en_question: A data engineer configures a large number of AWS Glue jobs that all start up around the same time. All the jobs run for less than 1 hour in the same subnet of the same VPC. All the AWS Glue jobs run on a G1.X worker type. Some of the jobs occasionally fail with the following error: "The specified subnet does not have enough free addresses to satisfy the request". What is the likely root cause of the error?

A.text: There are not enough IP addresses in the subnet.

B.text: The G1.X worker type cannot access the subnet.

C.text: AWS Glue does not have the correct IAM permissions to add additional IP addresses to the subnet.

D.text: There are not enough IP addresses in the VPC.

zh_question: 一名資料工程師設定大量AWSGlue工作，這些工作皆於相近時間啟動。所有 工作執行時間均少於1小時，且位於同一VPC的同一子網內。所有AWS Glue工作皆使用G1.X工作節點類型執行。 部分工作偶爾會失敗，並出現以下錯誤：「指定的子網沒有足夠的空閒位 址來滿足請求」。 此錯誤的可能根本原因為何？

A.text: 子網中的IP位址數量不足。

B.text: G1.X工作節點類型無法存取該子網。

C.text: AWSGlue缺乏正確的IAM權限，無法將額外的IP位址新增至 子網。

D.text: VPC中的IP位址不足。

en_question: A company runs an Apache Spark application every night in an Amazon EMR cluster. The company uses Amazon EC2 instances to supply compute capacity for the EMR cluster. The company deployed the Spark application in cluster mode. An error occurs in the Spark application. A log for the error is stored in the application's Spark driver standard error logs. A data engineer needs to investigate the error. Where can the data engineer find this error log?

A.text: The engineer can connect to the web UI on the live cluster to see the YARN ResourceManager logs.

B.text: The engineer can connect to the persistent application UI to see the first YARN container log in the Spark UI.

C.text: The engineer can connect to the Amazon EMR console to see the Amazon EMR step logs that are archived in Amazon S3.

D.text: The engineer can connect to the primary node of the cluster by using SSH to see the Spark history server logs.

zh_question: 一家公司每晚在AmazonEMR叢集中執行ApacheSpark應用程式。該公司 使用AmazonEC2執行個體為EMR叢集提供運算容量。该公司已以叢集模式 部署該Spark應用程式。 Spark應用程式發生錯誤。該錯誤的日誌已儲存於應用程式的Spark驅動程 式標準錯誤日誌中。資料工程師需要調查此錯誤。 資料工程師可以在哪裡找到此錯誤日誌？

A.text: 工程師可以連線至即時叢集的WebUI，以查看YARNResourceManager 日誌。

B.text: 工程師可以連線至持久化應用程式UI，以在SparkUI中查看第一個YARN容器日誌。

C.text: 工程師可以連線至控制台以查看歸檔在AmazonS3中的AmazonEMR步驟日誌。

D.text: 工程師可以使用SSH連線至叢集的主要節點，以查看Spark歷史伺服器日誌。

en_question: A company processes 500 GB of audience and advertising data daily, storing CSV files in Amazon S3 with schemas registered in AWS Glue Data Catalog. They need to convert these files to Apache Parquet format and store them in an S3 bucket. The solution requires a long-running workflow with 15 GiB memory capacity to process the data concurrently, followed by a correlation process that begins only after the first two processes complete. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Use Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA) to orchestrate the workflow by using AWS Glue. Configure AWS Glue to begin the third process after the first two processes have finished.

B.text: Use Amazon EMR to run each process in the workflow. Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to handle messages that indicate the completion of the first two processes. Configure an AWS Lambda function to process the SQS queue by running the third process.

C.text: Use AWS Glue workflows to run the first two processes in parallel. Ensure that the third process starts after the first two processes have finished.

D.text: Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate a workflow that uses multiple AWS Lambda functions. Ensure that the third process starts after the first two processes have finished.

zh_question: 一家公司每天處理500GB的受眾與廣告數據，將CSV檔案儲存在AmazonS3 中，並在AWSGlueDataCatalog註冊其架構。他們需要將這些檔案轉換為 ApacheParquet格式，並儲存至S3儲存桶。 該解決方案需要一個長期執行的工作流程，具備15GiB的記憶體容量以並行處 理資料，隨後進行關聯處理程序，且此程序僅在前兩個程序完成後才會啟動。 哪項解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用AmazonManagedWorkflowsforApacheAirflow(AmazonMWAA)搭配 AWSGlue來協調工作流程。設定AWSGlue在前兩個程序完成後啟動第三個程序。

B.text: 使用AmazonEMR執行工作流程中的每個程序。建立一個AmazonSimpleQueue Service(AmazonSQS)佇列，用以處理指示前兩個程序完成的訊息。 設定一個AWSLambda函數來處理SQS佇列，並執行第三個程序。

C.text: 使用AWSGlue工作流程並行執行前兩個處理程序。確保第三個處理程序在前兩個處理 程序完成後才開始。

D.text: 使用AWSStepFunctions協調一個使用多個AWSLambda函數的工作流程。確保第三個 處理程序在前兩個處理程序完成後才開始。

en_question: A company uses an organization in AWS Organizations to manage multiple AWS accounts. The company uses an enhanced fanout data stream in Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to receive streaming data from multiple producers. The company runs the data stream in an account named Account A. The company wants to use an AWS Lambda function in an account named Account В to process the data from the data stream. The company creates a Lambda execution role in Account В that has permissions to access data from the data stream in Account A. What additional step must the company take to meet this requirement?

A.text: Create a service control policy (SCP) to grant the data stream read access to the cross- account Lambda execution role. Attach the SCP to Account A.

B.text: Add a resource-based policy to the data stream to allow read access for the cross-account Lambda execution role.

C.text: Create a service control policy (SCP) to grant the data stream read access to the cross- account Lambda execution role. Attach the SCP to Account B.

D.text: Add a resource-based policy to the cross-account Lambda function to grant the data stream read access to the function.

zh_question: 一家公司使用AWSOrganizations中的組織來管理多個AWS帳戶。該公司在 AmazonKinesisDataStreams中使用增強型扇出資料串流，以接收來自多個生 產者的串流資料。該資料串流在名為「帳戶A」的帳戶中執行。該公司希望在使用 名為「帳戶B」的帳戶中，透過AWSLambda函數處理來自該資料串流的資料。 該公司在「帳戶B」中建立了一個Lambda執行角色，並賦予其存取「帳戶A」 中資料串流資料的權限。 公司必須採取哪項額外步驟才能符合此要求？

A.text: 建立服務控制原則(SCP)，授予資料串流對跨帳戶Lambda執行角色的讀取存取權限。 將此SCP附加至帳戶A。

B.text: 在資料串流上新增資源型原則，以允許跨帳戶Lambda執行角色進行讀取存取。

C.text: 建立服務控制原則(SCP)，授予資料串流對跨帳戶Lambda執行角色的讀取存取權限。 將此SCP附加至帳戶B。

D.text: 在跨帳戶Lambda函數上新增資源型原則，以授予該函數對資料串流的讀取存取權限。

en_question: A company needs to use Amazon Athena to analyze data that is in an Amazon S3 bucket. A data engineer needs to configure AWS Glue table partitions for year, month, and day. The data engineer needs to create the partitions every day to adjust to schema changes in the data. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Use AWS Glue DataBrew to create the partitions for the AWS Glue table.

B.text: Use an AWS Lambda function to create the partitions for the AWS Glue table.

C.text: Set partition projection properties for the AWS Glue table.

D.text: Configure an AWS Glue crawler to run on a set schedule.

zh_question: 某公司需要使用AmazonAthena來分析位於AmazonS3儲存桶中的資料。資 料工程師需要設定AWSGlue資料表的年份、月份和日期分區。該工程師必須每 天建立這些分區，以因應資料結構描述的變更。 哪項解決方案能符合這些需求？

A.text: 使用AWSGlueDataBrew為AWSGlue資料表建立分割區。

B.text: 使用AWSLambda函式為AWSGlue資料表建立分割區。

C.text: 為AWSGlue資料表設定分割區投影屬性。

D.text: 設定AWSGlue爬蟲程式依排程執行。

en_question: A hotel management company receives daily data files from each of its hotels. The company wants to upload its data to AWS. The company plans to use Amazon Athena to access the files. The company needs to protect the files from accidental deletion. The company will develop an application on its on- premises servers to automatically forward the files to a fully managed AWS ingestion service. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Use AWS DataSync to replicate data from the on-premises servers to Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS). Configure automatic backups in AWS Backup.

B.text: Use the Amazon Kinesis Agent on the on-premises servers to send data to Amazon Data Firehose. Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket that has versioning enabled.

C.text: Use AWS Glue jobs to ingest data from the on-premises servers into Amazon RDS. Enable automated backups for data protection.

D.text: Use a self-managed Apache Kafka agent on the on-premises servers to stream data to Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK). Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket with versioning enabled.

zh_question: 一家飯店管理公司每天會從其旗下的每家飯店接收資料檔案。該公司希望將資料 上傳至AWS，並計畫使用AmazonAthena來存取這些檔案。公司需要保護這 些檔案以免被意外刪除。此外，公司將在內部部署的伺服器上開發應用程式，以 自動將檔案轉送至完全託管的AWS資料擷取服務。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用AWSDataSync將資料從內部部署伺服器複製到AmazonElasticFileSystem (AmazonEFS)。在AWSBackup中設定自動備份。

B.text: 使用本地伺服器上的AmazonKinesisAgent將資料傳送至AmazonDataFirehose。 將資料儲存在已啟用版本控制的AmazonS3儲存貯體中。（正確 解答）

C.text: 使用AWSGlue任務將資料從內部部署伺服器匯入AmazonRDS。啟用自動備份以保護 資料。

D.text: 在內部部署伺服器上使用自行管理的ApacheKafka代理程式，將資料串流至 AmazonManagedStreamingforApacheKafka（AmazonMSK）。將資料儲存在已啟 用版本控制的AmazonS3儲存貯體中。

en_question: A company wants to use Apache Spark jobs that run on an Amazon EMR cluster to process streaming data. The Spark jobs will transform and store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company will use Amazon Athena to perform analysis. The company needs to optimize the data format for analytical queries. Which solutions will meet these requirements with the SHORTEST query times? (Choose two.)

A.text: Use Avro format. Use AWS Glue Data Catalog to track schema changes.

B.text: Use ORC format. Use AWS Glue Data Catalog to track schema changes.

C.text: Use Apache Parquet format. Use an external Amazon DynamoDB table to track schema changes.

D.text: Use Apache Parquet format. Use AWS Glue Data Catalog to track schema changes.

E.text: Use ORC format. Store schema definitions in separate files in Amazon S3.

zh_question: 一家公司希望使用在AmazonEMR叢集上執行的ApacheSpark工作來處理串 流資料。這些Spark工作將轉換並儲存資料至AmazonS3儲存貯體，而該公司 將使用AmazonAthena進行分析。 該公司需要最佳化資料格式以用於分析查詢。 哪些解決方案能以最短的查詢時間符合這些需求？（請選擇兩項。）

A.text: 使用Avro格式。使用AWSGlue資料目錄來追蹤結構描述變更。

B.text: 使用ORC格式。使用AWSGlue資料目錄來追蹤結構描述變更。

C.text: 使用ApacheParquet格式。使用外部AmazonDynamoDB資料表來追蹤結構描述 變更。

D.text: 使用ApacheParquet格式。使用AWSGlueDataCatalog追蹤架構變更。

E.text: 使用ORC格式。將架構定義儲存在AmazonS3中的獨立檔案內。

en_question: A company adds new data to a large CSV file in an Amazon S3 bucket every day. The file contains company sales data from the previous 5 years. The file currently includes more than 5,000 rows. The CSV file structure is shown below with sample data: The company needs to use Amazon Athena to run queries on the CSV file to fetch data from a specific time period. Which solution will meet this requirement MOST cost-effectively?

A.text: Write an Apache Spark script to convert the CSV data to JSON format. Create an AWS Glue job to run the script every day. Catalog the JSON data in AWS Glue. Run the Athena queries on the JSON data.

B.text: Use prefixes to partition the data in the S3 bucket. Use the SALE_DATE column to create a partition for each day. Catalog the data in AWS Glue and ensure that the partitions are added. Update the Athena queries to use the new partitions.

C.text: Launch an Amazon EMR cluster. Specify AWS Glue Data Catalog as the default Apache Hive metastore. Use Presto in Trino to run queries on the data.

D.text: Create an Amazon RDS database. Create a table named SALES that matches the schema of the CSV file. Create an index on the SALE_DATE column. Create an AWS Lambda function to load the CSV data into the RDS database. Use S3 Event Notifications to invoke the Lambda function.

zh_question: 一家公司每天將新資料新增至AmazonS3儲存桶中的大型CSV檔案。該檔案包 含過去5年的公司銷售資料，目前已有超過5,000列。下方的CSV檔案結構顯 示了範例資料： 該公司需要使用AmazonAthena對該CSV檔案執行查詢，以擷取特定時間 區間的資料。 哪項解決方案能以最具成本效益的方式滿足此需求？

A.text: 撰寫ApacheSpark腳本，將CSV資料轉換為JSON格式。建立AWSGlue工作以每日執 行該腳本。在AWSGlue中編目JSON資料。針對該JSON資料執行Athena查詢。

B.text: 使用前綴在S3儲存桶中分割資料。使用SALE_DATE欄位為每一天建立一個分割區。在 AWSGlue中編目資料，並確保已新增這些分割區。更新Athena查詢以使用新的分割區。

C.text: 啟動一個AmazonEMR叢集。指定AWSGlueDataCatalog為預設的ApacheHive中 繼資料庫儲存區。使用Trino中的Presto對資料執行查詢。

D.text: 建立一個AmazonRDS資料庫。建立一個名為SALES的資料表，其結構與CSV檔案 相符。在SALEDATE欄位上建立索引。建立一個AWSLambda函數，將_CSV資料載入至 RDS資料庫。使用S3事件通知來觸發該Lambda函數。

en_question: A data engineer must implement a data cataloging solution to track schema changes in an Amazon Redshift table. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Schedule an AWS Glue crawler to run every day on the table by using the Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) driver. Configure the crawler to update an AWS Glue Data Catalog.

B.text: Use AWS DataSync to log the table metadata to an AWS Glue Data Catalog. Use an AWS Glue crawler to update the Data Catalog every day.

C.text: Use the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to log the table metadata to an Apache Hive metastore. Use Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to update the metastore every day.

D.text: Schedule an AWS Glue crawler to run every day on the table. Configure the crawler to update an Apache Hive metastore.

zh_question: 資料工程師必須實作資料目錄解決方案，以追蹤AmazonRedshift資料表中 的結構描述變更。 哪項解決方案符合這些需求？

A.text: 使用JavaDatabaseConnectivity(JDBC)驅動程式，排程讓AWSGlue爬取程式每天在 該資料表上執行。設定爬取程式以更新AWSGlue資料目錄。

B.text: 使用AWSDataSync將資料表中繼資料記錄至AWSGlue資料目錄。使用AWSGlue爬取 程式每天更新資料目錄。

C.text: 使用AWSSchemaConversionTool(AWSSCT)將資料表中繼資料記錄至ApacheHive 中繼儲存區。使用AmazonEventBridgeScheduler每天更新中繼儲存區。

D.text: 排程讓AWSGluecrawler每天在該資料表上執行。設定此crawler以更新ApacheHive metastore。

en_question: A data engineer is building a solution to detect sensitive information that is stored in a data lake across multiple Amazon S3 buckets. The solution must detect personally identifiable information (PII) that is in a proprietary data format. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Use the AWS Glue Detect PII transform with specific patterns.

B.text: Use Amazon Made with managed data identifiers.

C.text: Use an AWS Lambda function with custom regular expressions.

D.text: Use Amazon Athena with a SQL query to match the custom formats.

zh_question: 一位資料工程師正在建構解決方案，以偵測儲存在跨多個AmazonS3儲存桶 之資料湖中的敏感資訊。該解決方案必須能偵測位於專有資料格式中的個人識 別資訊(PII)。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用AWSGlueDetectPII轉換並指定特定模式。

B.text: 使用AmazonMadewithmanageddataidentifiers。

C.text: 使用具有自訂正規表示式的AWSLambda函數。

D.text: 使用AmazonAthena並透過SQL查詢來比對自訂格式。

en_question: A data engineer is building a new data pipeline that stores metadata in an Amazon DynamoDB table. The data engineer must ensure that all items that are older than a specified age are removed from the DynamoDB table daily. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST configuration effort?

A.text: Enable DynamoDB TTL on the DynamoDB table. Adjust the application source code to set the TTL attribute appropriately.

B.text: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that uses a daily cron expression to trigger an AWS Lambda function to delete items that are older than the specified age.

C.text: Add a lifecycle configuration to the DynamoDB table that deletes items that are older than the specified age.

D.text: Create a DynamoDB stream that has an AWS Lambda function that reacts to data modifications. Configure the Lambda function to delete items that are older than the specified age.

zh_question: 資料工程師正在建置新的資料管線，將中繼資料儲存於AmazonDynamoDB資 料表中。該工程師必須確保每日從DynamoDB資料表中移除所有超過指定年限 的項目。 哪項解決方案能以最小的設定工作量符合此需求？

A.text: 在DynamoDB資料表上啟用DynamoDBTTL。調整應用程式原始碼以適當設定 TTL屬性。

B.text: 建立使用每日排程表達式的AmazonEventBridge規則，以觸發一個AWS Lambda函數，刪除超過指定年限的項目。

C.text: 為DynamoDB資料表新增生命週期設定，以刪除超過 指定時限的項目。

D.text: 建立一個具有AWSLambda函式的DynamoDB串流，用以回應資料 修改。設定該Lambda函式以刪除超過指定時限的項目。

en_question: A ride-sharing company stores records for all rides in an Amazon DynamoDB table. The table includes the following columns and types of values: The table currently contains billions of items. The table is partitioned by RideID and uses TripStartTime as the sort key. The company wants to use the data to build a personal interface to give drivers the ability to view the rides that each driver has completed, based on RideStatus. The solution must access the necessary data without scanning the entire table. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Create a local secondary index (LSI) on DriverID.

B.text: Create a global secondary index (GSI) that uses RiderID as the partition key and RideStatus as the sort key.

C.text: Create a global secondary index (GSI) that uses DriverID as the partition key and RideStatus as the sort key.

D.text: Create a filter expression that uses RiderID and RideStatus.

zh_question: 一家共乘服務公司將所有行程記錄儲存在AmazonDynamoDB資料表中。該 資料表包含以下欄位與數值類型： 該表格目前包含數十億筆項目。表格以RideID作為分割鍵，並使用 TripStartTime作為排序鍵。公司希望利用這些資料建置一個個人化介面，讓司 機能夠根據RideStatus檢視每位司機已完成的行程。此解決方案必須能在不掃描 整個表格的情況下存取必要的資料。 哪項解決方案符合這些需求？

A.text: 在DriverID上建立本機次要索引(LSI)。

B.text: 建立一個全域次要索引(GSI)，使用RiderID作為分割鍵，並使用RideStatus作為排序鍵。

C.text: 建立一個全域次要索引(GSI)，使用DriverID作為分割鍵，並使用RideStatus作為排序鍵。

D.text: 建立一個使用RiderID和RideStatus的篩選運算式。

en_question: A company stores information about its subscribers in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company runs an analysis every time a subscriber ends their subscription. The company uses AWS Lambda functions to respond to events from the S3 bucket by performing analyses. The Lambda functions clean data from the S3 bucket and initiate an AWS Glue workflow. The Lambda functions have 128 MB of memory and 512 MB of ephemeral storage. The Lambda functions have a timeout of 15 seconds. All three functions successfully finish running. However, CPU usage is often near 100%, which causes slow performance. The company wants to improve the performance of the functions and reduce the total runtime of the pipeline. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Increase the memory of the Lambda functions to 512 MB.

B.text: Increase the number of retries by using the Maximum Retry Attempts setting.

C.text: Configure the Lambda functions to run in the company's VPC.

D.text: Increase the timeout value for the Lambda functions from 15 seconds to 30 seconds.

zh_question: 一家公司將其訂閱者的資訊儲存在AmazonS3儲存貯體中。每當有訂閱者結束 訂閱時，該公司便會執行分析作業。該公司使用AWSLambda腳本來回應來自 S3儲存貯體的事件，並執行相關分析。 Lambda函數會清理S3儲存貯桶中的資料，並啟動AWSGlue工作流程。這 些Lambda函數擁有128MB的記憶體和512MB的暫存儲存空間，超時設定 為15秒。 所有三個函數均成功執行完畢。然而，CPU使用率經常接近100%，導致效能緩 慢。該公司希望提升函數效能並縮短管道的總執行時間。 哪項解決方案符合這些需求？

A.text: 將Lambda函數的記憶體增加至512MB。

B.text: 透過「最大重試次數」設定增加重試次數。

C.text: 將Lambda函數設定為在公司的VPC中執行。

D.text: 將Lambda函數的逾時值從15秒增加至30秒。

en_question: A company uses a data stream in Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to collect transactional data from multiple sources. The company uses an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) pipeline to look for outliers in the data from the stream. When the workflow detects an outlier, it sends a notification to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. The SNS topic initiates a second workflow to retrieve logs for the outliers and stores the logs in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company experiences delays in the notifications to the SNS topic during periods when the data stream is processing a high volume of data. When the company examines Amazon CloudWatch logs, the company notices a high value for the glue.driver.BlockManager.disk.diskSpaceUsed_MB metric when the traffic is high. The company must resolve this issue. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational effort?

A.text: Increase the number of data processing units (DPUs) in AWS Glue ETL jobs.

B.text: Use Amazon EMR to manage the ETL pipeline instead of AWS Glue.

C.text: Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate a parallel workflow state.

D.text: Enable auto scaling for the AWS Glue ETL jobs.

zh_question: 某公司使用AmazonKinesisDataStreams中的資料串流，從多個來源收集交 易資料。該公司使用AWSGlue提取、轉換和載入(ETL)管線，以偵測來自該串 流的資料中的異常值。當工作流程偵測到異常值時，它會將通知傳送至 AmazonSimpleNotificationService(AmazonSNS)主題。該SNS主題會啟 動第二個工作流程，以檢索異常值的日誌，並將這些日誌儲存在AmazonS3儲 存貯桶中。 該公司在資料串流處理大量資料期間，經歷了通知发送至SNS主題的延遲。當公 司檢查AmazonCloudWatch日誌時，發現流量高時， glue.driver.BlockManager.disk.diskSpaceUsed_MB指標的值很高。公司必 須解決此問題。 哪種解決方案能以最少的工作量滿足此需求？

A.text: 增加AWSGlueETL工作中的資料處理單元(DPU)數量。

B.text: 使用AmazonEMR而非AWSGlue來管理ETL管線。

C.text: 使用AWSStepFunctions來協調平行工作流程狀態。

D.text: 啟用AWSGlueETL工作的自動擴展功能。

en_question: A company has a data processing pipeline that runs multiple SQL queries in sequence against an Amazon Redshift cluster. The company merges with a second company. The original company modifies a query that aggregates sales revenue data to join sales tables from both companies. The sales table for the first company is named Table S1. The sales table for the second company is named Table S2. Table S1 contains 10 billion records. Table S2 contains 900 million records. The query becomes slow after the modification. A data engineer must improve the query performance. Which solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

A.text: Use the KEY distribution style for both sales tables. Select a low cardinality column to use for the join.

B.text: Use the KEY distribution style for both sales tables. Select a high cardinality column to use for the join.

C.text: Use the EVEN distribution style for Table S1. Use the ALL distribution style for Table S2.

D.text: Use the Amazon Redshift query optimizer to review and select optimizations to implement.

E.text: Use Amazon Redshift Advisor to review and select optimizations to implement.

zh_question: 某公司擁有一個資料處理管線，會依序對AmazonRedshift叢集執行多個 SQL查詢。該公司與另一家公司合併後，原公司修改了一個彙總銷售營收資料的 查詢，以聯結兩家公司的銷售資料表。第一家公司的銷售資料表名為TableS1， 第二家公司的銷售資料表名為TableS2。TableS1包含100億筆記錄，Table S2包含9億筆記錄。 修改後查詢變慢。資料工程師必須提升查詢效能。 哪些解決方案符合這些需求？（請選擇兩項。）

A.text: 對兩個銷售資料表使用KEY分佈樣式。選擇一個低基數的欄位用於聯結。

B.text: 對兩個銷售資料表使用KEY分佈樣式。選擇一個高基數的欄位用於聯結。

C.text: 對資料表S1使用EVEN分佈樣式。對資料表S2使用ALL分佈樣式。

D.text: 使用AmazonRedshift查詢優化器來檢視並選擇要實作的優化。

E.text: 使用AmazonRedshiftAdvisor來檢視並選擇要實作的優化。

en_question: A gaming company uses AWS Glue to perform read and write operations on Apache Iceberg tables for real-time streaming data. The data in the Iceberg tables is in Apache Parquet format. The company is experiencing slow query performance. Which solutions will improve query performance? (Choose two.)

A.text: Use AWS Glue Data Catalog to generate column-level statistics for the Iceberg tables on a schedule.

B.text: Use AWS Glue Data Catalog to automatically compact the Iceberg tables.

C.text: Use AWS Glue Data Catalog to automatically optimize indexes for the Iceberg tables.

D.text: Use AWS Glue Data Catalog to enable copy-on-write for the Iceberg tables.

E.text: Use AWS Glue Data Catalog to generate views for the Iceberg tables.

zh_question: 一家遊戲公司使用AWSGlue對ApacheIceberg表格執行讀取和寫入作業， 以處理即時串流資料。Iceberg表格中的資料採用ApacheParquet格式。該 公司正面臨查詢效能緩慢的問題。 哪些解決方案可以改善查詢效能？（請選擇兩項。）

A.text: 使用AWSGlueDataCatalog定期為Iceberg表格產生欄位層級的統計資料。 日程。

B.text: 使用AWSGlueDataCatalog自動壓縮Iceberg表格。

C.text: 使用AWSGlueDataCatalog自動最佳化Iceberg表格的索引。

D.text: 使用AWSGlueDataCatalog為Iceberg表格啟用寫時複製（Copy‑on‑Write）。

E.text: 使用AWSGlueDataCatalog為Iceberg表格產生檢視表。

en_question: A data engineer at a company is optimizing extract, transform, and load (ETL) workflows. The current architecture uses Amazon EMR and Apache Spark for large-scale transformations and AWS Glue for other ETL tasks. The workflows load processed data into an Amazon S3 based data lake. The company wants to move to a fully managed serverless solution that can orchestrate multiple ETL jobs and automate execution. The new solution must continue to use Spark to process data. The company needs to orchestrate and automate the ETL workflows with minimal manual intervention. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Migrate all ETL jobs to AWS Glue. Use AWS Glue workflows to orchestrate the pipeline.

B.text: Configure AWS Step Functions and Amazon EventBridge to orchestrate and invoke ETL workflows in AWS Glue and Amazon EMR.

C.text: Configure AWS Lambda functions to process Amazon S3 event notifications for data transformation tasks when new data is uploaded.

D.text: Use Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow automatic scheduling to orchestrate the Spark-based ETL jobs.

zh_question: 某公司的資料工程師正在最佳化提取、轉換與載入(ETL)工作流程。目前的架 構使用AmazonEMR和ApacheSpark進行大規模轉換，並使用AWS Glue執行其他ETL任務。這些工作流程將處理後的資料載入基於Amazon S3的資料湖中。 該公司希望遷移至完全託管的無伺服器解決方案，以協調多個ETL作業並自動 化執行。新解決方案必須繼續使用Spark來處理資料。該公司需要以最少的人 工干預來協調和自動化ETL工作流程。 哪種解決方案能符合這些需求？

A.text: 將所有ETL作業遷移至AWSGlue。使用AWSGlue工作流程來協調管線。

B.text: 設定AWSStepFunctions和AmazonEventBridge，以協調並叫用AWSGlue和 AmazonEMR中的ETL工作流程。

C.text: 設定AWSLambda函式，以便在新資料上傳時處理用於資料轉換任務的 AmazonS3事件通知。

D.text: 使用AmazonManagedWorkflowsforApacheAirflow的自動排程功能來協調基於 Spark的ETL作業。

en_question: A company that operates globally must follow regulations that require data from an AWS Region to be accessible only within that Region. A data engineer is creating a data pipeline that will create resources in the Region where the data engineer works. The data pipeline should have access to data only from the Region where the data engineer works. The pipeline uses Active Directory as an identity and authentication system. The pipeline uses a custom identity broker application to verify that employees are signed in to Active Directory and to obtain temporary credentials by using the AssumeRole API operation. Which solution will meet the locality requirements with the LEAST administrative effort?

A.text: Create an IAM role that has permissions to create resources. Create a policy for each Region that ensures users can create resources only in that Region. Pass the policy as the session policy when employees obtain the temporary credentials.

B.text: Create an IAM role for data engineers in each Region separately. Instruct each data engineer to obtain temporary credentials by assuming the appropriate Region specific IAM role.

C.text: Create an IAM group for each Region. Include the required IAM policies for each IAM group. Add users to each IAM group so that when users log in by obtaining the temporary credentials, the users will receive the appropriate access based on the IAM group.

D.text: Create individual IAM policies that allow users to create resources in a specific Region. Assign the policies to each data engineer. Allow users to assume the individually assigned role when the users log in to AWS.

zh_question: 一家在全球營運的公司必須遵循相關法規，要求來自特定AWS區域的資料僅 能在該區域內存取。 一名資料工程師正在建立一個資料管線，該管線將在資料工程師所在的區域中建 立資源。此資料管線應僅能存取資料工程師所在區域的資料。該管線使用 ActiveDirectory作為身分識別與驗證系統。此管線使用自訂的身分識別代理應 用程式，以驗證員工已登入ActiveDirectory，並透過呼叫AssumeRoleAPI作 業來取得臨時憑證。 哪種解決方案能以最小的管理努力滿足地域性要求？

A.text: 建立一個具有建立資源權限的IAM角色。為每個區域建立一個政策，確保使用者僅能在該區 域建立資源。當員工取得臨時憑證時，將此政策作為工作階段政策傳遞。

B.text: 分別為每個區域的資料工程師建立IAM角色。指示每位資料工程師透過承擔對應區域專 屬的IAM角色來取得臨時憑證。

C.text: 為每個區域建立一個IAM群組。將所需的IAM政策納入每個IAM群組中。 將使用者新增至每個IAM群組，如此當使用者透過取得臨時憑證登入時，即可依據其所屬的 IAM群組獲得相應的存取權限。

D.text: 建立個別化的IAM政策，允許使用者在特定區域中建立資源。將這些政策指派給每位資 料工程師。允許使用者在登入AWS時承擔其個別指派的角色。

en_question: A company needs a solution to automatically ingest data from an Amazon S3 bucket to an Amazon Redshift table every day. The company must obfuscate sensitive data in Amazon Redshift. Users must not be able to view the sensitive data as plaintext. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Enable Amazon Macie for the company's AWS account. Configure a sensitive data discovery job for the S3 bucket. Configure an AWS Glue job to load the data into Amazon Redshift.

B.text: Enable Amazon Macie for the company's AWS account. Configure an AWS Glue job to flag and obfuscate data columns based on the Macie analysis. Load the data into Amazon Redshift.

C.text: Configure an AWS Glue job to read the data from the S3 bucket, detect and obfuscate sensitive data, and load the data into Amazon Redshift.

D.text: Configure an AWS Glue job to load the data into Amazon Redshift. Use Amazon Redshift to detect the sensitive data, create masking policies, and apply dynamic masking.

zh_question: 某公司需要一種解決方案，能夠每天自動將資料從AmazonS3儲存桶匯入至 AmazonRedshift資料表。該公司必須在AmazonRedshift中對敏感資料進行 混淆處理，確保使用者無法以純文字形式檢視這些敏感資料。 哪項解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 為公司的AWS帳戶啟用AmazonMacie。設定敏感資料探索 工作以針對S3儲存貯桶進行。設定AWSGlue工作，將資料載入AmazonRedshift。

B.text: 為公司的AWS帳戶啟用AmazonMacie。設定AWSGlue工作，根據Macie分析結果標記並 混淆資料欄位。將資料載入AmazonRedshift。

C.text: 設定AWSGlue工作以從S3儲存桶讀取資料，偵測並混淆 敏感資料 , 並將資料載入AmazonRedshift。

D.text: 設定AWSGlue工作以將資料載入AmazonRedshift。使用AmazonRedshift偵測敏 感資料、建立遮罩原則，並套用動態遮罩。

en_question: A company needs to aggregate and filter a large amount of streaming data in real-time with low latency. The company needs to store the data in Amazon S3 for analysis. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

A.text: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams with provisioned capacity and AWS Lambda functions to perform custom transformations and to integrate with Amazon S3.

B.text: Use Amazon Data Firehose with built-in data transformations. Deliver the data directly to Amazon S3.

C.text: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams and Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink to perform complex processing and to integrate with Amazon S3.

D.text: Use Amazon Data Firehose and AWS Lambda functions to perform custom transformations and to deliver the data to Amazon S3.

zh_question: 一家公司需要以低延遲即時彙總並過濾大量串流資料。該公司需要將資料儲存於 AmazonS3以供分析。 哪種解決方案能以最符合營運效率的方式滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用具有預置容量的AmazonKinesisDataStreams與AWSLambda函數，以 執行自訂轉換並與AmazonS3整合。

B.text: 使用AmazonDataFirehose及其內建的資料轉換功能。將資料直接遞送至 AmazonS3。

C.text: 使用AmazonKinesisDataStreams和AmazonManagedServicefor ApacheFlink執行複雜處理，並與AmazonS3整合。

D.text: 使用AmazonDataFirehose和AWSLambda函式執行自訂轉換，並將資料遞送至 AmazonS3。

en_question: A company is developing machine learning (ML) models. A data engineer needs to apply data quality rules to training data. The company stores the training data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Create an AWS Lambda function to check data quality and to raise exceptions in the code. Run the function when data is added to the S3 bucket. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm for exceptions in the code.

B.text: Create an AWS Glue DataBrew project for the data in the S3 bucket. Create a ruleset for the data quality rules. Create a profile job to run the data quality rules. Use Amazon EventBridge to run the profile job when data is added to the S3 bucket.

C.text: Create an Amazon EMR provisioned cluster. Add a Python open source data quality package to the EMR cluster. Use the Python package to write code for data quality rules and to copy the data from the S3 bucket to the EMR cluster. Copy the data from the S3 bucket to the EMR cluster. Run the data quality rules.
