D.text: Create AWS Lambda functions to evaluate data quality rules. Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate a workflow that publishes notifications when the data fails to meet data quality rules.

zh_question: 一家公司正在開發機器學習(ML)模型。資料工程師需要將資料品質規則套用至 訓練資料。該公司將訓練資料儲存在AmazonS3儲存貯桶中。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 建立AWSLambda函數以檢查資料品質並在程式碼中引發例外。當資料新增至S3儲存貯體 時執行該函數。針對程式碼中的例外建立AmazonCloudWatch警示。

B.text: 為S3儲存貯體中的資料建立AWSGlueDataBrew專案。建立資料品質規則的規則集。建 立設定檔作業以執行資料品質規則。使用AmazonEventBridge在資料新增至S3儲存貯體時 執行設定檔作業。

C.text: 建立AmazonEMR預置叢集。將Python開放原始碼資料品質套件新增至EMR叢集。使 用該Python套件撰寫資料品質規則的程式碼，並將 資料從S3儲存貯體複製至EMR叢集。將資料從S3儲存貯體複製至EMR叢集。執行資料品質 規則。

D.text: 建立AWSLambda函數以評估資料品質規則。使用AWSStepFunctions協調工作流 程，以便在資料未符合資料品質規則時發布通知。

en_question: A data engineer needs to analyze time-sensitive sales data. The company stores the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The data engineer uses AWS Glue Data Catalog to access the data. When the data engineer performs the analysis, the data engineer notices that some records are missing or out of date. What is the likely cause of these issues?

A.text: AWS Glue Data Catalog is not up to date with the latest S3 partition changes.

B.text: Incorrect IAM roles are assigned to the AWS Glue jobs.

C.text: Versioning is not enabled on the S3 bucket.

D.text: The AWS Glue job schedules overlap with one another.

zh_question: 一名資料工程師需要分析對時間敏感的銷售資料。該公司將資料儲存在A mazonS3儲存桶中。該資料工程師使用AWSGlueDataCatalog來存取這些資 料。 當該資料工程師執行分析時，發現部分記錄遺失或過時。 造成這些問題的可能原因為何？

A.text: AWSGlueDataCatalog未與最新的S3分割區變更保持同步。

B.text: 指派給AWSGlue工作的IAM角色不正確。

C.text: 未在S3儲存貯桶上啟用版本控制。

D.text: AWSGlue工作排程彼此重疊。

en_question: A retail company stores point-of-sale transaction data in an Amazon RDS for MySQL database. The company maintains historical sales analytics in Amazon Redshift. The company needs to create daily reports that combine the current day's transactions with historical sales patterns for trend analysis. The company requires a solution that provides near real-time insights while minimizing data transfer costs and maintenance overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Configure AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to continuously replicate data from RDS for MySQL to Amazon Redshift. Use Redshift queries to create consolidated reports.

B.text: Implement Amazon Redshift federated queries to directly access RDS for MySQL data and join it with existing Redshift tables in a single query.

C.text: Use AWS Glue to create an extract, transform, and load (ETL) pipeline that runs every hour to copy incremental data from RDS for MySQL to Amazon Redshift. Generate reports.

D.text: Export RDS for MySQL data to an Amazon S3 bucket on a regular schedule. Use the COPY command to load the data into Amazon Redshift staging tables. Join the data with historical data.

zh_question: 一家零售公司將銷售點交易資料儲存在AmazonRDSforMySQL資料庫中。該 公司在AmazonRedshift中維護歷史銷售分析資料。該公司需要建立每日報表， 結合當日的交易與歷史銷售模式以進行趨勢分析。該公司需要一種解決方案，能提 供近乎即時的洞察，同時將資料傳輸成本與維護負擔降至最低。 哪項解決方案能符合這些需求？

A.text: 設定AWSDatabaseMigrationService(AWSDMS)以持續將資料從 RDSforMySQL複製到AmazonRedshift。使用Redshift查詢來建立整合報表。

B.text: 實作AmazonRedshift聯邦查詢，直接存取RDSforMySQL資料並 在單一查詢中將其與現有的Redshift資料表進行聯結。

C.text: 使用AWSGlue建立提取、轉換和載入(ETL)管線，每小時執行一次，將來自RDSfor MySQL的增量資料複製到AmazonRedshift。產生報表。

D.text: 定期將RDSforMySQL資料匯出至AmazonS3儲存桶。使用COPY指令將資料載入 AmazonRedshift暫存資料表。將資料與歷史資料進行聯結。

en_question: A company is creating a new data pipeline to populate a data lake. A data analyst needs to prepare and standardize the data before a data engineering team can perform advanced data transformations. The data analyst needs a solution to process the data that does not require writing new code. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

A.text: Use Python and Pandas in an AWS Glue Studio notebook. Ensure that the data engineers add additional transformations to complete the pipeline.

B.text: Use Amazon SageMaker Canvas and SageMaker Data Wrangler to write to a new dataset. Ensure that the data engineers add additional transformations to complete the pipeline by using AWS Glue.

C.text: Use AWS Glue Studio with data preparation recipe transformations. Ensure that the data engineers add additional transformations to complete the pipeline.

D.text: Create a document that includes the data preparation rules. Ensure that the data engineers implement the rules in AWS Glue.

zh_question: 一家公司正在建立新的資料管線以充實資料湖。在資料工程團隊執行進階資料 轉換之前，資料分析師需要先準備並標準化資料。該資料分析師需要一種無需 編寫新程式碼即可處理資料的解決方案。 哪項解決方案能以最少的工作量滿足這些需求？

A.text: 在AWSGlueStudio筆記本中使用Python和Pandas。確保資料工程師新增其他轉換以完 成管線。

B.text: 使用AmazonSageMakerCanvas和SageMakerDataWrangler寫入新資料集。確 保資料工程師使用AWSGlue新增其他轉換以完成管線。

C.text: 使用具有資料準備食譜轉換功能的AWSGlueStudio。確保資料工程師新增其他轉換以 完成管線。

D.text: 建立一份包含資料準備規則的文件。確保資料工程師在AWSGlue中實作這些規則。

en_question: A company uses an Amazon RDS for Oracle database to store data for an ecommerce application. The company needs a solution to make the data in all tables available for future analytics. The solution must process data from a table named customer_complaints in near real time by using a REST API. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

A.text: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to replicate the Oracle database to an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL database instance. Create an AWS Lambda function to process data from the PostgreSQL customer_complaints table and to call the REST API.

B.text: Create a task in AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to replicate the Oracle database to Amazon Redshift. Set the Oracle database as the source. Configure an AWS Lambda function to use the Amazon Redshift Data API to query the data from the customer_complaints table and to call the REST API. Unload the data from Amazon Redshift to Amazon S3.

C.text: Set up one AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) task to stream the customer_complaints table data to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Set up a second AWS DMS task to send data to an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure an AWS Lambda function to process Kinesis data and to call the REST API.

D.text: Create a read replica of the Amazon RDS for Oracle database. Configure an AWS Lambda function to process data from the read replica customer_complaints table and to call the REST API.

zh_question: 一家公司使用適用於Oracle的AmazonRDS資料庫來儲存電子商務應用程式 的資料。該公司需要一種解決方案，使所有表中的資料可用於未來的分析。此解 決方案必須透過RESTAPI，以近乎即時的方式處理名為customer_ complaints的表中的資料。 哪種解決方案能以最具成本效益的方式滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用AWSDatabaseMigrationService(AWSDMS)將Oracle資料庫複製到Amazon RDSforPostgreSQL資料庫執行個體。建立一個AWSLambda函式，用於處理來自 PostgreSQL客戶_投訴表的資料，並呼叫RESTAPI。

B.text: 在AWSDatabaseMigrationService(AWSDMS)中建立任務，將Oracle資料庫複製 到AmazonRedshift。將Oracle資料庫設定為來源。設定AWSLambda函式以使用 AmazonRedshiftDataAPI查詢來自customer_complaints資料表的資料，並呼叫REST API。將資料從AmazonRedshift卸載至AmazonS3。

C.text: 設定一個AWSDatabaseMigrationService(AWSDMS)任務，將customer_ complaints資料表的資料串流至AmazonKinesisDataStreams。設定第二個AWS DMS任務，將資料傳送至AmazonS3儲存貯體。設定AWSLambda函式以處理 Kinesis資料並呼叫RESTAPI。」

D.text: 建立AmazonRDSforOracle資料庫的唯讀複本。設定AWSLambda 函式用於處理來自唯讀複本customer_complaints表的資料，並呼叫REST API.

en_question: A company maintains a central Amazon Redshift data warehouse that aggregates daily transactional data from Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL and Amazon Aurora MySQL. A data engineer notices that some complex transformation queries take hours to finish. The data engineer wants to optimize query performance to reduce query execution time as much as possible. Which solution will meet this requirement?

A.text: Increase the concurrency scaling quota for the Redshift cluster.

B.text: Export the tables to an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Athena to query the data in the bucket.

C.text: Use Amazon Redshift Spectrum to create external tables based on the Redshift tables.

D.text: Use materialized views in Amazon Redshift for frequently queried data patterns.

zh_question: 一家公司維護著一個中央AmazonRedshift資料倉儲，用於彙整來自 AmazonRDSforPostgreSQL和AmazonAuroraMySQL的每日交易 資料。一位資料工程師發現，某些複雜的轉換查詢需要耗費數小時才能完 成。該資料工程師希望最佳化查詢效能，以盡可能縮短查詢執行時間。 哪項解決方案能符合此需求？

A.text: 提高Redshift叢集的並行擴展配額。

B.text: 將表格匯出至AmazonS3儲存桶。使用AmazonAthena查詢儲存桶中的資料。

C.text: 使用AmazonRedshiftSpectrum根據Redshift表格建立外部表格。

D.text: 在AmazonRedshift中針對經常查詢的資料模式使用實體化檢視表。

en_question: A company uses an Amazon S3 bucket to integrate multiple data sources into a central data lake. The company needs to perform multiple transformations and data cleaning processes on the data to make the data accessible to business partners. The company needs a solution that will give multiple business partners the ability to run SQL queries on the central data lake during normal business hours. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

A.text: Use a provisioned Amazon EMR cluster after normal business hours to process the previous day's data, apply all necessary transformations, and load the prepared data into Amazon Redshift Serverless.

B.text: Use an AWS Glue Flex Job after normal business hours to process the previous day's data, apply all necessary transformations. and load the prepared data into Amazon Redshift Serverless.

C.text: Use an AWS Lambda function after normal business hours to process the previous day's data, apply all necessary transformations, and load the prepared data into an Amazon Redshift provisioned cluster.

D.text: Use an AWS Glue Flex job after normal business hours to process the previous day's data, apply all necessary transformations, and load the prepared data into an Amazon Redshift provisioned cluster.

zh_question: 一家公司使用AmazonS3儲存桶將多個資料來源整合至中央資料湖。該公司需 要對資料執行多項轉換與資料清理流程，以使業務合作夥伴能夠存取這些資料。 該公司需要一種解決方案，讓多位業務合作夥伴能在正常營業時間內對中央 資料湖執行SQL查詢。 哪種解決方案能以最具成本效益的方式滿足這些需求？

A.text: 在正常營業時間過後，使用已預配的AmazonEMR叢集處理前一天的資料、套用所有必要 的轉換，並將準備好的資料載入AmazonRedshiftServerless。

B.text: 在正常營業時間過後，使用AWSGlueFlexJob處理前一天的資料、套用所有必要的轉換， 並將準備好的資料載入AmazonRedshiftServerless。

C.text: 在正常營業時間過後，使用AWSLambda函數處理前一天的資料、套用所有必要的轉換，並 將準備好的資料載入已預配的AmazonRedshift叢集。

D.text: 在正常營業時間過後，使用AWSGlueFlexJob處理前一天的資料、套用所有必要的轉 換，並將準備好的資料載入已預配的AmazonRedshift叢集。

en_question: A company needs to build an extract, transform, and load (ETL) pipeline that has separate stages for batch data ingestion, transformation, and storage. The pipeline must store the transformed data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Each stage must automatically retry failures. The pipeline must provide visibility into the success or failure of individual stages. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Chain AWS Glue jobs that perform each stage together by using job triggers. Set the MaxRetries field to 0.

B.text: Deploy AWS Step Functions workflows to orchestrate AWS Lambda functions that ingest data. Use AWS Glue jobs to transform the data and store the data in the S3 bucket.

C.text: Build an Amazon EventBridge based pipeline that invokes AWS Lambda functions to perform each stage.

D.text: Schedule Apache Airflow directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) on Amazon Manages Workflows tor Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA) to orchestrate pipeline steps. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to ingest data. Use AWS Glue jobs to transform data and store the data in the S3 bucket.

zh_question: 一家公司需要建置一個提取、轉換和載入(ETL)管線，該管線需具備獨立的階段， 用於批次資料擷取、轉換和儲存。此管線必須將轉換後的資料儲存在Amazon S3儲存貯體中。每個階段必須自動重試失敗的作業。此外，該管線必須提供對 各個階段成功或失敗狀況的可見度。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用工作觸發器串接執行各階段的AWSGlue工作。將MaxRetries欄位設定為0。

B.text: 部署AWSStepFunctions工作流程以協調用於擷取資料的AWSLambda函式。使用 AWSGlue工作來轉換資料並將資料儲存至S3儲存貯體。

C.text: 建置一個基於AmazonEventBridge的管線，呼叫AWSLambda函式以執行每個階段。

D.text: 在AmazonManagedWorkflowsforApacheAirflow(AmazonMWAA)上排程 ApacheAirflow有向無環圖(DAG)，以協調管線步驟。使用AmazonSimpleQueue Service(AmazonSQS)來攝取資料。使用AWSGlue工作來轉換資料，並將資料儲存至S3儲 存桶。

en_question: A company needs to implement a data mesh architecture in which domains for trading, risk, and compliance teams each have own their data. The teams need to share specific views with one another. The teams have over 1,000 tables across 50 databases in AWS Glue Data Catalog. All three teams use Amazon Athena to perform on-demand analysis. The teams use Amazon Redshift to generate complex reports. The compliance team must audit all data access. Access to personally identifiable information (PII) data must be restricted. The company requires a scalable solution to meet the team requirements. The solution must provide the ability to perform analysis across team domains. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Create views in Athena for on-demand analysis. Use the Athena views in Amazon Redshift to perform cross-domain analytics. Use AWS CloudTrail to audit data access. Use AWS Lake Formation to establish fine-grained access control.

B.text: Use AWS Glue Data Catalog views to perform analysis. Use AWS CloudTrail logs to audit data access. Use AWS Lake Formation to manage access permissions. Use security definer views to mask PII.

C.text: Use AWS Lake Formation to set up cross-domain access to tables. Set up fine-grained access controls.

D.text: Create materialized views and enable Amazon Redshift datashares for each domain. Configure cross-domain access policies.

zh_question: 某公司需要實作資料網格架構，其中交易、風險與合規團隊各自擁有其領域的資 料。這些團隊需要彼此共用特定的檢視畫面。這些團隊在AWSGlueData Catalog中擁有超過1,000個表格，分佈於50個資料庫中。這三個團隊皆使用 AmazonAthena執行隨需分析，並使用AmazonRedshift產生複雜報表。合 規團隊必須稽核所有資料存取行為，且對個人識別資訊（PII）資料的存取必須受 到限制。 公司需要一個可擴展的解決方案以滿足團隊需求。該解決方案必須提供跨團隊網 域執行分析的能力。 哪項解決方案能符合這些需求？

A.text: 在Athena中建立視圖以供隨需分析。在AmazonRedshift中使用Athena視圖執行跨網 域分析。使用AWSCloudTrail審計資料存取。使用AWSLakeFormation建立細粒度存取 控制。

B.text: 使用AWSGlueDataCatalog視圖執行分析。使用AWSCloudTrail日誌審計資料存取。 使用AWSLakeFormation管理存取權限。使用安全定義者視圖遮蔽個人識別資訊（PII）。

C.text: 使用AWSLakeFormation設定跨網域的資料表存取。設定細粒度存取控制。

D.text: 建立實體化檢視表，並為每個網域啟用AmazonRedshift資料共享。 設定跨網域存取原則。

en_question: A company stores data in Amazon S3 and Amazon RDS. The company needs to apply technical controls to meet security requirements. The company must generate backups of the data and retain the backups for specified retention periods. The company must protect the backups from accidental or malicious deletion during the retention periods. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Create S3 buckets with versioning and MFA Delete enabled. Set a backup retention period and backup window for each RDS DB instance. Use the automated backup feature of Amazon RDS, and take additional snapshots as required.

B.text: Create S3 buckets with versioning and Same-Region Replication enabled. Set a backup retention period and backup window for each RDS DB instance. Use the automated backup feature of Amazon RDS. Take additional snapshots as required.

C.text: Create a backup plan in AWS Backup. Specify the backup schedule, set window and lifecycle values, and select a backup vault. Assign the Amazon S3 and Amazon RDS resources to the backup plan. Create a vault lock in compliance mode.

D.text: Create S3 buckets with versioning and Cross-Region Replication enabled. Set a backup retention period and backup window for each RDS DB instance. Use Amazon RDS automated backups. Take additional snapshots as required.

zh_question: 一家公司將資料儲存在AmazonS3和AmazonRDS中。該公司需要實施技術 控制措施以符合安全要求。該公司必須產生資料備份，並依規定的保留期限保 存這些備份。此外，該公司必須在保留期間內保護備份，防止其遭到意外或惡 意刪除。 哪項解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 建立啟用版本控制與多因素認證(MFA)刪除功能的S3儲存貯體。為每個RDS資料庫執行 個體設定備份保留期間與備份視窗。使用AmazonRDS的自動備份功能，並視需要採取額外 快照。

B.text: 建立啟用版本控制與同區域複寫功能的S3儲存貯體。為每個RDS資料庫執行個體設定 備份保留期間與備份視窗。使用AmazonRDS的自動備份功能，並視需要採取額外快照。

C.text: 在AWSBackup中建立備份計畫。指定備份排程、設定視窗與生命週期值，並選取備份保存 庫。將AmazonS3與AmazonRDS資源指派至該備份計畫。以合規模式建立保存庫鎖定。

D.text: 建立啟用版本控制與跨區域複寫功能的S3儲存貯體。為每個RDS資料庫執行個體設定備 份保留期間與備份視窗。使用AmazonRDS自動備份功能，並視需要採取額外快照。

en_question: A data engineer uploads confidential documents to an Amazon S3 bucket every day. The data engineer requires a solution to independently verify the integrity of all uploaded data to confirm that there was no corruption during the transfer process. Which solution will meet this requirement?

A.text: Download a subset of the data after the data is uploaded to the S3 bucket. Manually validate the objects for integrity.

B.text: Change the default encryption on the S3 bucket to server-side encryption with customer- provided keys (SSE-

C.text: . Turn on S3 bucket keys to validate data integrity. C) Calculate the SHA-256 checksum for the objects before uploading the objects. Pass the calculated value to the AWS SDK in each upload request.

D.text: Download the complete data after the data is uploaded to the S3 bucket. Programmatically validate the objects for integrity.

zh_question: 一名資料工程師每天將機密文件上傳至AmazonS3儲存桶。該資料工程師需要一 種解決方案，以獨立驗證所有上傳資料的完整性，確認傳輸過程中未發生損毀。 哪項解決方案能符合此需求？

A.text: 在資料上傳至S3儲存貯體後，下載部分資料。手動驗證物件的完整性。

B.text: 將S3儲存貯體的預設加密變更為使用客戶提供金鑰的伺服器端加密(SSE‑

C.text: 。啟用S3儲 存貯體金鑰以驗證資料完整性。 C)在上傳物件前計算其SHA‑256檢查總和。在每次上傳請求中將計算出的值傳遞給 AWSSDK。

D.text: 在資料上傳至S3儲存貯體後，下載完整資料。以程式方式驗證物件的完整性。

en_question: A company needs to optimize storage for an Amazon S3 bucket. Objects older than 1 year must be accessible within 5 hours. All versions of the objects must be retained and immutable for 7 years. All versions of the objects must use the write-once-read-many (WORM) model. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Configure S3 Versioning on the bucket and use the S3 Intelligent-Tiering storage class. Configure a lifecycle policy for the bucket to transition objects that are older than 1 year to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval. Configure the policy to delete objects that are older than 7 years.

B.text: Configure S3 Object Lock on the bucket and use the S3 Intelligent-Tiering storage class. Configure a lifecycle policy for the bucket to transition objects that are older than 1 year to S3 Glacier Deep Archive. Configure the policy to delete objects that are older than 7 years.

C.text: Configure S3 Object Lock on the bucket and use the S3 Intelligent-Tiering storage class. Configure a lifecycle policy for the bucket to transition objects that are older than 1 year to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval. Configure the policy to delete objects that are older than 7 years.

D.text: Configure S3 Versioning on the bucket and use the S3 Intelligent-Tiering storage class. Configure a lifecycle policy for the bucket to transition objects that are older than 1 year to S3 Glacier Deep Archive. Configure the policy to deletes objects that are older than 7 years.

zh_question: 公司需要最佳化AmazonS3儲存桶的儲存空間。超過1年的物件必須在5小時 內可存取。所有物件版本必須保留並不可變更達7年。所有物件版本必須使用一 次寫入、多次讀取(WORM)模型。 哪種解決方案能符合這些需求？

A.text: 在儲存貯體上設定S3版本控制，並使用S3智慧分層儲存類別。 為儲存桶設定生命週期原則，將超過1年的物件轉換至S3 GlacierFlexibleRetrieval。設定原則以刪除超過7年的物件。

B.text: 在儲存桶上設定S3物件鎖定，並使用S3Intelligent‑Tiering儲存類別。 為儲存桶設定生命週期原則，將超過1年的物件轉換至S3 GlacierDeepArchive。設定原則以刪除超過7年的物件。

C.text: 在儲存貯桶上設定S3物件鎖定，並使用S3Intelligent‑Tiering儲存層級。為儲存貯桶設定 生命週期原則，將超過1年的物件轉換至S3GlacierFlexibleRetrieval。設定原則以刪除超 過7年的物件。

D.text: 在儲存貯桶上設定S3版本控制，並使用S3Intelligent‑Tiering儲存層級。 為儲存貯桶設定生命週期原則，將超過1年的物件轉換至S3 GlacierDeepArchive。設定原則以刪除超過7年的物件。

en_question: A data engineer needs to deploy a complex pipeline. The stages of the pipeline must be able to run a script. The data engineer must use only fully managed and serverless services in the pipeline. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Deploy AWS Glue jobs and workflows. Use AWS Glue to run the jobs and workflows on a schedule.

B.text: Use Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA) to build and schedule the pipeline.

C.text: Deploy the script to Amazon EC2 instances. Use Amazon EventBridge to run the script on a schedule.

D.text: Use Aws Glue DataBrew to build the pipeline. Use Amazon EventBridge to run the pipeline on a schedule.

zh_question: 一名資料工程師需要部署一個複雜的管線。該管線的各個階段必須能夠執行腳本。 資料工程師在管線中只能使用完全託管且無伺服器的服務。 哪種解決方案符合這些需求？

A.text: 部署AWSGlue任務與工作流程。使用AWSGlue依排程執行這些任務與工作流程。

B.text: 使用AmazonManagedWorkflowsforApacheAirflow(AmazonMWAA)來建置並 排程該管線。

C.text: 將腳本部署至AmazonEC2執行個體。使用AmazonEventBridge依排程執行該腳本。

D.text: 使用AwsGlueDataBrew來建置該管線。使用AmazonEventBridge依排程執行該管線。

en_question: A company needs to optimize storage costs for an Amazon S3 bucket. The S3 bucket receives 10 million objects every day. The objects range in size from 2 KB to 5 MB. The objects need to be immediately accessible for the first 60 days. Users access objects infrequently from 61 to 180 days. The objects must be accessible within an hour from 181 to 365 days. The company can delete the objects after 365 days. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Use S3 Intelligent-Tiering to automatically transition objects. Select the Archive Access tier for Intelligent-Tiering. Configure an S3 bucket policy to expire objects that are older than 365 days.

B.text: Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to move objects. Configure the policy to move objects from S3 Standard to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 60 days. Move the objects to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 180 days. Expire objects after 365 days.

C.text: Enable S3 Inventory. Use a daily inventory report to configure an S3 Batch Operations job that moves objects from S3 Standard to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 60 days. Move objects to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 180 days. Expire objects after 365 days.

D.text: Enable S3 Inventory. Run an AWS Lambda function each day to fetch an inventory report and move objects from S3 Standard to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 60 days. Move objects to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 180 days. Expire objects after 365 days.

zh_question: 一家公司需要優化AmazonS3儲存桶的儲存成本。該S3儲存桶每天接收1,000 萬個物件。這些物件的大小介於2KB到5MB之間。這些物件在前60天內必須 可立即存取。使用者在第61天到第180天期間偶爾存取物件。從第181天到第 365天，物件必須在一小時內可存取。公司可以在365天後刪除這些物件。 哪種解決方案能符合這些需求？

A.text: 使用S3Intelligent‑Tiering自動轉移物件。為Intelligent‑Tiering選擇Archive Access層級。設定S3儲存桶原則，以過期超過365天的物件。

B.text: 建立S3生命週期原則以移動物件。設定該原則，在60天後將物件從S3Standard移至 S3Standard‑InfrequentAccess（S3Standard‑IA）。在180天後將物件移至S3 GlacierFlexibleRetrieval。在365天後過期物件。

C.text: 啟用S3Inventory。使用每日庫存報告來設定一個S3BatchOperations工作，以 在60天後將物件從S3Standard移至S3Standard‑InfrequentAccess（S3Standard‑IA）。 在180天後將物件移至S3GlacierFlexibleRetrieval。在365天後讓物件過期。

D.text: 啟用S3Inventory。每天執行一個AWSLambda函式來取得庫存報告，並 在60天後將物件從S3Standard移至S3Standard‑InfrequentAccess（S3Standard‑IA）。 在180天後將物件移至S3GlacierFlexibleRetrieval。在365天後讓物件過期。

en_question: A company needs to use an Aws Glue PySpark job to read specific data from an Amazon DynamoDB table. The company knows the partition key values for the required records. The existing processing logic of the AWS Glue PySpark job requires the data to be in DynamicFrame format. The company needs a solution to ensure that the job reads only the specified data. Which solution will meet this requirement with the MINIMUM number of read capacity units (RCUs)?

A.text: Use the AWS Glue DynamoDB ETL connector to read the DynamoDB table. Use the filter option to read the required partition key.

B.text: Perform a query on the DynamoDB table in the AWS Glue job by using only the sort key in the key condition expression. Load the data into a DynamicFrame.

C.text: Perform a scan on the DynamoDB table in the Aws Glue job. Put the data into a DynamicFrame. Filter the DynamicFrame on the partition key.

D.text: Perform a query on the DynamoDB table in the AWS Glue job. Use the partition key in the key condition expression. Put the data into a DynamicFrame.

zh_question: 一家公司需要使用AWSGluePySpark工作從AmazonDynamoDB資料表中 讀取特定資料。該公司已知所需記錄的分割鍵值。現有的AWSGluePySpark工 作處理邏輯要求資料必須為DynamicFrame格式。該公司需要一種解決方案， 以確保工作僅讀取指定的資料。 哪種解決方案能以最少的讀取容量單位(RCU)滿足此需求？

A.text: 使用AWSGlueDynamoDBETL連接器讀取DynamoDB資料表。使用篩選 選項來讀取所需的分割鍵。

B.text: 在AWSGlue工作中對DynamoDB資料表執行查詢，僅在 索引鍵條件表達式中使用排序鍵。將資料載入至動態框架(DynamicFrame)。

C.text: 在AWSGlue工作中對DynamoDB資料表執行掃描。將資料放入 DynamicFrame。根據分割鍵過濾DynamicFrame。

D.text: 在AWSGlue工作中對DynamoDB資料表執行查詢。在鍵條件表達式中使用分割鍵。將 資料放入DynamicFrame。

en_question: A company runs a multi-tenant Amazon EMR cluster on Amazon EC2 instances. Multiple teams perform interactive query analyses and data transformations on the data in the EMR cluster. The teams can access the cluster only through EMR Studio workspaces and EMR steps. The teams need to use EMR steps to run Apache Spark jobs to fetch data from an Amazon DynamoDB table. The DynamoDB table contains confidential data that must be accessible to only one specific team. The company needs to ensure that only the appropriate team can access the confidential data in the EMR cluster. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Set up runtime roles for EMR steps.

B.text: Set up AWS Lake Formation permissions.

C.text: Set up IAM roles for EMR File System (EMRFS) requests.

D.text: Set up a DynamoDB resource-based policy.

zh_question: 一家公司在AmazonEC2執行個體上運行多租戶的AmazonEMR叢集。多個團 隊在該EMR叢集的資料上執行互動式查詢分析與資料轉換。這些團隊僅能透過 EMRStudio工作區和EMR步驟來存取叢集。 各團隊需要使用EMR步驟來執行ApacheSpark工作，以從Amazon DynamoDB資料表擷取資料。該DynamoDB資料表包含機密資料，僅限特定 團隊存取。公司需要確保只有適當的團隊才能存取EMR叢集中的機密資料。 哪種解決方案符合這些需求？

A.text: 設定EMR步驟的執行時期角色。

B.text: 設定AWSLakeFormation權限。

C.text: 設定用於EMR檔案系統(EMRFS)請求的IAM角色。

D.text: 設定DynamoDB資源型原則。

en_question: A company stores Apache Parquet files in an Amazon S3 data lake. The data lake receives thousands of files from multiple sources every hour. The files range in size from 50 KB to 100 KB. The company is evaluating the implementation of Apache Iceberg tables for the data lake. The company is using AWS Glue Data Catalog as part of the evaluation. The company needs a solution to optimize query performance in Iceberg. The solution must ensure that Iceberg table performance does not degrade when more files are added over time. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Use an AWS Glue job to compact the files into a standard size of 512 MB at the end of each day. Run an AWS Glue crawler to update the Data Catalog.

B.text: Configure the Data Catalog to automatically compact the files every minute.

C.text: Configure Iceberg table properties to enable automatic compaction based on thresholds for file size and the number of files.

D.text: Implement a partition strategy in Amazon S3. Run an AWS Glue crawler to update the Data Catalog every 5 minutes.

zh_question: 一家公司將ApacheParquet檔案儲存在AmazonS3資料湖中。該資料湖每小 時接收來自多個來源的數千個檔案，檔案大小介於50KB至100KB之間。 該公司正在評估為資料湖實作ApacheIceberg表格。作為評估的一部分，該公 司使用AWSGlueDataCatalog。該公司需要一種解決方案來最佳化Iceberg中 的查詢效能。該解決方案必須確保隨著時間推移新增更多檔案時，Iceberg表格 的效能不會下降。 哪種解決方案符合這些需求？

A.text: 使用AWSGlue工作，在每天結束時將檔案壓縮成512MB的標準大小。 執行AWSGluecrawler以更新DataCatalog。

B.text: 設定DataCatalog每分鐘自動壓縮檔案。

C.text: 設定Iceberg表格屬性，以根據檔案大小和檔案數量的閾值啟用自動壓縮。

D.text: 在AmazonS3中實作分割策略。每5分鐘執行一次AWSGluecrawler以更新資料目錄。

en_question: A data engineer must maintain and monitor a data pipeline on AWS that processes streaming data from Internet of Things (IoT) devices. The pipeline uses Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to ingest data and Amazon Data Firehose to deliver data to an Amazon S3 bucket. The data engineer needs to monitor the health of the pipeline. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

A.text: Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs to manually review logs that are generated by Kinesis Data Streams and Firehose.

B.text: Configure Amazon CloudWatch alarms to monitor key metrics such as IncomingBytes, OutgoingBytes, and DeliveryToS3.Success for Kinesis Data Streams and Firehose

C.text: Use an AWS Lambda function to run daily checks on the status of the Kinesis Data Streams and Firehose. Configure the Lambda function to use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to send notifications.

D.text: Use Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink to perform near real-time anomaly detection on the streaming data and to invoke alerts if unusual patterns are detected.

zh_question: 資料工程師必須在AWS上維護並監控一個處理來自物聯網(IoT)裝置串流資料 的資料管線。該管線使用AmazonKinesisDataStreams來攝取資料，並使用 AmazonDataFirehose將資料遞送至AmazonS3儲存桶。資料工程師需要監 控該管線的運作狀況。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運工作量滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用AmazonCloudWatchLogs手動檢視由KinesisDataStreams和Firehose產生 的日誌。

B.text: 設定AmazonCloudWatch警報以監控關鍵指標，例如KinesisDataStreams和 Firehose的IncomingBytes、OutgoingBytes和DeliveryToS3.Success

C.text: 使用AWSLambda函式每日檢查KinesisDataStreams和Firehose的狀態。設定該 Lambda函式使用AmazonSimpleNotificationService(AmazonSNS)發送通知。

D.text: 使用AmazonManagedServiceforApacheFlink對串流資料執行近即時異常偵測，並在 偵測到異常模式時觸發警報。

en_question: A company needs a solution to store and query product data that has variable attributes. The solution must support unpredictable and high-volume queries with single-digit millisecond latency, even during sudden traffic spikes. The solution must retrieve items by a primary identifier named Product ID. The solution must allow flexible queries by secondary attributes named Category and Brand. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Use an Amazon DynamoDB table with on-demand capacity to store product data. Store products by primary key. Use global secondary indexes (GSIs) to store secondary attributes.

B.text: Use Amazon Aurora with a Multi-AZ deployment to store product data. Use read replicas. Create indexes for primary and secondary attributes.

C.text: Use an Amazon OpenSearch Serverless cluster with dynamic scaling to store product data. Index product data by primary and secondary attributes.

D.text: Use Amazon ElastiCache (Redis OSS) and Amazon S3 to store product data. Use Amazon Athena to run flexible secondary attribute queries.

zh_question: 某公司需要一種解決方案來儲存和查詢具有可變屬性的產品資料。該解決方案必 須支援不可預測且高容量的查詢，並具備個位數毫秒的延遲，即使在流量突然激 增時亦然。該解決方案必須透過名為「ProductID」的主要識別碼來檢索項目， 並允許透過名為「Category」和「Brand」的次要屬性進行彈性查詢。 哪項解決方案能符合這些需求？

A.text: 使用具有隨需容量的AmazonDynamoDB資料表來儲存產品資料。透過主鍵儲存產品。 使用全域次要索引(GSI)來儲存次要屬性。

B.text: 使用具有多可用區域部署的AmazonAurora來儲存產品資料。使用唯讀複本。 為主要和次要屬性建立索引。

C.text: 使用具有動態擴展功能的AmazonOpenSearchServerless叢集來儲存產品資料。 依主要與次要屬性建立產品資料索引。

D.text: 使用AmazonElastiCache(RedisOSS)與AmazonS3儲存產品資料。使用 AmazonAthena執行彈性的次要屬性查詢。

en_question: A company is uploading log files from on-premises servers to an Amazon S3 bucket. The company needs to validate that the logs from the on-premises server are the same as the logs that are stored in the S3 bucket. Which solution will meet this requirement?

A.text: Use the AWS SDK to automatically compute CRC32 checksums during the upload. Store the checksums in S3 object metadata.

B.text: Create an AWS Lambda function to calculate SHA-256 checksums. Store results in a separate metadata table. Validate the logs after the upload.

C.text: Enable S3 Object Lock in compliance mode on the S3 bucket. Upload the objects to the bucket.

D.text: After uploading the objects to the S3 bucket, enable S3 Object Lock in governance mode on the S3 objects.

zh_question: 一家公司正在將日誌檔案從內部部署伺服器上傳至AmazonS3儲存貯體。該 公司需要驗證內部部署伺服器的日誌與儲存在S3儲存貯體中的日誌是否一致。 哪種解決方案能符合此需求？

A.text: 使用AWSSDK在上傳期間自動計算CRC32校驗和。將校驗和儲存於S3物件中繼資料中。

B.text: 建立AWSLambda函式以計算SHA‑256校驗和。將結果儲存至獨立的後設資料表中。上 傳後驗證日誌。

C.text: 在S3儲存貯體上啟用合規模式的S3物件鎖定。將物件上傳至該儲存貯體。

D.text: 將物件上傳至S3儲存貯體後，在S3物件上啟用治理模式的S3物件鎖定。

en_question: An ecommerce company uses AWS Glue ETL to process and analyze orders. The company wants to build an extract, transform, and load (ETL) pipeline that processes placed, shipped, delivered, and canceled orders differently. The company integrates the order processing system with Amazon EventBridge. The company configures EventBridge Scheduler rules for each order status to invoke different AWS Glue workflows. When the company examines Amazon CloudWatch metrics for the workflow, the company notices that the FailedInvocations metric shows a high value for canceled orders. The company must determine the cause of the failed invocations. Which solution will meet this requirement?

A.text: Configure a dead-letter queue in EventBridge Scheduler to store failed events. Analyze the failed order events.

B.text: Use the archive and replay features in EventBridge Scheduler to investigate the issue.

C.text: Change the retry policy in EventBridge Scheduler to reduce the value for maximum retries.

D.text: Change the retry policy in EventBridge Scheduler to increase the value for maximum age of event.

zh_question: 一家電子商務公司使用AWSGlueETL來處理與分析訂單。該公司希望建置一 個提取、轉換和載入(ETL)管線，針對已下單、已出貨、已送達及已取消的訂單 進行差異化處理。 該公司將訂單處理系統與AmazonEventBridge整合。該公司為每種訂單狀態 設定EventBridgeScheduler規則，以呼叫不同的AWSGlue工作流程。當該 公司檢視工作流程的AmazonCloudWatch指標時，發現FailedInvocations 指標對於已取消訂單顯示出高數值。 該公司必須找出導致呼叫失敗的原因。 哪項解決方案能符合此需求？

A.text: 在EventBridgeScheduler中設定死信佇列以儲存失敗的事件。分析失敗的訂單事件。

B.text: 使用EventBridgeScheduler中的歸檔與重播功能來調查此問題。

C.text: 變更EventBridgeScheduler中的重試原則，以降低最大重試次數的值。

D.text: 變更EventBridgeScheduler中的重試原則，以提高最大存續時間的值。 活動。

en_question: A company needs to build a data pipeline to process a 1-TB file from an Amazon S3 bucket. The pipeline needs to create three DataFrames based on business logic. The pipeline must save all three DataFrames to a second S3 bucket in parallel. The company needs to set the pipeline to be the target of an Amazon EventBridge rule that matches file uploads to the source S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST maintenance overhead?

A.text: Configure an Apache Spark Streaming application on Amazon EMR to process data from the S3 source bucket in batches, create DataFrames, and save the output to the destination S3 bucket.

B.text: Configure three AWS Lambda functions to process the business logic and to save the DataFrames to the destination S3 bucket in parallel.

C.text: Configure an AWS Glue workflow to run three AWS Glue jobs in parallel to process the file.

D.text: Configure an AWS Step Functions state machine to initiate an AWS Glue workflow to run three AWS Glue jobs in parallel to process the file.

zh_question: 一家公司需要建置一個資料管線，以處理來自AmazonS3儲存桶的1TB檔案。 該管線需根據業務邏輯建立三個DataFrame。該管線必須將所有三個 DataFrame平行儲存至第二個S3儲存桶。該公司需要將此管線設定為 AmazonEventBridge規則的目標，該規則需比對上傳至來源S3儲存桶的檔案。 哪種解決方案能以最低的維護負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 在AmazonEMR上設定ApacheSparkStreaming應用程式，以處理來自 分批從S3來源儲存桶讀取、建立DataFrame，並將輸出儲存至目的地S3 儲存桶。

B.text: 設定三個AWSLambda函數以處理業務邏輯，並平行將DataFrame儲存至目的地 S3儲存桶。

C.text: 設定一個AWSGlue工作流程，以平行執行三個AWSGlue工作來處理檔案。

D.text: 設定一個AWSStepFunctions狀態機器，以啟動一個AWSGlue工作流程，平行執行 三個AWSGlue工作來處理檔案。

en_question: A company needs to transform IoT sensor data in near real time before the company stores the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The data is available from a data stream in Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. The company needs to apply complex and stateful transformations to the data before the company stores the data. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Schedule AWS Glue ETL jobs to process the data stream.

B.text: Configure an application in Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink to process the data stream.

C.text: Configure an AWS Lambda function to process the data stream.

D.text: Schedule Apache Spark jobs on an Amazon EMR cluster to process the data stream.

zh_question: 一家公司需要在將物聯網感測器資料儲存至AmazonS3儲存桶之前，以近即時 方式轉換該資料。這些資料可從AmazonKinesisDataStreams中的資料串流 取得。 该公司需要在存储数据之前，对数据应用复杂且有状态的转换。 哪种解决方案能以最低的运营开销满足这些要求？

A.text: 排程AWSGlueETL工作来处理数据流。

B.text: 在AmazonManagedServiceforApacheFlink中配置应用程序来处理数据流。（正 确答案）

C.text: 配置AWSLambda函数来处理数据流。

D.text: 在AmazonEMR叢集上排程ApacheSpark工作以處理資料串流。

en_question: A company stores time-series data that is collected from streaming services in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company must ensure that only workloads that are deployed within the company’s VPC can access the data. Which solution will meet this requirement?

A.text: Create an S3 bucket policy that uses a condition to allow access only to traffic that originates from the company’s VPC.

B.text: Apply a security group to the S3 bucket that allows connections only from the company's VPC CIDR block.

C.text: Define an IAM policy that denies access to all users unless the request originates from within the company’s VPC.

D.text: Use a network ACL on the VPC subnets to allow only specific resources to access the S3 bucket.

zh_question: 一家公司將從串流服務收集的時間序列資料儲存在AmazonS3儲存桶中。該公 司必須確保只有部署在公司VPC內的工作負載才能存取這些資料。 哪種解決方案能符合此需求？

A.text: 建立一個S3儲存貯桶原則，使用條件來僅允許源自公司VPC的流量存取。

B.text: 將安全群組套用至S3儲存貯存桶，僅允許來自公司VPCCIDR區塊的連線。

C.text: 定義IAM政策，拒絕所有使用者的存取，除非請求源自於 公司的VPC。

D.text: 在VPC子網上使用網路存取控制清單（ACL），僅允許特定資源存取S3 儲存桶。

en_question: A company runs a data platform on AWS. The data platform uses AWS Glue to provide a data catalog and to perform processing. The company notices quality issues in the data. The company needs to implement data quality validations. The validations must include rules for known issues. The validations must have the ability to automatically detect unexpected data quality issues. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operation overhead?

A.text: Use AWS Glue jobs to implement AWS Glue Data Quality validations that include anomaly detection.

B.text: Use AWS Glue jobs to implement data quality rules that use open source data quality frameworks.

C.text: Use AWS Glue DataBrew to profile the data. Configure data quality rules based on the data quality results from the profiling.

D.text: Use AWS Glue jobs to implement data quality validations that use SQL statements.

zh_question: 一家公司在AWS上運行資料平台。該資料平台使用AWSGlue提供資料目錄並 執行處理作業。公司發現資料存在品質問題。 公司需要實作資料品質驗證。這些驗證必須包含針對已知問題的規則，並具備自動 偵測意外資料品質問題的能力。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用AWSGlue工作來實作包含異常偵測功能的AWSGlue資料品質驗證。

B.text: 使用AWSGlue工作來實作採用開放原始碼資料品質框架的資料品質規則。

C.text: 使用AWSGlueDataBrew對資料進行剖析。根據剖析產生的資料品質結果來設定資料品 質規則。

D.text: 使用AWSGlue工作來實作採用SQL陳述式的資料品質驗證。

en_question: A company uses an Amazon S3 Standard bucket to maintain a self-managed transactional data lake that uses Apache Iceberg tables. The data lake ingests data both in real time and in batches. Users report slow performance for real-time tables. A data engineer reviews the real-time tables and notices that the tables are made up of many small data files The data engineer must improve the performance of the real-time tables. Which solution will meet this requirement?

A.text: Expire historic snapshots.

B.text: Archive historic snapshots.

C.text: Delete S3 objects that are not linked from the Iceberg table.

D.text: Apply compaction.

zh_question: 一家公司使用AmazonS3Standard儲存桶來維護一個自行管理的交易資料湖， 該資料湖使用ApacheIceberg表格。此資料湖同時以即時和批次方式匯入資 料。 使用者回報即時表格的效能緩慢。資料工程師檢視即時表格後發現，這些表 格由許多小型資料檔案組成。資料工程師必須提升即時表格的效能。 哪種解決方案能符合此需求？

A.text: 過期歷史快照。

B.text: 歸檔歷史快照。

C.text: 刪除未從Iceberg表格連結的S3物件。

D.text: 套用壓縮。

en_question: An ecommerce company collects daily customer transaction logs in CSV format and stores the logs in Amazon S3. The company uses Amazon Athena to scan a subset of attributes from the logs on the same day the company receives each log. Query times are increasing because of increasing transaction volume. The company wants to improve query performance. Which solution will meet these requirements with the SHORTEST query times?

A.text: Convert the CSV logs into multiple ORC files for better parallelism in Athena. Partition by date in Amazon S3. Use columnar pushdown filters.

B.text: Convert the CSV logs to JSON. Partition by date in Amazon S3. Use Athena with dynamic filtering to reduce data scans.

C.text: Convert the CSV logs to Avro. Partition by date in Amazon S3. Use Athena with projection- based partitioning.

D.text: Convert the CSV logs to a single Apache Parquet file for each day Partition the data by date in Amazon S3. Use Athena with predicate pushdown filters.

zh_question: 一家電子商務公司每日以CSV格式收集客戶交易記錄，並將這些記錄儲存於 AmazonS3。該公司在收到每筆記錄的當天，使用AmazonAthena掃描記錄 中的部分屬性。 由於交易量增加，查詢時間變長。公司希望提升查詢效能。 哪項解決方案能以最短的查詢時間滿足這些需求？

A.text: 將CSV日誌轉換為多個ORC檔案，以提升Athena的平行處理能力。在 AmazonS3中依日期進行分割。使用欄位下推篩選。

B.text: 將CSV日誌轉換為JSON。在AmazonS3中依日期進行分割。使用搭配動態篩選的 Athena以減少資料掃描。

C.text: 將CSV日誌轉換為Avro。在AmazonS3中依日期進行分割。使用帶有基於投影之分割 功能的Athena。

D.text: 將CSV日誌轉換為每天的單一ApacheParquet檔案。在AmazonS3中依日期對資料進 行分割。使用帶有謂詞下推篩選功能的Athena。

en_question: A company stores customer data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company must permanently delete all customer data that is older than 7 years. Which solution will meet this requirement?

A.text: Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to permanently delete objects that are older than 7 years.

B.text: Use Amazon Athena to query the S3 bucket for objects that are older than 7 years. Configure Athena to delete the results.

C.text: Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to move objects that are older than 7 years to S3 Glacier Deep Archive.

D.text: Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to enable S3 Object Lock on all objects that are older than 7 years.

zh_question: 一家公司將客戶資料儲存在AmazonS3儲存貯體中。該公司必須永久刪除所 有超過7年的客戶資料。 哪項解決方案能符合此需求？

A.text: 設定S3生命週期原則，以永久刪除超過7年的物件。

B.text: 使用AmazonAthena查詢S3儲存貯體中超過7年的物件。設定 Athena以刪除結果。

C.text: 設定S3生命週期原則，將超過7年的物件移至S3Glacier DeepArchive。

D.text: 設定S3生命週期原則，以對所有超過7年的物件啟用S3物件鎖定。

en_question: Two data engineering teams use separate AWS accounts. Both teams request access to the same datashare in an Amazon Redshift cluster that is in a third AWS account. The datashare is named salesshare. A data engineer must use the Amazon Redshift SQL interface to grant both data engineering teams' access to the datashare. Which command or commands will meet this requirement?

A.text: GRANT USAGE ON DATASHARE salesshare TO ACCOUNTS ‘’ AND ‘’;

B.text: GRANT USAGE ON DATASHARE salesshare TO NAMESPACES ‘’ AND ‘’;

C.text: GRANT USAGE ON DATASHARE salesshare TO ACCOUNT ‘’; GRANT USAGE ON DATASHARE salesshare TO ACCOUNT ‘’;

D.text: GRANT USAGE ON DATASHARE salesshare TO NAMESPACE ‘’; GRANT USAGE ON DATASHARE salesshare TO NAMESPACE ‘’;

zh_question: 兩個資料工程團隊使用不同的AWS帳戶。這兩個團隊都要求存取位於第三個 AWS帳戶中的AmazonRedshift叢集內的同一個資料共用，該資料共用名為 salesshare。 資料工程師必須使用AmazonRedshiftSQL介面，授予這兩個資料工程團隊對 該資料共用的存取權限。 哪一個或哪些指令符合此需求？

A.text: 將DATASHAREsalesshare的USAGE權限授予帳戶''和'';

B.text: 授予對資料共用salesshare的使用權限給命名空間''和'';

C.text: GRANTUSAGEONDATASHAREsalesshareTOACCOUNT''; GRANTUSAGEONDATASHAREsalesshareTOACCOUNT'';

D.text: GRANTUSAGEONDATASHAREsalesshareTONAMESPACE''; GRANTUSAGEONDATASHAREsalesshareTONAMESPACE'';

en_question: A company regularly loads data into an Amazon DynamoDB table. The company must retain the data in DynamoDB for 1 year. After 1 year, the company must archive the data for 5 years. After 5 years, the company must delete the data. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

A.text: Include a timestamp with the data that is loaded into DynamoDB. Create an AWS Lambda function to read the timestamps and move items that are 1 year old to Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to delete the items after 5 years.

B.text: Enable Amazon DynamoDB Streams. Configure a TTL rule to delete items from the DynamoDB table after 1 year. Use an AWS Lambda function to consume the stream and send items to Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval. Delete the items from S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 5 years.

C.text: Include a timestamp with the data that is loaded into DynamoDB. Use an AWS Lambda function to read timestamps and move items that are 1 year old directly to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive. Configure the function to delete items after 5 years.

D.text: Enable Amazon DynamoDB Streams. Configure a TTL rule to delete items from the DynamoDB table after 1 year. Use an AWS Lambda function to consume the stream and send items directly to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to delete the items after 5 years.

zh_question: 一家公司定期將資料載入AmazonDynamoDB資料表。該公司必須在 DynamoDB中保留資料1年。1年後，該公司必須將資料歸檔5年。5年後，該 公司必須刪除資料。 哪種解決方案能以最具作業效率的方式滿足這些需求？

A.text: 在載入DynamoDB的資料中包含時間戳記。建立AWSLambda函數以讀取時間戳記， 並將滿1年的項目移至AmazonS3GlacierFlexibleRetrieval。建立S3生命週期原則， 在5年後刪除這些項目。

B.text: 啟用AmazonDynamoDBStreams。設定TTL規則，在1年後從DynamoDB資料表 中刪除項目。使用AWSLambda函數消費串流，並將項目傳送至AmazonS3Glacier FlexibleRetrieval。在5年後從S3GlacierFlexibleRetrieval刪除這些項目。

C.text: 在載入DynamoDB的資料中包含時間戳記。使用AWSLambda函數讀取時間戳記，並將 滿1年的項目直接移至AmazonS3GlacierDeepArchive。設定該函數在5年後刪除項目。

D.text: 啟用AmazonDynamoDBStreams。設定TTL規則，在1年後從DynamoDB資料表 中刪除項目。使用AWSLambda函數來消費串流並傳送 項目直接至AmazonS3GlacierDeepArchive。建立S3生命週期原則，在5年後刪除這 些項目。

en_question: A company must retain specific data for 1 year. A data engineer observes that one of the company’s Amazon S3 buckets contains millions of objects that are older than 3 years. Versioning is enabled on the bucket. To reduce costs, the data engineer implements an S3 Lifecycle rule to expire objects after 365 days. The new S3 Lifecycle rule causes the object count to double instead of decrease. Which additional step must the data engineer take to permanently delete the old objects?

A.text: Disable versioning on the S3 bucket.

B.text: Use an AWS Lambda function to run a Python job to identify and delete objects that are older than 365 days.

C.text: Suspend versioning on the S3 bucket.

D.text: Add an additional S3 Lifecycle rule to delete the current and expired versions of objects that are older than 365 days.

zh_question: 公司必須保留特定資料一年。一名資料工程師觀察到，該公司的其中一個 AmazonS3儲存貯桶包含數百萬個超過三年的物件。該儲存貯桶已啟用版本控 制。 為了降低成本，資料工程師實作了S3生命週期規則，以在365天後過期物件。 新的S3生命週期規則導致物件數量加倍而非減少。 資料工程師必須採取哪項額外步驟才能永久刪除舊物件？

A.text: 停用S3貯存桶的版本控制。

B.text: 使用AWSLambda函式執行一個Python工作，以識別並刪除 超過365天的物件。

C.text: 暫停S3儲存桶的版本控制。

D.text: 新增一則S3生命週期規則，以刪除超過365天的目前版本與過期版本的物件。

en_question: A manufacturing company uses AWS Glue jobs to process IoT sensor data to generate predictive maintenance models. A data engineer needs to implement automated data quality checks to identify temperature readings that are outside the expected range of -50°C to 150°C. The data quality checks must also identify records that are missing timestamp values. The data engineer needs a solution that requires minimal coding and can automatically flag the specified issues. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Create an AWS Glue DataBrew project to profile the sensor data Define completeness rules for timestamps. Set up numeric range validation for temperature values.

B.text: Use AWS Glue’s Data Quality rules and machine learning (ML)-based anomaly detection to identify missing timestamps and to detect temperature anomalies.

C.text: Create an AWS Lambda function to scan the sensor data files to validate temperature ranges. Use AWS Glue Data Catalog tables to check timestamp completeness.

D.text: Create an AWS Glue DynamicFrame that uses a custom data quality operator to profile the sensor data. Use Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler transforms to validate timestamps and temperature ranges.

zh_question: 一家製造公司使用AWSGlue任務處理物聯網感測器資料，以生成預測性維護模 型。一位資料工程師需要實作自動化資料品質檢查，以識別超出預期範圍（‑50° C至150°C）的溫度讀數。這些資料品質檢查也必須識別缺少時間戳記值的記錄。 資料工程師需要一個只需極少程式碼撰寫，且能自動標記指定問題的解決 方案。 哪項解決方案符合這些需求？

A.text: 建立AWSGlueDataBrew專案以分析感測器資料；定義時間戳記的完整性規則；設定溫度 數值的數值範圍驗證。

B.text: 使用AWSGlue的「資料品質」規則與基於機器學習(ML)的異常偵測功能，以識別遺漏 的時間戳記並偵測溫度異常。

C.text: 建立AWSLambda函式以掃描感測器資料檔案，驗證溫度範圍。 使用AWSGlueDataCatalog資料表來檢查時間戳記的完整性。

D.text: 建立一個使用自訂資料品質運算子來剖析感測器資料的AWSGlueDyna micFrame。使用AmazonSageMakerDataWrangler轉換來驗證時間戳記和溫度範圍。

en_question: A media company wants to improve a system that recommends media content to customers based on user behavior and preferences. To improve the recommendation system, the company needs to incorporate insights from third- party datasets into the company’s existing analytics platform. The company wants to minimize the effort and time required to incorporate third-party datasets. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Use API calls to access and integrate third-party datasets from AWS Data Exchange.

B.text: Use API calls to access and integrate third-party datasets from AWS DataSync.

C.text: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to access and integrate third-party datasets from a Git repository.

D.text: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to access and integrate third-party datasets from Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR).

zh_question: 一家媒體公司希望改進其根據使用者行為與偏好來推薦媒體內容的系統。為了提升 推薦系統的效能，該公司需要將第三方資料集的洞察整合到現有的分析平台中。 該公司希望最小化整合第三方資料集所需的努力與時間。 哪項解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用API呼叫從AWSDataExchange存取並整合第三方資料集。

B.text: 使用API呼叫從AWSDataSync存取並整合第三方資料集。

C.text: 使用AmazonKinesisDataStreams從Git存取並整合第三方資料集 程式碼儲存庫。

D.text: 使用AmazonKinesisDataStreams來存取並整合來自AmazonElasticContainer Registry(AmazonECR)的第三方資料集。

en_question: A company generates yearly financial statements for customers and stores the statements in an Amazon S3 bucket. Customers rarely access the documents after 1 week. The company must retain the statements for 7 years. The statements must remain readily accessible for customers. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST cost-effective way?

A.text: Create an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 7 days. Expire the objects after 7 years.

B.text: Set the S3 bucket to use S3 Intelligent-Tiering when new objects are uploaded. Set objects to expire after 7 years.

C.text: Create an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition objects to S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval after 7 days. Expire the objects after 7 years.

D.text: Set the S3 bucket to use S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval when new objects are uploaded. Create an AWS Lambda function that runs daily to delete any objects that are older than 7 years.

zh_question: 一家公司每年為客戶生成財務報表，並將這些報表儲存在AmazonS3儲存桶中。 客戶在1週後很少存取這些文件。該公司必須將報表保留7年，且報表必須隨時 可供客戶存取。 哪種解決方案能以最具成本效益的方式滿足這些需求？

A.text: 建立S3生命週期規則，在7天後將物件轉換至S3GlacierDeepArchive。在7年後過期這 些物件。

B.text: 設定S3儲存桶在新物件上傳時使用S3Intelligent‑Tiering。設定物件在7年後過期。

C.text: 建立S3生命週期規則，在7天後將物件轉換至S3GlacierInstantRetrieval。在7年後 過期這些物件。

D.text: 設定S3儲存桶在新物件上傳時使用S3GlacierInstantRetrieval。建立一個每日執行的 AWSLambda函式，以刪除任何超過7年的物件。

en_question: A company runs an extract, transform, and load (ETL) job in AWS Glue. The job processes personally identifiable information (PII) data and writes logs to an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group. A data engineer needs to mask PII data in the CloudWatch logs group. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Attach an AWS Glue security configuration to the ETL job.

B.text: Configure a data protection policy. Attach the policy to the CloudWatch log group.

C.text: Run an Amazon Macie sensitive data discovery job.

D.text: Call AWS Glue sensitive data detection APIs in the ETL job.

zh_question: 一家公司在AWSGlue中執行提取、轉換和載入(ETL)作業。該作業處理個人 識別資訊(PII)資料，並將日誌寫入AmazonCloudWatchLogs日誌群組。資 料工程師需要在CloudWatch日誌群組中遮罩PII資料。 哪種解決方案能符合這些需求？

A.text: 將AWSGlue安全性設定附加至ETL工作。

B.text: 設定資料保護原則。將原則附加至CloudWatch日誌群組。

C.text: 執行AmazonMacie敏感資料探索工作。

D.text: 在ETL作業中呼叫AWSGlue敏感資料偵測API。

en_question: A company creates a new non-production application that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance. The application needs to communicate with an Amazon RDS database instance using Java Database Connectivity (JDBC). The EC2 instances and the RDS database instance are in the same subnet. Which solution will meet this requirement?

A.text: Modify the IAM role that is assigned to the database instance to allow connections from the EC2 instances.

B.text: Modify the ec2_authorized_hosts parameter in the RDS parameter group to include the EC2 instances. Restart the database instance.

C.text: Update the database security group to allow connections from the EC2 instances.

D.text: Enable the Amazon RDS Data API and specify the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the database instance in the JDBC connection string.

zh_question: 一家公司建立了一個新的非生產應用程式，該應用程式執行於AmazonEC2執 行個體上。此應用程式需要使用JavaDatabaseConnectivity(JDBC)與 AmazonRDS資料庫執行個體進行通訊。EC2執行個體與RDS資料庫執行個 體位於同一子網中。 哪種解決方案能符合此需求？

A.text: 修改指派給資料庫實體的IAM角色，以允許來自 EC2實體的連線。

B.text: 修改RDS參數群組中的ec2_authorized_hosts參數，以納入EC2實體。重新啟動資料庫 實體。

C.text: 更新資料庫安全群組以允許來自EC2實體的連線。

D.text: 啟用AmazonRDSDataAPI，並在JDBC連線字串中指定資料庫實體的Amazon資 源名稱(ARN)。

en_question: A retail company wants to implement real-time analytics for an ecommerce platform. The company needs to collect clickstream data from the company's website and mobile apps. The company needs to store the data for analytics. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST ongoing maintenance?

A.text: Use Amazon Data Firehose to ingest the streaming data. Deliver the processed data directly to a provisioned Amazon Redshift cluster.

B.text: Deploy agents on Amazon EC2 instances to collect the streaming data. Use the AWS CLI to periodically batch upload the data to an Amazon S3 bucket.

C.text: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to collect the streaming data. Use Amazon Data Firehose to deliver the data to an Amazon S3 bucket.

D.text: Use an Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK) broker to collect the data. Store the data in an Amazon RDS DB instance.

zh_question: 一家零售公司希望為其電商平台實施即時分析。該公司需要從其網站和行動應 用程式收集點擊流數據，並將這些數據儲存起來以供分析之用。 哪項解決方案能以最少的持續維護工作滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用AmazonDataFirehose匯入串流資料。將處理後的資料直接遞送至已預置的 AmazonRedshift叢集。

B.text: 在AmazonEC2執行個體上部署代理程式以收集串流資料。使用AWSCLI定期批次上傳 資料至AmazonS3儲存貯桶。

C.text: 使用AmazonKinesisDataStreams收集串流資料。使用AmazonDataFirehose將資 料遞送至AmazonS3儲存貯桶。

D.text: 使用AmazonManagedStreamingforApacheKafka(AmazonMSK)代理程式收集 資料。將資料儲存在AmazonRDS資料庫執行個體中。

en_question: A company uses AWS Glue ETL pipelines to process data. The company uses Amazon Athena to analyze data in an Amazon S3 bucket. To better understand shipping timelines, the company decides to collect and store shipping and delivery dates in addition to order data. The company adds a data quality check to ensure that shipping date is greater than order date and that delivery date is greater than shipping date. Orders that fail the quality check must be stored in a second S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

A.text: Use the AWS Glue DataBrew DATEDIFF function to create two additional columns. Check the new columns.

B.text: Use Athena to query all three date columns, and compare the columns.

C.text: Use AWS Glue Data Quality to create a custom rule that uses the three date columns.

D.text: Use an AWS Glue crawler to populate an AWS Glue Data Catalog. Use the three date columns to create a filter.

zh_question: 某公司使用AWSGlueETL管線來處理資料。該公司使用Amazon Athena分析AmazonS3儲存桶中的資料。 為了更深入了解運送時程，該公司決定除了訂單資料外，還收集並儲存運送日期與 送達日期。该公司新增了資料品質檢查，以確保運送日期晚於訂單日期，且送達日 期晚於運送日期。未通過品質檢查的訂單必須儲存在第二個S3儲存桶中。 哪項解決方案能以最具成本效益的方式滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用AWSGlueDataBrew的DATEDIFF函數建立兩個額外欄位，並檢查這些新欄位。

B.text: 使用Athena查詢所有三個日期欄位，並比較這些欄位。

C.text: 使用AWSGlueDataQuality建立自訂規則，以運用這三個日期欄位。

D.text: 使用AWSGluecrawler來填充AWSGlueDataCatalog。使用三個日期欄位建立篩 選條件。

en_question: A data engineer is designing a log table for an application that requires continuous ingestion. The application must provide dependable API-based access to specific records from other applications. The application must handle more than 4,000 concurrent write operations and 6,500 read operations every second. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Create an Amazon Redshift table with the KEY distribution style. Use the Amazon Redshift Data API to perform all read and write operations.

B.text: Store the log files in an Amazon S3 Standard bucket. Register the schema in AWS Glue Data Catalog. Create an external Redshift table that points to the AWS Glue schema. Use the table to perform Amazon Redshift Spectrum read operations.

C.text: Create an Amazon Redshift table with the EVEN distribution style. Use the Amazon Redshift Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) connector to establish a database connection. Use the database connection to perform all read and write operations.

D.text: Create an Amazon DynamoDB table that has provisioned capacity to meet the application's capacity needs. Use the DynamoDB table to perform all read and write operations by using DynamoDB APIs.

zh_question: 一位資料工程師正在為需要持續匯入的應用程式設計日誌表。該應用程式必須提 供可靠的基於API的存取方式，供其他應用程式查詢特定記錄。此應用程式每秒 必須處理超過4,000次並發寫入操作和6,500次讀取操作。 哪項解決方案能符合這些需求？

A.text: 建立具有KEY分佈樣式的AmazonRedshift資料表。使用AmazonRedshiftData API執行所有讀取和寫入作業。

B.text: 將日誌檔案儲存在AmazonS3Standard儲存貯體中。在AWSGlueDataCatalog中註冊 結構描述。建立指向AWSGlue結構描述的外部Redshift資料表。使用該資料表執行 AmazonRedshiftSpectrum讀取作業。

C.text: 建立具有EVEN分佈樣式的AmazonRedshift資料表。使用AmazonRedshiftJava DatabaseConnectivity(JDBC)連接器建立資料庫連線。使用該資料庫連線執行所有讀取和 寫入作業。

D.text: 建立具有預置容量以符合應用程式容量需求的AmazonDynamoDB資料表。使用 DynamoDBAPI，透過該DynamoDB資料表執行所有讀取和寫入作業。

en_question: A company needs to store and analyze a large amount of IoT sensor data. The company needs to retain the data indefinitely. The company analyzes the data in an Amazon Redshift cluster. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

A.text: Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket in JSON format. Configure auto-copy data ingestion from the S3 bucket to the Redshift cluster.

B.text: Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket in Apache Parquet format. Configure query access through Amazon Redshift Spectrum.

C.text: Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket in JSON format. Configure query access through Amazon Redshift Spectrum.

D.text: Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket in Apache Parquet format. Configure auto-copy data ingestion from the S3 bucket to the Redshift cluster.

zh_question: 一家公司需要儲存並分析大量的物聯網感測器資料。該公司需要無限期保留這些 資料，並在AmazonRedshift叢集中進行分析。 哪種解決方案能以最具成本效益的方式滿足這些需求？

A.text: 將資料以JSON格式儲存至AmazonS3儲存貯體。設定自動複製資料匯入 從S3儲存貯體至Redshift叢集。

B.text: 將資料以ApacheParquet格式儲存在AmazonS3儲存貯體中。透過Amazon RedshiftSpectrum設定查詢存取。

C.text: 將資料以JSON格式儲存在AmazonS3儲存貯體中。透過AmazonRedshift Spectrum設定查詢存取。

D.text: 將資料以ApacheParquet格式儲存在AmazonS3儲存貯體中。設定從S3儲存貯體到 Redshift叢集的自動複製資料匯入。

en_question: A company has an Amazon S3 based data lake. The data lake contains datasets that belong to multiple departments. The data lake ingests millions of customer records each day. A data engineer needs to design an access and storage solution that allows departments to access only the subset of the company's dataset that each department requires. The solution must follow the principle of least privilege. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

A.text: Define IAM policies and IAM roles for each department. Specify the S3 access paths from the data lake that each team can access.

B.text: Set up Amazon Redshift and Amazon Redshift Spectrum as the primary entry points for the data lake. Define an IAM role that Amazon Redshift can assume. Configure the IAM role to grant access to the data that is in Amazon S3.

C.text: Set up AWS Lake Formation. Assign LF-Tags to AWS Glue Data Catalog resources. Enable Lake Formation tag-based access control (LF-TBAC).

D.text: Deploy an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL database that has the aws_s3 extension installed. Configure AWS Step Functions events to invoke an AWS Lambda function to sync the data lake with the database.

zh_question: 一家公司擁有基於AmazonS3的資料湖。該資料湖包含屬於多個部門的資料集， 且每天匯入數百萬筆客戶記錄。 資料工程師需要設計一套存取與儲存解決方案，讓各部門僅能存取其所需的本公 司資料子集。該解決方案必須遵循最小權限原則。 哪項解決方案能以最少的工作量滿足這些需求？

A.text: 為每個部門定義IAM政策和IAM角色。指定每個團隊可以存取的資料湖中的S3存取路徑。

B.text: 設定AmazonRedshift和AmazonRedshiftSpectrum作為資料湖的主要入口點。定義一 個可由AmazonRedshift承擔的IAM角色。設定該IAM角色以授予對存放在AmazonS3中 資料的存取權限。

C.text: 設定AWSLakeFormation。將LF標籤指派給AWSGlueDataCatalog資源。啟用 基於標籤的LakeFormation存取控制(LF‑TBAC)。

D.text: 部署已安裝aws_s3擴充功能的AmazonRDSforPostgreSQL資料庫。 設定AWSStepFunctions事件以呼叫AWSLambda函式，將資料湖與資料庫同步。

en_question: A healthcare company stores patient records in an on-premises MySQL database. The company creates an application to access the MySQL database. The company must enforce security protocols to protect the patient records. The company currently rotates database credentials every 30 days to minimize the risk of unauthorized access. The company wants a solution that does require the company to modify the application code for each credential rotation. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Assign an IAM role access permissions to the database. Configure the application to obtain temporary credentials through the IAM role.

B.text: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to generate encryption keys. Configure automatic key rotation. Store the encrypted credentials in an Amazon DynamoDB table.

C.text: Use AWS Secrets Manager to automatically rotate credentials. Allow the application to retrieve the credentials by using API calls.

D.text: Store credentials in an encrypted Amazon S3 bucket. Rotate the credentials every month by using an S3 Lifecycle policy. Use bucket policies to control access.

zh_question: 一家醫療保健公司將病患記錄儲存在內部部署的MySQL資料庫中。該公司建立 了一個應用程式來存取此MySQL資料庫。該公司必須強制實施安全通訊協定以 保護病患記錄。目前，該公司每30天輪換一次資料庫憑證，以最大限度地降低 未經授權存取的風險。 該公司希望找到一種解決方案，無需針對每次憑證輪換而修改應用程式程式碼。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足此需求？

A.text: 指派IAM角色的存取權限至資料庫。設定應用程式以取得 透過IAM角色取得的臨時憑證。

B.text: 使用AWSKeyManagementService(AWSKMS)產生加密金鑰。設定 自動金鑰輪替。將加密的憑證儲存於AmazonDynamoDB資料表中。

C.text: 使用AWSSecretsManager自動輪替憑證。允許應用程式透過API呼叫來擷取憑證。

D.text: 將憑證儲存於加密的AmazonS3貯存桶中。使用S3生命週期原則每月輪替憑證。使用貯 存桶原則控制存取。

en_question: A retail company needs to implement a solution to capture data updates from multiple Amazon Aurora MySQL databases. The company needs to make the updates available for analytics in near real time. The solution must be serverless and require minimal maintenance. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Set up AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) tasks that perform schema conversions for each database. Load the changes into Amazon Redshift Serverless.

B.text: Use Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK) Connect with Debezium connectors to load data into Amazon Redshift Serverless.

C.text: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to set up binary log replication to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Load the data into Amazon Redshift Serverless after schema conversion.

D.text: Use Aurora zero-ETL integrations with Amazon Redshift Serverless for each database to load Aurora MySQL changes in Amazon Redshift Serverless.

zh_question: 一家零售公司需要實施一項解決方案，以捕捉來自多個AmazonAurora MySQL資料庫的資料更新。該公司需要讓這些更新能以近乎即時的方式供分析 使用。此解決方案必須為無伺服器架構，且所需維護工作最少。 哪項解決方案能以最低的營運 開銷？

A.text: 設定AWSDatabaseMigrationService(AWSDMS)任務，針對每個資料庫執行結構轉換 。將變更載入至AmazonRedshiftServerless。

B.text: 使用AmazonManagedStreamingforApacheKafka(AmazonMSK)Connect搭配 Debezium連接器，將資料載入至AmazonRedshiftServerless。

C.text: 使用AWSDatabaseMigrationService(AWSDMS)設定二進位日誌複製至Amazon KinesisDataStreams。在進行結構描述轉換後，將資料載入至AmazonRedshiftServerless。

D.text: 對每個資料庫使用Aurorazero‑ETL整合與AmazonRedshiftServerless，以將 AuroraMySQL的變更載入至AmazonRedshiftServerless。

en_question: A data engineer is writing a query to join two tables in Amazon Athena. The data engineer needs to choose the correct join order for the tables to optimize query performance. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Specify the smaller table on the left side of the join and the larger table on the right side of the join.

B.text: Specify the larger table on the left side of the join and the smaller table on the right side of the join.

C.text: Use AWS Glue to pre-process the tables before performing the join.

D.text: Use table statistics to automatically determine the join order.

zh_question: 一名資料工程師正在撰寫查詢，以在AmazonAthena中聯結兩個資料表。該資 料工程師需要選擇正確的資料表聯結順序，以最佳化查詢效能。 哪項解決方案符合這些需求？

A.text: 在聯結的左側指定較小的表格，右側指定較大的表格。 聯結。

B.text: 將較大的表格指定在聯結的左側，將較小的表格指定在聯結的右側。

C.text: 使用AWSGlue在執行聯結前先對表格進行預處理。

D.text: 使用表格統計資料自動決定聯結順序。

en_question: A company generates reports from 30 tables in an Amazon Redshift data warehouse. The data source is an operational Amazon Aurora MySQL database that contains 100 tables. Currently, the company refreshes all data from Aurora to Amazon Redshift every hour, which causes delays in report generation. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose two.)

A.text: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to create a replication task. Select only the required tables.

B.text: Create a database in Amazon Redshift that uses the integration.

C.text: Create a zero-ETL integration in Amazon Aurora. Select only the required tables.

D.text: Use query editor v2 in Amazon Redshift to access the data in Aurora.

E.text: Create an AWS Glue job to transfer each required table. Run an AWS Glue workflow to initiate the jobs every 5 minutes.

zh_question: 一家公司從包含30個資料表的AmazonRedshift資料倉儲中產生報表。其資 料來源為一個包含100個資料表的營運用AmazonAuroraMySQL資料庫。目 前，該公司每小時將所有資料從Aurora重新整理至AmazonRedshift，導致 報表產生延遲。 哪兩個步驟的組合能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？（請選擇兩項。）

A.text: 使用AWSDatabaseMigrationService(AWSDMS)建立複製任務。僅選取 所需的資料表。

B.text: 在AmazonRedshift中建立使用此整合功能的資料庫。

C.text: 在AmazonAurora中建立零ETL整合。僅選取所需的資料表。

D.text: 使用AmazonRedshift中的查詢編輯器v2來存取Aurora中的資料。

E.text: 建立一個AWSGlue工作以轉移每個所需的資料表。執行一個AWSGlue工作流程，每 5分鐘啟動這些工作一次。

en_question: A data engineer needs a fully automated solution to check for new data in multiple databases and process data that the solution finds. The solution must run every hour. The solution must be compatible with Amazon RDS, Amazon DynamoDB, and Amazon OpenSearch Service. The solution must be able to process up to 10 MB of data at one time. The solution must be optimized for costs and operational overhead. The solution must have robust error handling capabilities. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Use Amazon EventBridge to invoke AWS Step Functions every hour to deploy an AWS Lambda function to check for data. Configure Step Functions steps to process data that the Lambda function finds. Implement error handling in each state.

B.text: Use Amazon EventBridge to invoke an AWS Lambda function every hour to check for data. Configure the function to send a message to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue when the function finds new data. Use a second Lambda function to read the queue and perform the processing.

C.text: Configure an Apache Spark application to run on Amazon EMR to check for data. Implement error handling in the application. Use Amazon EventBridge to invoke the application every hour.

D.text: Use Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA) to create a workflow that runs a directed acyclic graph (DAG) every hour to check for data. Configure the DAG to process identified data. Implement error handling in a Python operator.

zh_question: 資料工程師需要一個完全自動化的解決方案，以檢查多個資料庫中的新資料並處 理所發現的資料。該解決方案必須每小時執行一次，並相容於AmazonRDS、 AmazonDynamoDB和AmazonOpenSearchService。該解決方案必須能夠 一次處理高達10MB的資料，同時針對成本與營運負擔進行優化，並具備穩健的 錯誤處理能力。 哪項解決方案符合這些需求？

A.text: 使用AmazonEventBridge每小時觸發AWSStepFunctions以部署AWSLa mbda函數來檢查資料。設定StepFunctions步驟以處理Lambda函數所發現的資料，並 在每個狀態中實作錯誤處理。

B.text: 使用AmazonEventBridge每小時觸發AWSLambda函數以檢查資料。設定該函數在發 現新資料時，將訊息发送至AmazonSimpleQueueService(AmazonSQS) 佇列。使用第二個Lambda函數讀取佇列並執行處理。

C.text: 設定在Amazon上執行的ApacheSpark應用程式，以檢查資料。在應用程式中實作錯誤 處理。使用AmazonEventBridge每小時呼叫該應用程式。

D.text: 使用AmazonManagedWorkflowsforApacheAirflow(AmazonMWAA)建立 一個工作流程，每小時執行一次有向無環圖(DAG)以檢查資料。設定該DAG來處理已識別 的資料。在Python運算子中實作錯誤處理。

en_question: A company uses an Amazon Redshift cluster to manage data, including vendor sales data. The company wants to store a copy of the vendor data in an Amazon S3 bucket. A data engineer sets up an AWS Glue job to upload the data to the S3 bucket data on a schedule. The data engineer set up a network connection to allow private traffic between Amazon Redshift and Amazon S3. What is the next step required to meet this requirement?

A.text: Create an IAM role that has permission to write to the S3 bucket. Associate the IAM role with the Amazon Redshift cluster.

B.text: Add the S3 bucket to an AWS Glue Data Catalog. Configure Amazon Redshift Spectrum to access the Data Catalog.

C.text: Enable the Amazon Redshift data sharing feature. Set the S3 bucket as a target bucket for data sharing.

D.text: Store login credentials for Amazon Redshift in AWS Secrets Manager. Add a reference to the secret to the Glue job configuration.

zh_question: 一家公司使用AmazonRedshift叢集來管理資料，包括供應商銷售資料。該公 司希望將供應商資料的副本儲存至AmazonS3儲存貯體中。 資料工程師設定了一個AWSGlue工作，以排程方式將資料上傳至S3儲存桶。 該工程師已設定網路連線，允許AmazonRedshift與AmazonS3之間的私 有流量。 下一步需要執行什麼操作才能符合此需求？

A.text: 建立一個具有寫入S3儲存桶權限的IAM角色。將該IAM角色與AmazonRedshift 叢集關聯。

B.text: 將S3儲存桶新增至AWSGlue資料目錄。設定AmazonRedshiftSpectrum以存取該 資料目錄。

C.text: 啟用AmazonRedshift資料共用功能。將S3儲存桶設定為資料共用的目標儲存桶。

D.text: 將AmazonRedshift的登入憑證儲存於AWSSecretsManager中。在Glue工作設定中 加入對該機密的參考。

en_question: A company stores a 100 MB dataset in an Amazon S3 bucket as an Apache Parquet file. A data engineer needs to profile the data before performing data preparation steps on the data. Which solution will meet this requirement in the MOST operationally efficient way?

A.text: Create a profile job on the dataset in AWS Glue DataBrew. Review the profile job results.

B.text: Stream the data into Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink for SQL queries. Use the Apache Flink dashboard to profile the data.

C.text: Ingest the data into Amazon Redshift Spectrum. Use SQL queries to profile the data.

D.text: Load the data into an Amazon QuickSight dataset. Build a topic to profile the data with questions.

zh_question: 一家公司將100MB的資料集以ApacheParquet檔案格式儲存在Amazon S3儲存貯桶中。資料工程師需要在執行資料準備步驟之前，先對該資料進行剖 析。 哪種解決方案能以最具營運效率的方式滿足此需求？

A.text: 在AWSGlueDataBrew的資料集上建立設定檔作業。檢視設定檔作業結果。

B.text: 將資料串流至AmazonManagedServiceforApacheFlink以進行SQL查詢。使用 ApacheFlink儀表板來設定資料輪廓。

C.text: 將資料匯入AmazonRedshiftSpectrum。使用SQL查詢來設定資料輪廓。

D.text: 將資料載入AmazonQuickSight資料集。建置一個主題以設定資料輪廓， questions.

en_question: A company needs to implement real-time analytics for a retail shopping platform. The company wants to capture clickstream data, process the data, and load the data into Amazon Redshift for analysis. The solution must handle hundreds of megabytes of data every second. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST query latency for analytics?

A.text: Use Amazon Data Firehose to capture the data. Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use the COPY command to load data into Amazon Redshift.

B.text: Use Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK) to capture the data. Use Amazon EMR to process the data. Use federated queries to access data in Amazon Redshift.

C.text: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to capture the data. Use Amazon Redshift streaming ingestion to load data directly into materialized views.

D.text: Use Amazon DynamoDB Streams to capture the data. Use AWS Glue to process the data. Use a zero-ETL integration to load the data into Amazon Redshift.

zh_question: 一家公司需要為零售購物平台實施即時分析。該公司希望捕捉點擊流資料、處理這 些資料，並將資料載入AmazonRedshift以供分析。該解決方案必須每秒處理數 百兆位元組的資料。 哪種解決方案能以最低的查詢延遲滿足這些分析需求？

A.text: 使用AmazonDataFirehose擷取資料。將資料儲存於AmazonS3儲存貯體中。使用 COPY指令將資料載入至AmazonRedshift。

B.text: 使用AmazonManagedStreamingforApacheKafka(AmazonMSK)來擷取資 料。使用AmazonEMR來處理資料。使用聯合查詢來存取AmazonRedshift中的資料。

C.text: 使用AmazonKinesisDataStreams擷取資料。使用AmazonRedshift串流擷取功 能，將資料直接載入具象化檢視表中。

D.text: 使用AmazonDynamoDBStreams擷取資料。使用AWSGlue處理資料。透過零ETL整 合，將資料載入至AmazonRedshift。

en_question: A company has a data pipeline that processes transaction data in real time. The company needs a notification system that alerts different teams based on the type of processing error without any delay. For security-related errors, the system must immediately notify the security team. For data validation errors, the system must notify the data quality team. For system errors, the system must notify the operations team. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic with an AWS Lambda function subscriber that evaluates the error type and forwards the error to the appropriate email addresses.

B.text: Configure Amazon EventBridge rules with distinct event patterns for each error type. Route each error type to a dedicated Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic for team-specific alerts.

C.text: Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) with message attributes to categorize errors. Allow each team to poll their respective SQS queue for relevant errors.

D.text: Set up Amazon CloudWatch alarms with different metrics for each error type. Invoke a different Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification each time a metrics threshold is crossed.

zh_question: 某公司擁有一個即時處理交易資料的資料管線。該公司需要一套通知系統，能依 據處理錯誤的類型立即警示不同團隊，且不得有任何延遲。針對安全相關的錯誤， 系統必須立即通知安全團隊；針對資料驗證錯誤，系統必須通知資料品質團隊； 針對系統錯誤，系統則必須通知作業團隊。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 建立一個AmazonSimpleNotificationService(AmazonSNS)主題，並設定AWS Lambda函數作為訂閱者，以評估錯誤類型並將錯誤轉寄至適當的電子郵件地址。

B.text: 設定AmazonEventBridge規則，為每種錯誤類型定義獨特的事件模式。將每種錯誤類型 路由至專用的AmazonSimpleNotificationService(AmazonSNS)主題，以發送針對特定 團隊的警示。

C.text: 使用帶有訊息屬性的AmazonSimpleQueueService(AmazonSQS)來分類 錯誤。允許各團隊輪詢其各自的SQS佇列以取得相關錯誤。

D.text: 針對每種錯誤類型設定具有不同指標的AmazonCloudWatch警報。每當指標觸發時， 即呼叫不同的AmazonSimpleNotificationService(AmazonSNS)通知。 閾值時。

en_question: A global ecommerce company processes customer transactions, inventory updates, and user activity logs across multiple AWS services. The company needs a scalable, fully managed, and event-driven orchestration solution to coordinate complex extract, transform, and load (ETL) workflows. The solution must use AWS Glue and Amazon EMR to process data. The data will be stored in Amazon Redshift and Amazon S3. The solution must support dependency management, automated retries, and data pipeline monitoring. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Use AWS Step Functions to define an express workflow that invokes the data transformation and loading tasks across Amazon EMR and AWS Glue.

B.text: Create AWS Lambda functions for each step of the workflow Configure Amazon EventBridge to invoke AWS Glue jobs. Configure the Lambda functions to process and move data through the pipeline.

C.text: Use Apache Airflow on Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA) to create Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) to manage ETL workflows.

D.text: Create an AWS Lambda function that runs each step of the workflow. Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule to invoke the function every day.

zh_question: 一家全球電子商務公司處理客戶交易、庫存 更新，以及跨多項AWS服務的使用者活動日誌。該公司 需要一個可擴展、完全託管且事件驅動的編排解決方案，以協調複雜的提取、轉 換和載入(ETL)工作流程。該解決方案必須使用AWSGlue和AmazonEMR 來處理資料。資料將儲存於 AmazonRedshift與AmazonS3。該解決方案必須支援相依性管理、自 動重試以及資料管線監控。 哪項解決方案能符合這些需求？

A.text: 使用AWSStepFunctions定義一個表達式工作流，以呼叫跨越AmazonEMR與AWS Glue的資料轉換與載入任務。

B.text: 為工作流的每個步驟建立AWSLambda函數。設定AmazonEventBridge以呼叫AWS Glue作業。設定Lambda函數以處理並透過管線移動資料。

C.text: 在AmazonManagedWorkflowsforApacheAirflow(AmazonMWAA)上使用 ApacheAirflow建立有向無環圖(DAG)，以管理ETL工作流。

D.text: 建立一個AWSLambda函數以執行工作流的每個步驟。建立一個Amazon EventBridge排程規則，每天呼叫該函數。

en_question: A global company currently uses Amazon Redshift to store data and Amazon Quick Suite (previously known as Amazon QuickSight) to generate reports. A team of business analysts have varying levels of technical expertise. Some analysts lack SQL knowledge. All the analysts need to create new reports frequently. The company wants to use natural program language queries to create dashboards and reports more efficiently. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

A.text: Use Quick Suite dashboards that have zero-ETL access to Amazon Redshift.

B.text: Enable Amazon Q in Quick Suite. Generate Quick Suite dashboards and reports.

C.text: Integrate Tableau with Amazon Redshift to give Tableau direct access to the data.

D.text: Use Quick Suite dashboards that have federated query access to Amazon Redshift.

zh_question: 一家全球性公司目前使用AmazonRedshift儲存資料，並使用Amazon QuickSuite（前身為AmazonQuickSight）生成報表。 一組業務分析師具備不同層級的技術專業知識。部分分析師缺乏SQL知識。 所有分析師都需要頻繁建立新報表。該公司希望使用自然語言查詢來更有效率 地建立儀表板和報表。 哪項解決方案能以最低的營運工作量滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用具有零ETL存取AmazonRedshift功能的QuickSuite儀表板。

B.text: 在QuickSuite中啟用AmazonQ。產生QuickSuite儀表板和報表。

C.text: 將Tableau與AmazonRedshift整合，以提供Tableau直接存取資料的能力。

D.text: 使用具有對AmazonRedshift聯合查詢存取權限的QuickSuite儀表板。

en_question: A company is setting up a new Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio domain. Each of the company's business units needs isolated control over its own assets, projects, and metadata. Specific datasets must be shareable with other business units upon approval. The company also requires centralized user authentication and identity mapping. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Configure each business unit as a domain unit with delegated ownership and fine-grained permissions policies. Give users the ability to share assets across domain units with explicit access control. Assign API keys to users for authentication to access the domain portal.

B.text: Configure business units as separate domain units with owner permissions. Restrict projects exclusively to owners to prevent data sharing between domains. Configure AWS IAM Identity Center for centralized authentication. Map user profiles to their respective domain units.

C.text: Configure business units to be represented as separate domains. Establish isolated environments with no shared administrative policies. Configure AWS IAM Identity Center for centralized authentication. Delegate administration at the domain level.

D.text: Configure each business unit as a separate domain unit to manage permissions on assets, projects, and metadata. Configure AWS IAM Identity Center for centralized authentication. Map user profiles to their respective domain units. Enable cross-business unit sharing through access requests. Instruct domain unit owners to approve or deny the requests.

zh_question: 一家公司正在設定新的AmazonSageMakerUnifiedStudio網域。該公司的每 個業務單位都需要对其自身的資產、專案和元資料擁有隔離的控制權。特定資料 集必須在獲得批准後可與其他業務單位共用。該公司還需要集中式的使用者驗證 和身分映射。 哪種解決方案能符合這些需求？

A.text: 將每個業務單位設定為網域單位，並賦予委託所有權與細粒度的權限政策。讓使用者能夠 透過明確的 存取控制，在不同網域單位之間共用資產。指派API金鑰給使用者，以便進行驗證以存取網域入口網站。

B.text: 將業務單位設定為獨立的網域單位，並賦予擁有者權限。將專案限制為僅擁有者可存取，以 防止網域間的資料共用。設定AWSIAMIdentityCenter以進行集中式驗證。將使用者設定檔 對應至其各自的網域單位。

C.text: 將業務單位設定為代表獨立的網域。建立隔離的 環境，且不共用任何管理原則。設定AWSIAMIdentityCenter以進行 集中式驗證。在網域層級委派管理權限。

D.text: 將每個業務單位設定為獨立的網域單位，以管理資產、專案和中繼資料的權限。設定AWS IAMIdentityCenter以進行集中式驗證。將使用者設定檔對應至其各自的網域單位。啟用透過 存取請求進行的跨業務單位共用。指示網域單位擁有者核准或拒絕這些請求。

en_question: A data engineer at a large company needs to create centralized datasets that are optimized for Amazon Redshift performance. The company has multiple downstream teams that use their own AWS accounts and dedicated Amazon Redshift clusters with RA3 nodes. All downstream teams need access to the centralized datasets. Which solution will provide immediate access to the datasets and maintain the current Amazon Redshift performance?

A.text: Copy the datasets to an Amazon S3 bucket by using the UNLOAD command. Register the table definitions in a dedicated AWS Glue Data Catalog schema. Share the schema with the other AWS accounts by using AWS Lake Formation. Use Amazon Redshift Spectrum to access the data.

B.text: Create a daily extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to unload the data to an Amazon S3 staging area. Instruct the teams to copy the data into their Amazon Redshift clusters.

C.text: Set up Amazon Redshift data sharing between the Amazon Redshift producer clusters and the consumer clusters to provide access to the centralized datasets.

D.text: Set up an AWS DataSync job that automatically syncs the data between the Amazon Redshift producer clusters and the consumer clusters.

zh_question: 一家大型公司的資料工程師需要建立針對AmazonRedshift效能優化的集中 式資料集。該公司擁有多個下游團隊，這些團隊使用各自的AWS帳戶以及配 備RA3節點的專用AmazonRedshift叢集。所有下游團隊都需要存取這些集 中式資料集。 哪種解決方案能提供對資料集的即時存取，並維持目前的AmazonRedshift效 能？

A.text: 使用UNLOAD指令將資料集複製到AmazonS3儲存貯桶。在專用的AWSGlueData Catalog架構中註冊表格定義。透過AWSLakeFormation與其它AWS帳戶共用該架構。使用 AmazonRedshiftSpectrum存取資料。

B.text: 建立每日的提取、轉換和載入(ETL)工作，將資料卸載至AmazonS3暫存區。指示各 團隊將資料複製到其各自的AmazonRedshift叢集。

C.text: 在AmazonRedshift生產者叢集與消費者叢集之間設定AmazonRedshift資料共用，以 提供對集中式資料集的存取權限。

D.text: 設定AWSDataSync工作，自動同步AmazonRedshift之間的資料 生產者叢集與消費者叢集。

en_question: A global finance company needs to implement near real-time cross-Region synchronization of trading data between trading centers in the us-east-1 Region, the eu-west-2 Region, and the ap-northeast-1 Region. The company must ensure that data is encrypted in transit. The solution must ensure data ordering and consistency and must support cross-Region disaster recovery. The solution must provide data latency of less than 500 milliseconds. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

A.text: Deploy Apache Kafka Connect in each AWS Region. Use custom-developed connectors to set up cross-Region data replication. Configure the SSL security protocol.
