B.text: Use Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK) Replicator to establish fully interconnected replication relationships between MSK clusters in the three AWS Regions. Enable TLS encryption and IAM authentication. Set up cross-Region backup configurations.

C.text: Deploy Apache Kafka Mirror Maker 2.0 in each AWS Region. Set up custom replication policies to handle cross-Region data synchronization. Configure the SSL security protocol.

D.text: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to receive trading data from each AWS Region. Use Amazon Data Firehose to replicate data between Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK) clusters in each Region. Configure AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encryption and IAM roles to manage access.

zh_question: 一家全球金融公司需要在us‑east‑1、eu‑west‑2和ap‑northeast‑1區域的交易中 心之間，實施近乎即時的跨區域交易資料同步。該公司必須確保資料在傳輸過程中 經過加密。解決方案必須確保資料順序與一致性，並支援跨區域災難復原。此外， 解決方案必須提供低於500毫秒的資料延遲。 哪項解決方案能以最低的營運工作量滿足這些需求？

A.text: 在每個AWS區域部署ApacheKafkaConnect。使用自訂開發的連接器設定跨區域資料複 製。設定SSL通訊協定。

B.text: 使用AmazonManagedStreamingforApacheKafka(AmazonMSK)Replicator， 在三個AWS區域的MSK叢集之間建立完全互連的複製關係。 啟用TLS加密和IAM驗證。設定跨區域備份組態。

C.text: 在每個AWS區域部署ApacheKafkaMirrorMaker2.0。設定自訂複製原則以處理跨區域 資料同步。設定SSL通訊協定。

D.text: 使用AmazonKinesisDataStreams從每個AWS區域接收交易資料。使用Amazon DataFirehose在各區域的AmazonManagedStreamingforApacheKafka(Amazon MSK)叢集之間複製資料。設定AWSKeyManagementService(AWSKMS)加密和IAM角 色以管理存取權限。

en_question: A company’s application needs to search and analyze data in near real time. The application must handle up to 1,000 requests each second with low query latency. The company wants a solution that individual data teams can own and configure to meet each team's cost and performance optimization requirements. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Use Amazon S3 buckets to store the data. Use Amazon Athena to query and analyze the data. Assign each data team a separate S3 bucket prefix to optimize queries.

B.text: Use streams in Amazon Kinesis Data Streams and Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink to query and analyze the data. Assign each data team a separate stream to manage and consume.

C.text: Use Amazon OpenSearch Service clusters with indexing to query the data. Assign each data team a separate cluster to configure for storage and queries.

D.text: Use Amazon Aurora clusters that run on Aurora I/O-Optimized instances. Assign each data team a separate Aurora cluster to configure for storage and queries.

zh_question: 一家公司的應用程式需要以近乎即時的方式搜尋並分析資料。該應用程式必須每秒 處理高達1,000個請求，並保持低查詢延遲。该公司希望找到一種解決方案，讓各 個資料團隊能夠自行擁有並進行設定，以符合各團隊在成本與效能最佳化方面的需 求。 哪種解決方案能符合這些需求？

A.text: 使用AmazonS3儲存桶來儲存資料。使用AmazonAthena來查詢並分析資料。為每個資 料團隊分配獨立的S3儲存桶前綴，以最佳化查詢。

B.text: 在AmazonKinesisDataStreams和AmazonManagedServiceforApache Flink中使用串流來查詢並分析資料。為每個資料團隊分配獨立的串流以供管理與消費。

C.text: 使用具備索引功能的AmazonOpenSearchService叢集來查詢資料。為每個資料團隊分 配獨立的叢集，以便針對儲存與查詢進行設定。

D.text: 使用在AuroraI/O最佳化執行個體上運行的AmazonAurora叢集。為每個資料團 隊分配一個獨立的Aurora叢集，以進行儲存和查詢的設定。

en_question: A company uses Amazon Redshift for its data warehouse. A data engineer must query a table named orders.complete_orders_history, which contains 100 columns. The query must return all columns except columns named companyId and unique_system_id. Which Amazon Redshift SQL statement will meet this requirement?
zh_question: 一家公司使用AmazonRedshift作為其資料倉儲。一名資料工程師必須查詢名 為orders.complete_orders_history的表格，該表格包含100個欄位。此查詢 必須傳回所有欄位，但排除名為companyId和unique_system_id的欄位。 哪一個AmazonRedshiftSQL陳述式符合此需求？

en_question: A company stores sensitive transaction data in an Amazon S3 bucket. A data engineer must implement controls to prevent accidental deletions. Which solution will meet this requirement?

A.text: Enable versioning on the S3 bucket and configure MFA delete.

B.text: Configure an S3 bucket policy rule that denies the creation of S3 delete markers.

C.text: Create an S3 Lifecycle rule that moves deleted files to S3 Glacier Deep Archive.

D.text: Set up AWS Config remediation actions to prevent users from deleting S3 objects.

zh_question: 一家公司將敏感的交易資料儲存在AmazonS3儲存貯體中。資料工程師必須 實作控制措施，以防止意外刪除。 哪項解決方案能符合此需求？

A.text: 在S3儲存貯體上啟用版本控制，並設定多因素認證(MFA)刪除。

B.text: 設定一條拒絕建立刪除標記的S3儲存貯體原則規則。

C.text: 建立一條將已刪除檔案移至S3GlacierDeepArchive的儲存生命週期規則。

D.text: 設定AWSConfig修復動作，以防止使用者刪除物件。

en_question: A company stores historical customer data in an Amazon Redshift table. A column named Email contains null entries and values that are not email addresses. The quality of the Email column is critical for multiple downstream processes. A data engineer must create an AWS Glue Data Quality rule that fails when the percentage of valid email addresses in the Email column is less than 90%. Which component of an AWS Glue Data Quality rule will meet these requirements?

A.text: Uniqueness "Email" matches "[%@%.%]" with a threshold set to > 0.9

B.text: ColumnValues "Email” matches "[%@%.%]" with a threshold set to > 0.1

C.text: ColumnValues "Email" matches "[%@%.%]" with a threshold set to > 0.9

D.text: UniqueValueRatio "Email" matches "[%@%.%]" with a threshold set to > 0.1

zh_question: 某公司將歷史客戶資料儲存在AmazonRedshift資料表中。名為「Email」的 欄位包含空值以及非電子郵件地址的值。「Email」欄位的品質對於多個下游流 程至關重要。資料工程師必須建立一條AWSGlueDataQuality規則，當「 Email」欄位中有效電子郵件地址的百分比低於90%時，該規則應判定為失敗。 AWSGlueDataQuality規則的哪個元件符合這些需求？

A.text: 唯一性：「Email」符合「[%@%.%]」，閾值設定為> 0.9

B.text: ColumnValues「Email」符合「[%@%.%]」，閾值設定為> 0.1

C.text: ColumnValues「Email」符合「[%@%.%]」，閾值設定為> 0.9

D.text: UniqueValueRatio「Email」符合「[%@%.%]」，閾值設定為> 0.1

en_question: A company is building data processing pipelines by using AWS Glue. The pipelines access data stored in Amazon S3. The company has organized the data into folders with prefixes that represent different classification levels. The company needs to restrict AWS Glue jobs to access only specific prefixes based on the data classification. The company must also restrict access to business hours (9 AM to 5 PM). Which elements must the company include in a custom IAM policy to meet these requirements?

A.text: A Resource element with S3 object Amazon Resource Name (ARN) patterns that use wildcards for each prefix and a Condition element that uses the $util.time variable with TimeGreaterThan and TimeLessThan operators

B.text: A Resource element with S3 object Amazon Resource Name (ARN) patterns that use wildcards for each prefix and a Condition element that uses the aws:CurrentTime condition key with DateGreaterThan and DateLessThan operators

C.text: A Condition element that uses the s3:prefix condition key to restrict folder access and aws:CurrentTime with DateGreaterThanEquals and DateLessThanEquals to restrict hours of operation

D.text: A Condition element that uses the s3:ResourceAccount condition key to restrict bucket access and a Deny statement that applies outside of business hours

zh_question: 一家公司正在使用AWSGlue建置資料處理管線。這些管線會存取儲存在 AmazonS3中的資料。該公司已將資料組織成具有代表不同分類層級之前綴的資 料夾。該公司需要限制AWSGlue工作僅能根據資料分類存取特定的前綴。該公 司還必須將存取限制在營業時間（上午9點至下午5點）。 為了符合這些需求，該公司必須在自訂IAM政策中包含哪些元素？

A.text: 一個Resource元素，包含使用萬用字元對應每個前綴的S3物件亚马逊資源名稱(ARN)模式， 以及一個使用$util.time變數並搭配TimeGreaterThan和TimeLessThan運算子的 Condition元素

B.text: 一個Resource元素，其包含使用萬用字元匹配各前綴的S3物件Amazon資源名稱 (ARN)模式，以及一個使用aws:CurrentTime條件鍵並搭配DateGreaterThan與 DateLessThan運算子的Condition元素

C.text: 一個Condition元素，使用s3:prefix條件鍵以限制資料夾存取，並使用帶有 DateGreaterThanEquals與DateLessThanEquals運算子的aws:CurrentTime以限制 作業時段

D.text: 一個使用s3:ResourceAccount條件鍵以限制儲存桶存取的Condition元素，以及一個適用 於營業時間之外的Deny陳述式

en_question: A company needs to collect logs for an Amazon RDS for MySQL database and make the logs available for audits. The logs must track each user that modifies data in the database or makes changes to the database instance. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Enable Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Create metric filters to monitor database changes and instance-level changes. Configure automated notification systems to send near real-time alerts for suspicious database operations.

B.text: Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to monitor database activity. Create an AWS Lambda function to process EventBridge events and store them in Amazon OpenSearch Service.

C.text: Configure AWS CloudTrail to log API calls. Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs for basic monitoring. Use IAM policies to control access to the logs. Set up scheduled reporting for log audits.

D.text: Enable and configure native Amazon RDS database audit logging. Enable Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Configure metric filters and alarms. Configure AWS CloudTrail audit logging.

zh_question: 一家公司需要收集AmazonRDSforMySQL資料庫的日誌，並提供這些日誌以 供稽核使用。這些日誌必須追蹤每一位修改資料庫資料或對資料庫實體進行變更 的使用者。 哪項解決方案能符合這些需求？

A.text: 啟用AmazonCloudWatchLogs。建立指標篩選器以監控資料庫變更和實體層級的變更。 設定自動化通知系統，針對可疑的資料庫作業發送近乎即時的警示。

B.text: 設定AmazonEventBridge規則以監控資料庫活動。建立AWSLambda函數來處理 EventBridge事件，並將它們儲存至AmazonOpenSearchService。

C.text: 設定AWSCloudTrail以記錄API呼叫。使用AmazonCloudWatchLogs進行基本監控。 使用IAM政策控制對日誌的存取權限。設定排程報告以進行日誌稽核。

D.text: 啟用並設定原生的AmazonRDS資料庫審計記錄功能。啟用AmazonCloudWatch Logs。設定指標篩選器與警報。設定AWSCloudTrail審計記錄功能。

en_question: A company processes a CSV file that contains millions of transaction records every day. The file is stored in Amazon S3. Each transaction must be validated before updating a database. The company needs a solution that will process the data in parallel. The solution must use error handling that stops the entire process if more than 15% of the records fail validation. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Create an AWS Batch job that processes chunks of the file in parallel with a custom error tracking mechanism.

B.text: Use AWS Step Functions Distributed Map state with the ToleratedFailurePercentage field set to 15%.

C.text: Deploy an Amazon EMR cluster with Spark to process the file Configure a custom failure threshold to 15%.

D.text: Use AWS Lambda with S3 Batch Operations to process the file and track validation failures to be less than 15%.

zh_question: 一家公司每天處理包含數百萬筆交易記錄的CSV檔案。該檔案儲存於Amazon S3中。每筆交易在更新資料庫前必須經過驗證。该公司需要一個能平行處理資料 的解決方案。該解決方案必須具備錯誤處理機制，若超過15%的記錄驗證失敗， 則停止整個處理流程。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運 額外開銷？

A.text: 建立一個AWSBatch工作，使用自訂錯誤追蹤機制平行處理檔案區塊。

B.text: 使用AWSStepFunctions分散式對應狀態，並將ToleratedFailurePercentage欄位 設定為15%。

C.text: 部署一個具備Spark的AmazonEMR叢集以處理檔案，並將自訂失敗閾值設定為15 %。

D.text: 使用AWSLambda搭配S3批次作業來處理檔案，並追蹤驗證失敗率低於15%。

en_question: A company needs to generate a one-time performance report by joining data that is stored in Amazon DynamoDB. Amazon RDS. Amazon Redshift. and Amazon S3. The company wants to avoid unnecessary data movement and to minimize query execution time. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Capture data from DynamoDB by using DynamoDB Streams. Migrate data from Amazon RDS by using AWS DMS. Export Amazon Redshift data. Store all data in Amazon S3. Use Redshift Spectrum to run queries.

B.text: Set up an AWS Glue ETL pipeline to extract, transform, and centralize data in Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena to run analytical queries.

C.text: Deploy an Amazon EMR cluster powered by Apache Spark to ingest, process, and merge datasets from multiple sources. Run analytical workloads on the merged data.

D.text: Use Amazon Athena Federated Query to perform one-time joins and analysis across DynamoDB, Amazon RDS, Amazon Redshift, and Amazon S3.

zh_question: 一家公司需要透過聯結儲存在AmazonDynamoDB、AmazonRDS、 AmazonRedshift和AmazonS3中的資料，產生一次性效能報告。該公司希 望避免不必要的資料移動，並將查詢執行時間降至最低。 哪種解決方案能符合這些需求？

A.text: 使用DynamoDBStreams從DynamoDB擷取資料。使用AWSDMS將資料從Amazon RDS遷移。匯出AmazonRedshift資料。將所有資料儲存於AmazonS3。使用Redshift Spectrum執行查詢。

B.text: 設定AWSGlueETL管線以提取、轉換並將資料集中於AmazonS3。使用Amazon Athena執行分析查詢。

C.text: 部署由ApacheSpark驅動的AmazonEMR叢集，以從多個來源攝取、處理並合併資 料集。在合併後的資料上執行分析工作負載。

D.text: 使用AmazonAthena聯邦查詢，針對DynamoDB、AmazonRDS、Amazon Redshift和AmazonS3執行一次性聯結與分析。

en_question: A data engineer is building a serverless. multi-step extract, transform, and load (ETL) pipeline. The pipeline extracts data from an Amazon S3 data lake and transforms the data by using AWS Glue ETL jobs. The pipeline then loads the results into an Amazon Redshift database. The data engineer needs to orchestrate the serverless ETL workflow. Which solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

A.text: Implement the workflow by using AWS Step Functions. Configure Step Functions to coordinate the AWS Glue ETL jobs and handle error conditions with automatic retries.

B.text: Use AWS Glue workflows to create a graph of the ETL tasks that visually represents the dependencies between jobs and the job triggers.

C.text: Provision an always on Amazon EC2 instance. Create a cron job that invokes the AWS Glue ETL jobs in sequence based on a predefined scheduleю

D.text: Use Amazon EventBridge rules to invoke the AWS Glue ETL jobs based on S3 object creation events. Configure the rules to chain the AWS Glue ETL jobs in sequence and handle complex job dependencies.

E.text: Build an orchestration solution by using AWS CodePipeline to coordinate the ETL pipeline and infrastructure changes based on the dependencies.

zh_question: 一名資料工程師正在建置一個無伺服器、多步驟的擷取、轉換與載入(ETL)管線。 該管線從AmazonS3資料湖擷取資料，並使用AWSGlueETL工作進行資料轉 換。接著，管線將結果載入AmazonRedshift資料庫。該資料工程師需要協調 此無伺服器ETL工作流程。 哪些解決方案符合這些需求？（請選擇兩項。）

A.text: 使用AWSStepFunctions實作工作流程。設定StepFunctions以協調AWSGlueETL 工作，並透過自動重試處理錯誤狀況。

B.text: 使用AWSGlue工作流程建立ETL任務的圖形，以視覺化方式呈現工作之間的依賴關係 及工作觸發條件。

C.text: 佈建一個永遠運行的AmazonEC2執行個體。建立一個排程工作，根據預定義的時間表依序 呼叫AWSGlueETL工作。

D.text: 使用AmazonEventBridge規則，根據S3物件建立事件來呼叫AWSGlueETL工作。設定 這些規則以串接AWSGlueETL工作序列，並處理複雜的工作依賴關係。

E.text: 使用AWSCodePipeline建置協調解決方案，以根據相依關係協調ETL流程與基礎設施 變更。

en_question: A media company uploads large video files to Amazon S3 for processing. After processing, the company needs to keep the original files for 90 days in case the files require reprocessing. After 90 days, the company can delete the files to reduce storage costs. The company stores the processed videos in a different S3 bucket. Which S3 Lifecycle configuration will meet these requirements for the original files MOST cost-effectively?

A.text: Store the files in S3 Standard for 90 days. Transition the files to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval for long-term storage. Then expire the files.

B.text: Store the files in S3 Standard for 90 days. Enable versioning. Enable Object Lock on the files for 90 days. Then expire the files.

C.text: Store the files in S3 Standard for 90 days. Implement S3 Lifecycle management to expire the files.

D.text: Store the files in S3 Intelligent-Tiering for 90 days. Enable versioning. Add S3 Lifecycle management to expire the files.

zh_question: 一家媒體公司將大型視訊檔案上傳至AmazonS3進行處理。處理完成後，該公司 需要保留原始檔案90天，以防檔案需要重新處理。90天後，該公司可以刪除這 些檔案以降低儲存成本。該公司將處理過的視訊儲存在另一個S3儲存貯體中。 哪種S3生命週期設定能以最具成本效益的方式滿足原始檔案的這些需求？

A.text: 將檔案儲存在S3Standard中90天。然後將檔案轉換至S3GlacierFlexibleRetrieval 以供長期儲存。然後讓檔案過期。

B.text: 將檔案儲存在S3Standard中90天。啟用版本控制。對檔案啟用物件鎖定90天。然後讓 檔案過期。

C.text: 將檔案儲存在S3Standard中90天。實作S3生命週期管理以讓檔案過期。

D.text: 將檔案儲存在S3Intelligent‑Tiering中90天。啟用版本控制。新增S3生命週期管 理以讓檔案過期。

en_question: A university is developing an educational application that analyzes student essays. The application provides personalized feedback with accurate citations to the university's textbooks. The application needs to process essays in multiple languages. Application responses must include direct references to specific sections in the course materials and must be in the student’s selected language. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Build a custom vector database by using Amazon OpenSearch Serverless. Store textbook content as multilingual embeddings. Create an AWS Lambda function that queues the database when generating responses with Amazon Bedrock.

B.text: Create a knowledge base in Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases with the university’s textbooks. Configure a multilingual model to generate responses with source citations.

C.text: Use Amazon Comprehend to detect the language and key topics in the essays. Use Amazon Kendra to search for relevant textbook passages. Create an AWS Lambda function that formats the textbook passages into feedback.

D.text: Use Amazon SageMaker to host a custom-trained large language model (LLM) that has been fine-tuned on the university’s textbooks to generate personalized feedback with citations.

zh_question: 一所大學正在開發一款教育應用程式，用於分析學生的論文。該應用程式提供個 人化回饋，並附上對大學教科書的準確引用。此應用程式需處理多種語言的論文。 應用程式的回應必須包含對課程材料特定章節的直接參考，且必須使用學生所選 的語言。 哪項解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用AmazonOpenSearchServerless建置自訂向量資料庫。將教科書內容儲存為多語言嵌 入。建立一個AWSLambda函式，在使用AmazonBedrock生成回應時將資料庫加入佇列。

B.text: 在AmazonBedrockKnowledgeBases中建立包含大學教科書的知識庫。設定多 語言模型以生成帶有來源引用的回應。

C.text: 使用AmazonComprehend偵測文章中的語言與關鍵主題。使用AmazonKendra搜尋 相關的教科書段落。建立一個AWSLambda函式，將教科書段落格式化為回饋意見。

D.text: 使用AmazonSageMaker託管經過大學教科書微調的自訂大型語言模型（LLM），以生成 帶有引用的個人化回饋。

en_question: A company needs a solution that restricts access to Amazon S3 data and encrypts the data by using AWS managed keys. The solution must manage database credentials that an AWS Lambda function uses and must rotate the credentials automatically. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Use S3 bucket policies to control access. Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3) to encrypt the data. Store the database credentials as Lambda environment variables.

B.text: Use IAM policies to control access. Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE- KMS) to encrypt the data. Configure AWS Secrets Manager to store and automatically rotate the credentials by using a Lambda function.

C.text: Use S3 ACLs to control access. Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) to encrypt the data. Store the credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store and automatically rotate the credentials by using a Lambda function.

D.text: Use IAM policies to control access. Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3) to encrypt the data. Store the credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Configure a scheduled Lambda function to rotate the credentials.

zh_question: 一家公司需要一種解決方案，以限制對AmazonS3資料的存取，並使用 AWS託管金鑰加密資料。該解決方案必須管理AWSLambda函數所使用的 資料庫憑證，並自動輪換這些憑證。 哪項解決方案能符合這些需求？

A.text: 使用S3儲存貯體原則來控制存取權限。使用由AmazonS3管理的金鑰（SSE‑S3） 進行伺服器端加密以加密資料。將資料庫憑證儲存為Lambda環境變數。

B.text: 使用IAM原則來控制存取權限。使用AWSKMS金鑰（SSE‑KMS）進行伺服器端加密以 加密資料。設定AWSSecretsManager以儲存憑證，並透過Lambda函式自動輪替憑證。

C.text: 使用S3存取控制清單（ACL）來控制存取權限。使用AWSKMS金鑰（SSE‑KMS）進行 伺服器端加密以加密資料。將憑證儲存在AWSSystemsManagerParameterStore中，並 透過Lambda函式自動輪替憑證。

D.text: 使用IAM原則來控制存取權限。使用由AmazonS3管理的金鑰（SSE‑S3）進行伺服器端加 密以加密資料。將憑證儲存在AWSSystemsManagerParameterStore中。 設定排程的Lambda函式以輪替憑證。

en_question: A company needs to store semi-structured transactional data for an application in a database. The database must be serverless. The application writes the data infrequently, but it reads the data frequently. The application must retrieve the data within milliseconds. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Store the data in an Amazon S3 Standard bucket. Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration.

B.text: Store the data in an Amazon S3 Apache Iceberg table. Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration.

C.text: Store the data in an Amazon RDS for MySQL cluster. Configure RDS Optimized Reads for the cluster.

D.text: Store the data in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Configure a DynamoDB Accelerator cache.

zh_question: 一家公司需要將應用程式的半結構化交易資料儲存至資料庫中。該資料庫必須為 無伺服器架構。應用程式寫入資料的頻率較低，但讀取資料的頻率較高，且必須 在數毫秒內檢索到資料。 哪項解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 將資料儲存在AmazonS3Standard儲存貯體中。啟用S3TransferAcceleration。

B.text: 將資料儲存在AmazonS3ApacheIceberg表中。啟用S3TransferAcceleration。

C.text: 將資料儲存在AmazonRDSforMySQL叢集中。為該叢組設定RDSOptimizedReads。

D.text: 將資料儲存在AmazonDynamoDB表中。設定DynamoDBAccelerator快取。

en_question: A company runs concurrent analytical queries on Amazon Redshift tables multiple times each day. The queries require consistent data views three times each day. The company runs extract, transform, and load (ETL) operations that update dimension tables while the queries run. The company has noticed that the queries cause table-level locks during the ETL operations. The company’s current solution experiences query timeouts and deadlocks during peak processing hours, which affects analytical reporting and on-demand analysis. Which solution will fix this issue?

A.text: Use Amazon Redshift materialized views for analytical queries. Schedule ETL operations during off-peak hours to minimize lock contention.

B.text: Configure Amazon Redshift federated queries to access source data directly. Use read replicas to isolate analytical workloads from ETL operations.

C.text: Use Amazon Redshift Spectrum to query data in Amazon S3 for analytical workloads. Maintain ETL operations on Amazon Redshift tables with transaction isolation.

D.text: Deploy separate Amazon Redshift clusters for ETL and analytics workloads. Use cross- database queries and data sharing to maintain data consistency.

zh_question: 一家公司每天多次在AmazonRedshift資料表上執行並發分析查詢。這些查詢 每天需要三次一致的資料視圖。該公司在查詢執行的同時，執行提取、轉換和載 入(ETL)作業以更新維度表。 該公司注意到，在ETL作業期間，查詢會導致資料表層級的鎖定。該公司目前的 解決方案在尖峰處理時段會發生查詢逾時和死結，進而影響分析報告與隨需分析。 哪項解決方案能修正此問題？

A.text: 使用AmazonRedshift實體化視圖進行分析查詢。排程執行ETL作業 於離峰時段，以最小化鎖定競爭。

B.text: 設定AmazonRedshift聯邦查詢，直接存取來源資料。使用讀取 複本以將分析工作負載與ETL作業隔離。

C.text: 使用AmazonRedshiftSpectrum查詢AmazonS3中的資料，以供分析工作負載使用。 在具有交易隔離功能的AmazonRedshift資料表上維持ETL作業。

D.text: 部署獨立的AmazonRedshift叢集，分別用於ETL與分析工作負載。使用跨資料庫查 詢和資料共享來維持資料一致性。

en_question: A company aggregates high-frequency sensor telemetry into an Amazon S3 data lake. Each sensor stream emits structured records every hour. The records include metadata such as sensor category, unit ID, operational state, event timestamp, and site location. The data scales up to millions of records each day. The company runs complex queries each day to uncover performance insights specific to sensor categories. Which solution will meet these requirements with the FASTEST query execution time?

A.text: Persist the data in Apache ORC format. Partition the data by date. Sort the data by sensor category.

B.text: Persist the data in CSV format. Partition the data by date. Sort the data by operational status.

C.text: Persist the data in Parquet format. Partition the data by sensor category. Sort the data by date

D.text: Persist the data in CSV format. Partition the data by date. Sort the data by sensor category.

zh_question: 一家公司將高頻率感測器遙測數據匯聚至AmazonS3資料湖。每個感測器串流每 小時發出結構化記錄。這些記錄 包含中繼資料，例如感測器類別、單位ID、運作狀態、事件 時間戳記和網站位置。資料規模每天可達數百萬筆記錄。 該公司每天執行複雜的查詢以發掘效能洞察 特定於感測器類別。 哪種解決方案能以最快的查詢執行時間滿足這些需求？

A.text: 將資料以ApacheORC格式持久化。按日期對資料進行分割。按感測器 類別排序。

B.text: 將資料以CSV格式持久化。按日期對資料進行分割。按運作狀態排序。

C.text: 將資料以Parquet格式持久化。按感測器類別對資料進行分割。按日期排序

D.text: 將資料以CSV格式持久化。按日期對資料進行分割。按感測器類別排序。

en_question: A company uses Amazon Redshift to store order transactions from the current day. The company has an orders table that contains the previous order data. The company also has a staging table that contains new or updated order records. The company needs to remove stale records from the orders table and insert the most recent data in the orders table from the staging table. Several downstream applications need the orders table to display up-to-date information. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Use Amazon Redshift Spectrum to delete stale records from the orders table and insert records from the staging table into the orders table.

B.text: Unload the orders table and the staging table to Amazon S3. Delete stale orders table data and insert new staging table data in Amazon S3 by using Amazon Athena. Copy the orders S3 table to the orders Amazon Redshift table.

C.text: Use Amazon Athena federated queries to read stale records from the orders table. Delete the stale records and insert the records from the staging table into the orders table.

D.text: Write an Amazon Redshift stored procedure that deletes the stale records from the orders table and inserts new records from the staging table.

zh_question: 某公司使用AmazonRedshift儲存當日的訂單交易資料。該公司擁有一個 orders資料表，其中包含歷史訂單資料；另有一個暫存資料表，用於存放新增 或更新的訂單記錄。 公司需要從orders資料表中移除過時的記錄，並將staging資料表中的最新 資料插入orders資料表。多個下游應用程式需要orders資料表顯示最新資訊。 哪種解決方案能符合這些需求？

A.text: 使用AmazonRedshiftSpectrum從orders資料表中刪除過時的記錄，並將 staging資料表中的記錄插入orders資料表。

B.text: 將orders資料表和staging資料表卸載至AmazonS3。使用AmazonAthena在 AmazonS3中刪除過時的orders資料表資料，並插入新的staging資料表資料。然後將 ordersS3資料表複製到ordersAmazonRedshift資料表。

C.text: 使用AmazonAthena聯邦查詢讀取orders資料表中的過時記錄。刪除這些過時記錄，並將 staging資料表中的記錄插入orders資料表。

D.text: 撰寫一個AmazonRedshift預存程序，從orders資料表中刪除過時的記錄，並從暫存資 料表中插入新記錄。

en_question: A company is developing a log streaming pipeline that uses Amazon Data Firehose. The pipeline streams Amazon CloudWatch Logs data to an Amazon S3 bucket. The company's analytics team needs to use the data in audits. The pipeline must deliver only the relevant logs to the S3 bucket in a compatible format for the team's analysis. Which solution will meet these requirements and maintain reliable performance?

A.text: Set the S3 bucket rules to allow logs from only specific timestamp ranges. Create an AWS Lambda function that converts the log files to the desired format. Use an S3 trigger to invoke the Lambda function.

B.text: Create a subscription filter in the CloudWatch Logs log group that uses the Firehose delivery stream as the destination. Create an AWS Lambda function that converts the log files to the desired format. Configure Firehose to invoke the Lambda function.

C.text: Create a subscription filter in the CloudWatch Logs log group. Configure the filter to monitor the Firehose stream. Create an AWS Lambda function to convert the log files to the desired format. Configure Firehose to invoke the Lambda function.

D.text: Tag the CloudWatch Logs log groups that the analytics team needs. Configure Firehose to ingest only the tagged log groups. Configure Firehose to write the output in the desired format.

zh_question: 一家公司正在開發使用AmazonDataFirehose的日誌串流管線。該管線將 AmazonCloudWatchLogs資料串流至AmazonS3儲存桶。該公司的分析團 隊需要在稽核中使用這些資料。此管線必須僅將相關日誌以符合團隊分析需求的 相容格式遞送至S3儲存桶。 哪項解決方案能符合這些需求並維持可靠的效能？

A.text: 設定S3儲存貯體規則，僅允許特定時間範圍的日誌。建立一個AWSLambda函數，將日 誌檔案轉換為所需格式。使用S3觸發程序來叫用該Lambda函數。

B.text: 在CloudWatchLogs日誌群組中建立訂閱篩選器，並將Firehose遞送串流設為目的地。 建立一個AWSLambda函數，將日誌檔案轉換為所需格式。設定Firehose以叫用該 Lambda函數。

C.text: 在CloudWatchLogs日誌群組中建立訂閱篩選器。設定該篩選器以監控Firehose串流。 建立一個AWSLambda函數，將日誌檔案轉換為所需格式。設定Firehose以叫用該 Lambda函數。

D.text: 為分析團隊所需的CloudWatchLogs日誌群組加上標籤。設定Firehose僅攝取已加上標 籤的日誌群組。設定Firehose以所需格式寫入輸出。

en_question: A media company wants to build a real-time analytics pipeline to process customer activity events across the company's website and mobile app. The company wants to build a solution to ingest millions of events with minimum latency. The solution must be scalable and durable enough so that no data is lost. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST cost-effective way?

A.text: Set up an Amazon Kinesis Data Streams pipeline to ingest data, process the data by using AWS Lambda functions, and store the results in Amazon Redshift for analytics.

B.text: Schedule an AWS Glue job to fetch user interaction logs every 10 minutes from Amazon S3. Configure the AWS Glue job to transform and store the data in Amazon Redshift for analytics.

C.text: Configure Amazon S3 Event Notifications to invoke an AWS Lambda function to process every new interaction log file. Store the result in Amazon Redshift for analytics.

D.text: Deploy an Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK) cluster. Use self- managed consumers to process and distribute data in real-time. Integrate with Amazon Redshift for enhanced analytics.

zh_question: 一家媒體公司希望建置一個即時分析管線，以處理該公司網站與行動應用程式 中的客戶活動事件。該公司希望建置一套解決方案，能夠以最低延遲攝取數百 萬筆事件。此解決方案必須具備足夠的擴充性與耐久性，確保不會遺失任何資 料。 哪種解決方案能以最具成本效益的方式滿足這些需求？

A.text: 設定AmazonKinesisDataStreams管線以攝取資料，使用AWSLambda函數處理資 料，並將結果儲存至AmazonRedshift以供分析。

B.text: 排程一個AWSGlue工作，每10分鐘從AmazonS3擷取使用者互動日誌。 設定AWSGlue工作以轉換資料並將其儲存至AmazonRedshift以供分析。

C.text: 設定AmazonS3事件通知，以呼叫AWSLambda函數來處理每個 新的互動記錄檔案。將結果儲存至AmazonRedshift以進行分析。

D.text: 部署一個AmazonManagedStreamingforApacheKafka(AmazonMSK)叢集。使用自 行管理的消費者來即時處理與分發資料。整合AmazonRedshift以強化分析功能。

en_question: A company stores a large dataset in an Amazon S3 bucket. A data engineer frequently runs complex queries on the dataset by using Amazon Athena. The data engineer needs to optimize query performance and optimize costs for queries that are run multiple times with the same parameters. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Convert the dataset to JSON format before running Athena queries.

B.text: Use Amazon EMR to pre-process the data before running Athena queries.

C.text: Configure query result reuse settings in the Athena workgroup.

D.text: Use Amazon Redshift Spectrum to query the data in Amazon S3.

zh_question: 一家公司將大型資料集儲存在AmazonS3儲存貯體中。一位資料工程師經常 使用AmazonAthena在該資料集上執行複雜查詢。這位資料工程師需要優化 查詢效能，並針對使用相同參數多次執行的查詢來優化成本。 哪種解決方案能符合這些需求？

A.text: 在執行Athena查詢之前，將資料集轉換為JSON格式。

B.text: 使用AmazonEMR在執行Athena查詢之前預先處理資料。

C.text: 在Athena工作群組中設定查詢結果重複使用設定。

D.text: 使用AmazonRedshiftSpectrum查詢AmazonS3中的資料。

en_question: A company stores raw clickstream data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company needs a solution to process the data every day by using complex PySpark transformations that rely on custom internal libraries. After the data is transformed, the company must store the data in Amazon Redshift for analytics. The solution must be highly scalable to handle large data workloads. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A.text: Use AWS Glue Studio to build and schedule PySpark jobs. Configure an AWS Glue data connection that includes the custom libraries.

B.text: Use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups with a custom AMI that contains the custom libraries to run a PySpark application.

C.text: Use Amazon EMR to run PySpark jobs. Use bootstrap actions to install the custom libraries

D.text: Use Amazon SageMaker Processing jobs to run PySpark code that uses native SageMaker libraries.

zh_question: 一家公司將原始點擊流資料儲存在AmazonS3儲存貯體中。該公司需要一種解決 方案，每天使用依賴自訂內部函式庫的複雜PySpark轉換來處理資料。資料轉換 後，公司必須將資料儲存在AmazonRedshift中以進行分析。該解決方案必須具 備高度可擴展性，以處理大型資料工作負載。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

A.text: 使用AWSGlueStudio建置並排程PySpark工作。設定包含自訂函式庫的AWS Glue資料連線。

B.text: 使用包含自訂函式庫的自訂AMI，搭配AmazonEC2自動擴展群組來執行PySpark應用程 式。

C.text: 使用AmazonEMR執行PySpark工作。使用啟動動作來安裝自訂函式庫。

D.text: 使用AmazonSageMaker處理工作來執行使用原生SageMaker函式庫的PySpark程 式碼。

en_question: An application uses an AWS Lambda function that is configured with managed runtimes. The Lambda function successfully writes logs to the default Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group. A data engineer wants to modify the logging behavior to show only ERROR level logs for application logs and WARN level logs for system logs. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.text: Add additional permissions to the Lambda execution role.

B.text: Set the log level to ERROR in the Lambda function code.

C.text: Configure the Lambda function to use the JSON log format.

D.text: Configure the Lambda function to send logs to a custom log group.

zh_question: 某個應用程式使用已設定為受管執行時期的AWSLambda函式。該La mbda函式能成功將日誌寫入預設的AmazonCloudWatchLogs日誌群組。 一位資料工程師希望修改日誌行為，使應用程式日誌僅顯示ERROR層級，而 系統日誌僅顯示WARN層級。 哪項解決方案能符合這些需求？

A.text: 為Lambda執行角色新增其他權限。

B.text: 在Lambda函式程式碼中將記錄層級設定為ERROR。

C.text: 將Lambda函式設定為使用JSON記錄格式。

D.text: 將Lambda函式設定為將記錄傳送至自訂記錄群組。
